Jab Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi ko koi baat taakeed se kahe toh zahir hai ki auron par woh taakeed aur bhi zyada hai. Taqwa use kehte hain ki Allah Ta'ala ki hidayat ke mutabiq sawab ke talab ki niyyat se Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at ki jaye. Aur farman-e-bari ke mutabiq uske azabon se bachne ke liye uski nafarmaniyan tark ki jayen. Kafiron aur munafiqon ki baatein na manna na unke mashwaron par karband hona na unki baatein qubuliyat ke irade se sunna. Ilm-o-hikmat ka malik Allah Ta'ala hi hai chunke woh apne wasee ilm se har kaam ka natija janta hai aur apni be-payan hikmat se uski koi baat koi feil ghair-hakeemana nahi hota toh tu usi ki ita'at કરતા rahe taaki bad-anjam se aur bigaar se bacha rahe. Jo Quran-o-Sunnat teri taraf wahi ho raha hai uski pairwi kar, Allah par kisi ka koi feil makhfi nahi. Apne tamam umoor-o-ahwal mein Allah Ta'ala ki zaat par hi bharosa rakh. Us par bharosa karne walon ko woh kafi hai kyunki tamam karsazi par woh qadir hai, uski taraf jhukne wala kamyab hi kamyab hai.

Sach badal nahin sakta, le-palak beta nahin ban sakta. Maqsood ko bayan karne se pehle bator-e-muqaddame aur suboot ke maslan ek woh baat bayan farmayi jise sab mehsoos karte hain aur phir us ki taraf se zehan hatakar apne maqsood ki taraf le gaye. Bayan farmaya ke yeh toh zahir hai ke kisi insaan ke dil do nahin hote. Isi tarah tum samajh lo ke apni jis biwi ko tum maa keh do toh woh waqai maa nahin ho jati. Theek isi tarah dusre ki aulad ko apna beta bana lene se woh sach-much beta hi nahin ho jata. Apni biwi se agar kisi ne bahalat-e-ghazab-o-ghussa keh diya ke tu mujh par aisi hai jaise meri maa ki peeth, toh is kehne se woh sach-much maa nahin ban jatin. Maayein toh woh hain jin ke batn se yeh paida hue hain. In dono baaton ke bayan ke baad asal maqsood ko bayan farmaya ke tumhare le-palak ladke bhi darhaqiqat tumhare ladke nahin. Yeh aayat Hazrat Zaid bin Harith R.A ke bare mein utri hai jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke azaad karda the, unhein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne nabuwwat se pehle apna mutabanni bana rakha tha. Unhein Zaid bin Muhammad kaha jata tha. Is aayat se is nisbat aur is ilhaq ka tod dena manzoor hai. Jaise ke isi surat ke asna mein hai aayat: (Mā kāna muḥammadun abā aḥadim-mir-rijālikum wa lākir-rasūlallāhi wa khātaman-nabiyyīn, wa kānallāhu bikulli shay'in 'alīmā) (Al-Ahzab: 40). Tum mein se kisi mard ke baap Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) nahin hain, balkeh woh Allah ke Rasool aur nabiyon ke khatam karne wale hain. Allah Ta'ala ko har cheez ka ilm hai. Yahan farmaya yeh toh sirf tumhari ek zabani baat hai, jo tum kisi ke ladke ko kisi ka ladka kaho, is se haqeeqat badal nahin sakti. Waqai mein us ka baap woh hai jis ki peeth se yeh nikla. Yeh namumkin hai ke ek ladke ke do baap hon, jaise yeh namumkin hai ke ek seene mein do dil hon. Allah Ta'ala haq farmane wala aur seedhi raah dikhane wala hai. Baaz log kehte hain ke yeh aayat ek Quraishi ke bare mein utri hai jis ne mashhoor kar rakha tha ke us ke do dil hain aur dono aql-o-fahm se pur hain, Allah Ta'ala ne is baat ki tardeed kar di. Ibn Abbas R.A ka bayan hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) namaz mein the, aap ko kuch khatra guzra, is par jo munafiq namaz mein shamil the woh kehne lage dekho is ke do dil hain, ek tumhare saath ek un ke saath. Is par yeh aayat utri ke Allah Ta'ala ne kisi shakhs ke seene mein do dil nahin banaye. Zuhri farmate hain yeh toh sirf bator-e-misaal ke farmaya gaya hai, yani jis tarah kisi shakhs ke do dil nahin hote isi tarah kisi bete ke do baap nahin ho sakte. Isi ke mutabiq hum ne bhi is aayat ki tafseer ki hai. Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam. Pehle toh rukhsat thi ke le-palak ladke ko palne wale ki taraf nisbat karke us ka beta keh kar pukara jaye, lekin ab Islam ne is ko mansookh kar diya hai aur farma diya hai ke un ke jo apne haqeeqi baap hain un hi ki taraf mansoob karke pukaro. Adl, neki, insaaf aur sachai yahi hai.

Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) farmate hain is aayat ke utarne se pehle hum Hazrat Zaid ko Zaid bin Muhammad (ﷺ) kaha karte the lekin is ke nazil hone ke baad hum ne yeh kehna chhor diya. Balkeh pehle toh aise le-paalak ke woh tamam huqooq hote the jo saggi aur sulbi aulad ke hote hain. Chunancha is aayat ke utarne ke baad Hazrat Sahla bint-e-Sahl (R.A) hazir-e-khidmat-e-Nabawi (ﷺ) ho kar arz karti hain ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) hum ne Salim ko munh-bola beta bana rakha tha ab Quran ne un ke bare mein faisla kar diya. Main us se ab tak parda nahin karti woh aa jate hain lekin mera khayal hai ke mere khawand Hazrat Huzaifa un ke is tarah aane se kuch bezar hain. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya phir kya hai jao Salim ko apna doodh pila is par haram ho jaogi. Al-garz yeh hukm mansookh ho gaya hai ab saaf lafzon mein aise larkon ki biwiyon ki bhi mudakhilat unhein larka banane wale ke liye bayan farma di. Aur jab Hazrat Zaid (R.A) ne apni biwi sahiba Hazrat Zainab bint-e-Jahsh ko talaq de di toh Aap (ﷺ) ne khud apna nikah un se kar liya aur musalman is ek mushkil se bhi chhoot gaye. Falhamdulillah isi ka lihaz rakhte hue jahan haram aurton ka zikr kiya wahan farmaya aayat (Wa-halaailu abnaikumul-lazina min aslabikum) (Surah (An-Nisa: 23) yani tumhari apni sulb se jo larke hon un ki biwiyan tum par haram hain. Haan raza'i larka nasbi aur sulbi larke ke hukm mein hai. Jaise Bukhari o Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke raza'at se woh tamam rishte haram ho jate hain jo nasab se haram ho jate hain. Yeh bhi khayal rahe ke pyar se kisi ko beta keh dena yeh aur cheez hai yeh mamnoo nahin. Musnad-e-Ahmad wagaira mein hai, Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain hum sab khandan-e-Abdul Muttalib ke chote bachon ko Muzdalifa se Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne raat ko hi Jamarat ki taraf rukhsat kar diya aur hamari ranen thapakte hue Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya beto suraj nikalne se pehle Jamarat par kankariyan na marna. Yeh waqia sanah 10 Hijri mah-e-Zul-Hijjah ka hai aur is ki dalalat zahir hai. Hazrat Zaid bin Haritha jin ke bare mein yeh hukm utra yeh sanah 8 Hijri mein Jang-e-Mota mein shaheed hue. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein marwi hai ke Hazrat Anas (R.A) ko Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne apna beta keh kar bulaya. Ise bayan farma kar ke le-paalak larkon ko un ke baap ki taraf mansoob kar ke pukara karo palne walon ki taraf nahin. Phir farmata hai ke agar tumhein un ke baapon ka ilm na ho toh woh tumhare deeni bhai aur islami dost hain. Huzoor (ﷺ) jab Umratul-Qaza wale saal Makkah Sharif se wapas laute toh Hazrat Hamza (R.A) ki sahibzadi chacha-chacha kehti hui aap ke peeche daurin. Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne unhein le kar Hazrat Fatima Zahra (R.A) ko de diya aur farmaya yeh tumhari chacha-zad behan hain unhein achi tarah rakho. Hazrat Zaid aur Hazrat Jafar farmane lage is bachi ke haqdar hum hain hum unhein palenge. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain nahin yeh mere han rahengi. Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne toh yeh daleel di ke mere chacha ki larki hain. Hazrat Zaid (R.A) farmate hain mere bhai ki larki hai. Jafar bin Abi Talib (R.A) kehne lage mere chacha ki larki hain.

Aur un ki chachi mere ghar mein hain yani Hazrat Asma bint-e-Umais (R.A)। Aakhir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh faisla kiya ke sahibzadi toh apni khala ke paas rahein kyunke khala maa ke qaim-maqam hai। Hazrat Ali (R.A) se farmaya tu mera hai aur main tera hoon। Hazrat Jafar (R.A) se farmaya tu surat-o-seerat mein mere mushaba hai। Hazrat Zaid (R.A) se farmaya tu mera bhai hai aur hamara maula hai। Is hadith mein bahut se ahkaam hain। Sab se behtar toh yeh hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hukm-e-haq suna kar aur daawedaron ko bhi naraz nahin hone diya। Aur aap ne isi aayat par amal karte hue Hazrat Zaid (R.A) se farmaya tum hamare bhai aur hamare dost ho। Hazrat Abu Bakra (R.A) ne farmaya isi aayat ke mat-hat main tumhara bhai hoon। Ubay farmate hain wallah agar yeh bhi maloom hota ke un ke walid koi aise waise hi thay toh bhi yeh un ki taraf mansoob hote। Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke jo shakhs jaan boojh kar apni nisbat apne baap ki taraf se dusre ki taraf kare us ne kufr kiya। Is se sakht wa'eed payi jati hai aur sabit hota hai ke sahi nasab se apne aap ko hatana bahut bada kabira gunah hai। Phir farmata hai jab tum ne apne taur par jitni taqat tum mein hai tehqeeq karke kisi ko kisi ki taraf nisbat kiya aur fil-haqeeqat woh nisbat ghalat hai toh is khata par tumhari pakad nahin। Chunancha khud Parwardigar ne hamein aisi dua taleem di ke hum us ki janab mein hain aayat (Rabbana la tu'akhizna in-nasina au akhta'na) (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 286) Aye Allah hamari bhool chook aur ghalti par hamein na pakad। Sahih Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke jab musalmanon ne yeh dua padhi Janab-e-Bari Azza Ismuhu ne farmaya main ne yeh dua qabool farmayi। Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai jab hakim apni koshish mein kamyab ho jaye apne ijtihad mein sehat ko pahunch jaye toh use dohra ajr milta hai aur agar khata ho jaye toh use ek ajr milta hai। Aur hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne meri ummat ko un ki khatayein bhool chook aur jo kaam un se zabardasti karaye jayen un se dargarzar farma liya hai। Yahan bhi yeh farma kar irshad farmaya ke haan jo kaam tum qasd-e-qalb se amdan karo woh beshak qabil-e-girift hain। Qasmon ke bare mein bhi yahi hukm hai upar jo hadith bayan hui ke nasab badalne wala kufr ka murtakib hai wahan bhi yeh lafz hain ke bawajood janne ke। Aayat-e-Quran jo ab tilawatan mansookh hai us mein tha aayat (Fa-in kufrabikum an targhabu an aba'ikum) yani tumhara apne baap ki taraf nisbat hatana kufr hai। Hazrat Umar (R.A) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko haq ke sath bheja aap ke sath kitab nazil farmayi is mein rajam ki bhi aayat thi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne khud bhi rajam kiya (yani shadi shuda zaniyon ko sangsar kiya) aur hum ne bhi aap ke baad rajam kiya। Hum ne Quran mein yeh aayat bhi padhi hai ke apne baapon se apna silsila-e-nasab na hatao yeh kufr hai। Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka irshad hai mujhe tum meri tareefon mein is tarah badha chadha na dena jaise Isa bin Maryam (Alaihimas Salam) ke sath hua। Main toh sirf Allah ka banda hoon toh tum mujhe Allah ka banda aur Rasool-e-Allah kehna।

Ek riwayat mein sirf Ibn-e-Maryam hai. Aur hadith mein hai teen khaslatein logon mein hain jo kufr hain: nasab mein ta'na zani, mayyat par nauha, sitaron se baran talbi.))

agar yeh bhi maloom hota ke un ke walid koi aise waise hi thay toh bhi yeh un ki taraf mansoob hote। Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke jo shakhs jaan boojh kar apni nisbat apne baap ki taraf se dusre ki taraf kare us ne kufr kiya। Is se sakht wa'eed payi jati hai aur sabit hota hai ke sahi nasab se apne aap ko hatana bahut bada kabira gunah hai। Phir farmata hai jab tum ne apne taur par jitni taqat tum mein hai tehqeeq karke kisi ko kisi ki taraf nisbat kiya aur fil-haqeeqat woh nisbat ghalat hai toh is khata par tumhari pakad nahin। Chunancha khud Parwardigar ne hamein aisi dua taleem di ke hum us ki janab mein hain aayat (Rabbana la tu'akhizna in-nasina au akhta'na) (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 286) Aye Allah hamari bhool chook aur ghalti par hamein na pakad। Sahih Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke jab musalmanon ne yeh dua padhi Janab-e-Bari Azza Ismuhu ne farmaya main ne yeh dua qabool farmayi। Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai jab hakim apni koshish mein kamyab ho jaye apne ijtihad mein sehat ko pahunch jaye toh use dohra ajr milta hai aur agar khata ho jaye toh use ek ajr milta hai। Aur hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne meri ummat ko un ki khatayein bhool chook aur jo kaam un se zabardasti karaye jayen un se dargarzar farma liya hai। Yahan bhi yeh farma kar irshad farmaya ke haan jo kaam tum qasd-e-qalb se amdan karo woh beshak qabil-e-girift hain। Qasmon ke bare mein bhi yahi hukm hai upar jo hadith bayan hui ke nasab badalne wala kufr ka murtakib hai wahan bhi yeh lafz hain ke bawajood janne ke। Aayat-e-Quran jo ab tilawatan mansookh hai us mein tha aayat (Fa-in kufrabikum an targhabu an aba'ikum) yani tumhara apne baap ki taraf nisbat hatana kufr hai। Hazrat Umar (R.A) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko haq ke sath bheja aap ke sath kitab nazil farmayi is mein rajam ki bhi aayat thi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne khud bhi rajam kiya (yani shadi shuda zaniyon ko sangsar kiya) aur hum ne bhi aap ke baad rajam kiya। Hum ne Quran mein yeh aayat bhi padhi hai ke apne baapon se apna silsila-e-nasab na hatao yeh kufr hai। Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka irshad hai mujhe tum meri tareefon mein is tarah badha chadha na dena jaise Isa bin Maryam (Alaihimas Salam) ke sath hua। Main toh sirf Allah ka banda hoon toh tum mujhe Allah ka banda aur Rasool-e-Allah kehna।

Ek riwayat mein sirf Ibn-e-Maryam hai. Aur hadith mein hai teen khaslatein logon mein hain jo kufr hain: nasab mein ta'na zani, mayyat par nauha, sitaron se baran talbi.))

Takmeel-e-Iman ki zaroori shart: Chunke Rabb-ul-Izzat Wahdahu La Sharika ko ilm hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni ummat par khud un ki apni jaan se bhi zyada meharban hain. Is liye Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko un ki apni jaan se bhi unka zyada ikhtiyar diya. Yeh khud apne liye koi tajweez na karein balkeh har hukm-e-Rasool ko ba-dil-o-jaan qabool karte jayen jaise farmaya aayat (فَلَا وَرَبِّكَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ حَتّٰي يُحَكِّمُوْكَ فِيْمَا شَجَــرَ بَيْنَھُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُوْا فِيْٓ اَنْفُسِهِمْ حَرَجًا مِّمَّا قَضَيْتَ وَيُسَلِّمُوْا تَسْلِــيْمًا) (Surah (An-Nisa: 65), tere Rabb ki qasam yeh momin na honge jab tak ke apne aapas ke tamam ikhtilafat mein tujhe munsif na maan lein aur tere tamam tar ahkaam aur faislon ko ba-dil-o-jaan aur kushada peshani qabool na kar lein. Sahih hadith shareef mein hai us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai tum mein se koi ba-iman nahin ho sakta, jab tak ke main use us ke nafs se, us ke maal se, us ki aulad se aur duniya ke kul logon se zyada mehboob na ho jaon. Ek aur sahih hadith mein hai Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap mujhe tamam jahan se zyada mehboob hain lekin haan khud mere apne nafs se. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya nahin nahin Umar jab tak ke main tujhe khud tere nafs se bhi zyada mehboob na ban jaon. Yeh sun kar Janab-e-Farooq (R.A) farmane lage qasam Allah ki Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap mujhe har cheez se yahan tak ke meri apni jaan se bhi zyada aziz hain, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ab theek hai. Bukhari Shareef mein is aayat ki tafseer mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tamam mominon ka zyada haqdar duniya aur aakhirat mein khud un ki apni jaano se bhi zyada main hoon. Agar tum chaho to parh lo aayat (اَلنَّبِيُّ اَوْلٰى بالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ مِنْ اَنْفُسِهِمْ وَاَزْوَاجُهٗٓ اُمَّهٰتُهُمْ ۭ وَاُولُوا الْاَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ اَوْلٰى بِبَعْضٍ فِيْ كِتٰبِ اللّٰهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُهٰجِرِيْنَ اِلَّآ اَنْ تَفْعَلُوْٓا اِلٰٓى اَوْلِيٰۗىِٕكُمْ مَّعْرُوْفًا ۭ كَانَ ذٰلِكَ فِي الْكِتٰبِ مَسْطُوْرًا) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 6). Suno jo musalman maal chor kar mare us ka maal to us ke warison ka hissa hai, aur agar koi mar jaye aur us ke zimme qarz ho ya us ke chote chote baal bache hon to us ke qarz ki adaigi ka main zimmedar hoon aur un bachon ki parwarish mere zimme hai. Phir farmata hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki azwaj-e-mutahharat hurmat aur ehtram mein, izzat aur ikram mein, buzurgi aur izam mein tamam musalmanon mein aisi hain jaisi khud ki apni maayen. Haan maa ke aur ahkaam maslan khalwat ya un ki larkiyon aur behnon se nikah ki hurmat yahan sabit nahin, go baaz ulama ne un ki betiyon ko bhi musalmanon ki behnein likha hai jaise ke Hazrat Imam Shafi (R.H) ne mukhtasar mein nassan farmaya hai lekin yeh ibarat ka itlaq hai na hukm ka isbat. Hazrat Muawiyah (R.A) waghera ko jo kisi na kisi Umm-ul-Momineen ke bhai the unhein mamoon kaha ja sakta hai ya nahin? Is mein ikhtilaf hai, Imam Shafi (R.H) ne to kaha hai keh sakte hain.

Rahi yeh baat ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Abu-ul-Momineen bhi keh sakte hain ya nahin? Yeh khayal rahe ke Abu-ul-Momineen kehne mein Musalman auratein bhi aajayengi, jama muzakkar salim mein ba-aitibar-e-taghlib ke muannas bhi shamil hai. Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ka farman hai ke nahin keh sakte, Imam Shafi (R.H) ke do qaulon mein bhi zyada sahih qaul yahi hai. Ubayy bin Ka'ab aur Ibn Abbas (R.A) ki qira'at mein 'Ummahatuhum' ke baad yeh lafz hain 'wa huwa abun lahum' yani Aap (ﷺ) un ke walid hain. Mazhab-e-Shafi mein bhi ek qaul yahi hai. Aur kuch ta'eed hadith se bhi hoti hai ke Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Main tumhare liye qaim-maqam baap ke hoon, main tumhein ta'leem de raha hoon, suno tum mein se jab koi pakhane mein jaye to Qibla ki taraf munh karke na baithe, na apne dahine haath se dheele le, na dahine haath se istinja kare. Aap (ﷺ) teen dheele lene ka hukm dete the aur gobar aur haddi se istinja karne ki muman'at farmate the (Nasa'i waghera). Is mein dusra qaul yeh hai ke Huzoor-e-Akram (ﷺ) ko baap na kaha jaye kyunke Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat: (Ma kana Muhammadun aba ahadin min rijalikum wa lakin Rasulallahi wa khataman-nabiyyin, wa kanallahu bikulli shai'in 'alima) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 40). Huzoor (ﷺ) tum mein se kisi mard ke baap nahin. Phir farmata hai ke ba-nisbat aam mominon, Muhajireen aur Ansar ke warse ke zyada mustahiq qarabatdar hain. Is se pehle Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ) ne Muhajireen aur Ansar mein jo bhai-chara karaya tha, isi ke aitibar se yeh aapas mein ek dusre ke waris hote the aur qasmein kha kar ek dusron ke jo haleef bane hue the, woh bhi aapas mein virsa baant liya karte the. Is ko is aayat ne mansookh kar diya. Pehle agar Ansari mar gaya to us ke waris us ki qarabat ke log nahin hote the balki Muhajir hote the jin ke darmiyan Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne bhai-chara kara diya tha. Hazrat Zubair bin Awwam (R.A) ka bayan hai ke yeh hukm khaas hum Ansari-o-Muhajireen ke bare mein utra. Hum jab Makkah chhod kar Madine aaye to hamare paas maal kuch na tha, yahan aa kar hum ne Ansariyon se bhai-chara kiya, yeh behtareen bhai saabit hue yahan tak ke un ke faut hone ke baad un ke maal ke waris bhi hote the. Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) ka bhai-chara Hazrat Kharija bin Zaid (R.A) ke saath tha. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ka falan ke saath. Hazrat Usman (R.A) ka ek Zurqi shakhs ke saath. Khud mera Hazrat Ka'ab bin Malik (R.A) ke saath. Yeh zakhmi hue aur zakhm bhi kaari the, agar us waqt un ka inteqal ho jata to main bhi un ka waris banta. Phir yeh aayat utri aur miras ka aam hukm hamare liye bhi ho gaya. Phir farmata hai virsa to un ka nahin lekin waise agar tum apne mukhlis ahbaab ke saath sulook karna chaho to tumhein ikhtiyar hai, wasiyat ke taur par kuch de-dila sakte ho. Phir farmata hai Allah ka yeh hukm pehle hi se is Kitab mein likha hua tha jis mein koi tarmeem-o-tabdeeli nahin hui.

Beech mein jo bhai-charey par virsa bat-ta tha yeh sirf ek khaas maslahat ki bina par khaas waqt tak ke liye tha, ab yeh hata diya gaya aur asli hukm de diya gaya, Wallahu A'lam.)))

Misaq-e-Anbiya farman hai ke in paanchon Ulul-Azm paighambaron se aur aam nabiyon se sab se hum ne ahd-o-waada liya ke woh mere deen ki tableegh karenge is par qaim rahenge. Aapas mein ek dusre ki madad-o-imdad aur ta'eed karenge aur ittefaq-o-ittehad rakhenge. Isi ahd ka zikr is aayat mein hai (وَاِذْ اَخَذَ اللّٰهُ مِيْثَاق النَّبِيّٖنَ لَمَآ اٰتَيْتُكُمْ مِّنْ كِتٰبٍ وَّحِكْمَةٍ ثُمَّ جَاۗءَكُمْ رَسُوْلٌ مُّصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَكُمْ لَتُؤْمِنُنَّ بِهٖ وَلَتَنْصُرُنَّهٗ 81) (Surah (Aal-e-Imran: 81) yani Allah Ta'ala ne nabiyon se qaul-o-qarar liya ke jo kuch kitab-o-hikmat de kar main tumhein bhejoon phir tumhare saath ki cheez ki tasdeeq karne wala rasool aa jaye to tum zaroor us par imaan lana aur us ki imdad karna. Bolo tumhein is ka iqrar hai? Aur mere samne is ka pukhta waada karte hain? Sab ne jawab diya ke haan hamein iqrar hai. Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne farmaya bas ab gawah rehna aur main khud bhi tumhare saath gawah hoon. Yahan aam nabiyon ka zikr kar ke phir khaas jaleel-ul-qadr paighambaron ka naam bhi le diya. Isi tarah in ke naam is aayat mein bhi hain (شَرَعَ لَكُمْ مِّنَ الدِّيْنِ مَا وَصّٰى بِهٖ نُوْحًا وَّالَّذِيْٓ اَوْحَيْنَآ اِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهٖٓ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ وَمُوْسٰى وَعِيْسٰٓى اَنْ اَقِيْمُوا الدِّيْنَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوْا فِيْهِ 13) (Surah (Ash-Shura: 13). Yahan Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ka zikr hai jo zameen par Allah ke pehle paighambar thay, Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka zikr hai jo sab se aakhri paighambar thay. Aur Ibrahim, Musa aur Isa (Alaihimas Salam / A.S) ka zikr hai jo darmiyani paighambar thay. Ek latafat is mein yeh hai ke pehle paighambar Hazrat Adam (A.S) ke baad ke paighambar Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ka zikr kiya aur aakhri paighambar Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se pehle ke paighambar Hazrat Isa (A.S) ka zikr kiya aur darmiyani paighambaron mein se Hazrat Ibrahim aur Hazrat Musa (Alaihimas Salam / A.S) ka zikr kiya. Yahan to tarteeb yeh rakhi ke fatih aur khatim ka zikr kar ke beech ke nabiyon ka bayan kiya aur is aayat mein sab se pehle Khatam-ul-Anbiya ka naam liya is liye ke sab se ashraf-o-afzal aap hi hain. Phir yak-e-baad-e-deegare jis tarah aaye hain isi tarah tarteeb-war bayan kiya. Allah Ta'ala apne tamam nabiyon par apna durood-o-salam nazil farmaye. Is aayat ki tafseer mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke paidaish ke aitbar se main sab nabiyon se pehle hoon aur duniya mein aane ke aitbar se sab se aakhir mein hoon, pas mujh se ibtida ki hai. Yeh hadith Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai lekin is ke ek rawi Saeed bin Bashir za'eef hain. Aur sanad se yeh mursal marwi hai aur yahi zyada mushabahat rakhti hai aur baaz ne ise mauqoof riwayat ki hai, Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain Hazrat Adam (A.S) ki aulad mein sab se zyada Allah ke pasandeeda paanch paighambar hain: Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, Isa, aur Muhammad (Salawatullahi wa Salamuhu Alaihim Ajma'een) aur in mein bhi sab se behtar Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain. Is ka ek rawi za'eef hai.

Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is aayat mein jis ahd-o-meesaq ka zikr hai yeh woh hai jo roz-e-azal mein Hazrat Adam (A.S) ki peeth se tamam insano ko nikal kar liya tha. Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) se marvi hai ke Hazrat Adam (A.S) ko buland kiya gaya, aap ne apni aulad ko dekha, un mein maldar, muflis, khubsurat aur har tarah ke log dekhe to kaha, "Allah! Kya achha hota ke tu ne in sab ko barabar hi rakha hota." Allah Ta'ala Azz-o-Jal Jalaluhu ne farmaya ke yeh is liye hai ke mera shukr ada kiya jaye. In mein jo Anbiya-e-Kiram (Alaihimas Salam) thay unhein bhi aap ne dekha, woh roshni ke manind numaya thay, un par noor baras raha tha. Un se nabuwwat-o-risalat ka ek aur khas ahd liya gaya tha jis ka bayan is aayat mein hai. Sadiqon se un ke sidq ka sawal ho, yani un se jo ahadees-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) pahunchane wale thay. Un ki ummaton mein se jo bhi un ko na maane use sakht azab hoga. Ae Allah! Tu gawah reh, hamari gawahi hai, hum dil se maante hain ke beshak tere Rasoolon ne tera paigham tere bandon ko bila kam-o-kast pahuncha diya. Unhon ne poori khair-khwahi ki aur haq ko saaf taur par numaya tareeqe se wazeh kar diya jis mein koi poshidgi, koi shuba, kisi tarah ka shak na raha, go badnaseeb ziddi jhagralu logon ne unhein na maana. Hamara iman hai ke tere Rasoolon ki tamam baatein sach aur haq hain aur jis ne un ki raah na pakdi woh gumrah aur batil par hai.))

Kya achha hota ke tu ne in sab ko barabar hi rakha hota." Allah Ta'ala Azz-o-Jal Jalaluhu ne farmaya ke yeh is liye hai ke mera shukr ada kiya jaye. In mein jo Anbiya-e-Kiram (Alaihimas Salam) thay unhein bhi aap ne dekha, woh roshni ke manind numaya thay, un par noor baras raha tha. Un se nabuwwat-o-risalat ka ek aur khas ahd liya gaya tha jis ka bayan is aayat mein hai. Sadiqon se un ke sidq ka sawal ho, yani un se jo ahadees-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) pahunchane wale thay. Un ki ummaton mein se jo bhi un ko na maane use sakht azab hoga. Ae Allah! Tu gawah reh, hamari gawahi hai, hum dil se maante hain ke beshak tere Rasoolon ne tera paigham tere bandon ko bila kam-o-kast pahuncha diya. Unhon ne poori khair-khwahi ki aur haq ko saaf taur par numaya tareeqe se wazeh kar diya jis mein koi poshidgi, koi shuba, kisi tarah ka shak na raha, go badnaseeb ziddi jhagralu logon ne unhein na maana. Hamara iman hai ke tere Rasoolon ki tamam baatein sach aur haq hain aur jis ne un ki raah na pakdi woh gumrah aur batil par hai.))

Ghazwa-e-Khandaq aur Musalmanon ki khasta haali:
Jang-e-Khandaq mein jo san 5 hijri mah-e-Shawwal mein hui thi, Allah Ta'ala ne mominon par jo apna fazl-o-ehsan kiya tha, uska bayan ho raha hai. Jabki mushrikeen ne poori taqat se aur poore ittehad se Musalmanon ko mita dene ke irade se zabardast lashkar lekar hamla kiya tha. Baaz log kehte hain jang-e-Khandaq san 4 hijri mein hui thi.

Is ladaai ka qissa yeh hai ke Banu Nazir ke yahudi sardaron ne, jin mein Salam bin Abu Haqeeq, Salam bin Mushkam, Kinana bin Rabee' wagera the, Makkah mein akar Quraishiyon ko, jo awwal hi se tayyar the, Huzoor ﷺ se ladaai karne par amada kiya aur un se ahd kiya ke hum apne zair-e-asar logon ke sath aap ki jama'at mein shamil hain. Unhein amada karke yeh log qabila Ghatafan ke paas gaye, un se bhi saaz-baaz karke apne sath shamil kar liya. Quraishiyon ne bhi idhar udhar phir kar tamam Arab mein aag laga kar sab gire-pade logon ko bhi sath mila liya. In sab ka sardar Abu Sufyan Sakhar bin Harb bana aur Ghatafan ka sardar Uyaina bin Hisn bin Badr muqarrar hua. In logon ne koshish karke das hazaar ka lashkar ikhatta kar liya aur Madine ki taraf chadh daude.

Huzoor ﷺ ko jab is lashkar-kashi ki khabrein pahunchin, to aap ne ba-mashwara Hazrat Salman Farsi ؓ Madine Sharif ki mashriqi samt mein khanday ya'ni khaayi khudwai. Is khanday ke khodne mein tamam Sahaba Muhajireen-o-Ansar ؓ shamil the aur khud aap bhi ba-nafs-e-nafees is ke khodne aur mitti dhone mein bhi hissa lete the. Mushrikeen ka lashkar bila-muzahamat Madine Sharif tak pahunch gaya aur Madine ke mashriqi hisse mein Uhad Pahar ke mutassil apna padaav jamaya. Yeh tha Madine ka neecha hissa, upar ke hisse mein unhon ne apni ek badi bhaari jam'iyat bhej di jis ne a'ali Madina mein lashkar ka padaav dala aur neeche upar se Musalmanon ko mahsoor kar liya.

Huzoor ﷺ apne sath ke Sahaba ko, jo teen hazaar se neeche the aur baaz riwayat mein hai ke sirf saat sau the, lekar un ke muqable par aaye. Sal'ah pahaari ko aap ne apni pusht par kiya aur dushmano ki taraf mutawajje hokar fauj ko tarteeb diya. Khandaq jo aap ne khodi aur khudwai thi, us mein pani wagera na tha, woh sirf ek gadha tha jo mushrikeen ke rele ko be-rok aane nahi deta tha. Aap ne bachon aur aurton ko Madine ke ek mahalle mein kar diya tha.

Yahudiyon ki ek jama'at Banu Quraiza Madine mein thi, mashriqi janib un ka mahalla tha. Nabi ﷺ se un ka muahida mazboot tha, un ka bhi bada giroh tha, taqreeban aath sau jangju ladne ke qabil maidan mein maujood the. Mushrikeen aur yahud ne un ke paas Huyayy bin Akhtab Nazri ko bheja, us ne unhein bhi sheeshe mein utar kar sabz bagh dikhla kar apni taraf kar liya aur unhon ne bhi theek mauqe par Musalmanon ke sath bad-ahdi ki aur a'laniya taur par sulah tod di.

Baahar se das hazaar ka woh lashkar jo ghera daale pada hai, andar se in yahudiyon ki baghawat jo baghli phode ki tarah uth khadi hui. Musalman battis dantron mein zabaan ya aate mein namak ki tarah ho gaye. Yeh kul saat sau aadmi kar hi kya sakte the.

Yeh waqt tha jis ka naqsha Quran-e-Kareem ne khincha hai ke aankhein pathra gayin, dil ulat gaye, tarah tarah ke khayalat aane lage. Jhanjhor diye gaye aur sakht imtihan mein mubtala ho gaye. Mahina bhar tak muhasray ki yehi talkh soorat qayim rahi, go mushrikeen ki yeh jurrat to nahi hui ke khandaq se paar ho kar dasti larai larte, lekin haan gheera dale pare rahe aur musalmanon ko tang kar diya. Albatta Amr bin Abd-e-Wud Aamiri jo Arab ka mashhoor shujaa pehlwan ko lekar khandaq se apne ghoron ko kooda laya. Yeh haal dekh kar Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apne sawaron ki taraf ishara kiya lekin kaha jata hai ke unhein tayyar na paakar Aap ne Hazrat Ali R.A ko hukam diya ke tum is ke muqabale par jao. Aap gaye, thori der tak to dono bahaduron mein talwar chalti rahi lekin bil-akhir Hazrat Ali R.A ne kufr ke is deo ko teh-e-tegh kiya jis se musalman bohat khush hue aur unhon ne samajh liya ke fateh hamari hai. Phir Parwardigar ne woh tund-o-tez aandhi bheji ke mushrikeen ke tamam khaime ukhad gaye, koi cheez qareene se na rahi, aag ka jalana mushkil ho gaya, koi jaye panah nazar na aayi, bil-akhir tang aa kar namuradi se wapas hue. Jis ka bayan is ayat mein hai. Jis hawa ka is ayat mein zikr hai, ba-qaul Mujahid Rahimahullah yeh saba hawaon se halak kiye gaye thay. Ikramah farmate hain janubi hawa ne shamali hawa se is jang-e-ahzab mein kaha ke chal hum tum jaakar Rasool Allah ﷺ ki madad karein, to shamali hawa ne kaha ke gahmi raat ko nahi chalati. Phir un par saba hawa bheji gayi. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A farmate hain mujhe mere mamoon Hazrat Usman bin Maz'oon R.A ne khandaq wali raat sakht jare aur tez hawa mein Madina Shareef bheja ke khana aur lihaf le aaon. Maine Huzoor se ijazat chahi to Aap ne ijazat marhamat farmai aur irshad farmaya ke mere jo sahabi tumhein mile unhein kehna ke mere paas chale aayein. Ab main chala, hawayein zanaate ki shain shain chal rahi theen. Mujhe jo musalman mila maine use Huzoor ﷺ ka paigham diya aur jis ne suna ulte paon furan Huzoor ki taraf chal diya yahan tak ke un mein se kisi ne peeche mur kar bhi na dekha. Hawa meri dhaal ko dhakke de rahi thi aur woh mujhe lag rahi thi yahan tak ke is ka loha mere paon par gir pada jise maine phenk diya. Is hawa ke sath hi sath Allah Ta'ala ne farishte bhi nazil farmaye thay jinhon ne mushrikeen ke dil aur seene khof aur roab se bhar diye. Yahan tak ke jitne sardaran-e-lashkar thay apne matehat sipahiyon ko apne paas bula bula kar kehne lage najat ki soorat talash karo. Bachao ka intzaam karo. Yeh tha farishton ka dala hua roab aur yehi woh lashkar hai jis ka bayan is ayat mein hai ke is lashkar ko tum ne nahi dekha. Hazrat Huzaifa bin Yaman R.A se ek nojawan shakhs ne jo Kufe ke rehne wale thay kaha ke اے Abu Abdullah tum bare khush naseeb ho ke tum ne Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ko dekha aur Aap ki majlis mein baithe, batao tum kya karte thay? Hazrat Huzaifa ne farmaya Wallah hum jaan nisariyan karte thay.

Naujawan farmane lage suniye chacha agar hum Huzoor ﷺ ke zamane ko pate toh wallah aap ko qadam bhi zameen par na rakhne dete apni gardanon par utha kar le jaate. Aap ne farmaya bhatije lo ek waqya suno Jang-e-Khandaq ke mauqe par Rasool Allah ﷺ bari raat tak namaz parhte rahe. Farigh ho kar daryaft farmaya ke koi hai jo ja kar lashkar-e-kuffar ki khabar laye? Allah ke Nabi ﷺ us se shart karte hain ke woh jannat mein dakhil hoga. Koi khara na hua kyunke khof ki, bhook ki aur sardi ki inteha thi. Par aap der tak namaz parhte rahe. Phir farmaya koi hai jo ja kar yeh khabar laye ke mukhalifein ne kya kiya? Allah ke Rasool ﷺ use mutmain karte hain ke woh zaroor wapas aayega aur meri dua hai ke Allah Ta'ala use jannat mein mera rafiq kare. Ab ke bhi koi khara na hua aur khara hota kaise? Bhook ke maare pait kamar se lag raha tha, sardi ke maare daant baj rahe the, khof ke maare patte pani ho rahe the. Bilakhir mera naam le kar Rasool Allah ﷺ ne aawaz di ab toh be-khare hue chara nahi tha. Farmane lage Huzaifa tu ja aur dekh ke woh us waqt kya kar rahe hain dekh jab tak mere pas wapas na pahunch jaye koi naya kaam na karna main ne bohat khoob keh kar apni raah li aur jurrat ke sath mushrikon mein ghus gaya wahan ja kar ajeeb haal dekha ke dikhai na dene wale Allah ke lashkar apna kaam phurti se kar rahe hain. Chulhon par se degen hawa ne ulat di hain, khaimon ke choben ukhad gayi hain, aag jala nahi sakte. Koi cheez apne thikane nahi rahi usi waqt Abu Sufiyan khara huwa aur ba-aawaz-e-buland munadi ki ke aey Quraishiyon apne apne sathi se hoshiyar ho jao. Apne sathi ko dekh bhal lo aisa na ho koi ghair khara ho. Main ne yeh sunte hi mere pas jo ek Quraishi jawan tha uska hath pakar liya aur us se pucha tu kaun hai? Us ne kaha main fulaan bin fulaan hoon. Main ne kaha ab hoshiyar rehna. Phir Abu Sufiyan ne kaha Allah gawah hai hum us waqt kisi theharne ki jagah par nahi hain. Hamare maweshi hamare oont halak ho rahe hain. Banu Quraiza ne hum se wada khilafi ki us ne hume bari takleef pahunchai phir us hawa ne toh hume pareshan kar rakha hai hum khana nahi paka sakte aag tak nahi jala sakte khaime dere thehar nahi sakte. Main toh tang aa gaya hoon aur main ne toh irada kar liya hai ke wapas ho jaoon pas main tum sab ko hukum deta hoon ke wapas chalo. Itna kehte hi apne oont par jo zanu bandha huwa baitha tha charh gaya aur use mara woh teen paon se hi khara ho gaya phir uska paon khola. Us waqt aisa acha mauqa tha ke agar main chahta ek teer mein hi Abu Sufiyan ka kaam tamam kar deta lekin Rasool Allah ﷺ ne mujh se farma diya tha ke koi naya kaam na karna is liye main ne apne dil ko rok liya. Ab main wapsi loota aur apne lashkar mein aa gaya jab main pahuncha hoon toh main ne dekha Rasool Allah ﷺ ek chadar ko lapete hue jo aap ki kisi biwi sahiba ki thi namaz mein mashghool hain. Aap ne mujhe dekh kar dono pairon ke darmiyan bitha liya aur chadar mujhe bhi orha di.

phir ruku aur sajdah kiya aur main wahin wohi chadar odhe baitha raha jab aap farigh hue toh main ne sara waqiah bayan kiya. Quraishiyon ke wapas laut jaane ki khabar jab qabilah Ghatafan ko puchi toh unhon ne bhi saaman bandha aur wapas laut gaye aur riwayat mein Hazrat Huzaifah R.A farmate hain jab main chala toh bawajood karake ki sakht sardi ke qasam Allah ki mujhe yeh maloom hota tha ki goya main kisi garam hammam mein hoon. Is mein yeh bhi hai ki jab main lashkar-e-kuffar mein pahuncha hoon us waqt Abu Sufyan aag sulagaye hue tap raha tha main ne use dekh kar pehchan kar apna teer kamaan mein chadhaliya aur chahta tha ki chala dun aur bilkul zad mein tha namumkin tha ki mera nishana khali jaye lekin mujhe Rasool Allah ﷺ ka yeh farman yaad aagaya ki koi aisi harkat na karna ki woh chaukne ho kar bhadak jayein toh main ne apna iradah tark kardiya. Jab main wapas aaya us waqt bhi mujhe koi sardi mehsoos na hui balki yeh maloom ho raha tha ki goya main hammam mein chal raha hoon. Haan jab Huzoor ﷺ ke paas pahunch gaya bade zor ki sardi lagne lagi aur main kapkapane laga toh Huzoor ﷺ ne apni chadar mujh ko odhadi. Main jo odh kar leta toh mujhe neend aagayi aur subah tak pada sota raha subah khud Huzoor ﷺ ne khud mujhe yeh keh kar jagaya ki aae sone wale bedar hoja. Aur riwayat mein hai ki jab us tabi ne kaha ki kaash hum Rasool Allah ﷺ ko dekhte aur aap ke zamane ko pate toh Huzaifah R.A ne kaha kaash ke tum jaisa iman hamein naseeb ho taaki bawajood na dekhne ke poora aur pukhta aqeedah rakhte ho. Baradar-zadhe jo tamna karte ho yeh tamna hi hai na jaane tum hote toh kya karte? Hum par toh aise kathan waqt aaye hain. Yeh keh kar phir aap ne mundarja-bala Khandaq ki raat ka waqiah bayan kiya. Is mein yeh bhi hai ki hawa jhhadi aandhi ke sath barish bhi thi. Aur riwayat mein hai ki Hazrat Huzaifah R.A Huzoor ﷺ ke sath ke waqiyat ko bayan farma rahe the jo ahl-e-majlis ne kaha ki agar hum us waqt maujood hote toh yun aur yun karte is par aap ne yeh waqiah bayan farmadiya ki bahar se toh das hazar ka lashkar ghere hue hai andar se Banu Quraiza ke aath so yahudi bigde hue hain baal-bachche aur auratein Madine mein hain khatra laga hua hai agar Banu Quraiza ne us taraf ka rukh kiya toh ek saahat mein hi auraton bachon ka faisla kar denge. Wallah us raat jaisi khauf-o-haras ki halat kabhi hum par nahi guzri. Phir woh hawayein chalti hain, aandhiyan uthti hain, andhera chha jata hai, kadak garaj aur bijli hoti hai ki Al-Azmatullah. Sathi ko dekhna toh kahan apni ungliyan bhi nazar na aati thin. Jo munafiq hamare sath the woh ek ek ho kar yeh bahana bana kar hamare baal-bachche aur auratein wahan hain aur ghar ka nigehban koi nahi. Huzoor ﷺ se aa kar ijazat chahne lage aur aap ne bhi kisi ek ko na roka jis ne kaha ki main jaon? Aap ne farmaya shauq se jao. Woh ek ek ho kar sarkne lage aur hum sirf teen sau ke qareeb reh gaye.

Huzoor ﷺ ab tashreef laye, ek ek ko dekha, meri ajeeb halat thi, na mere pas dushman se bachne ke liye koi aala tha, na sardi se mehfooz rehne ke liye koi kapra tha. Sirf meri biwi ki ek chhoti si chadar thi jo mere ghutno tak bhi nahi pahunchti thi. Jab Huzoor ﷺ mere pas pahunche, us waqt main apne ghutno mein sar daale hue dabak kar baitha hua kapkapara tha. Aap ne pucha yeh kaun hain? Maine kaha Huzaifa. Farmaya Huzaifa sun! Wallah mujh par to zameen tang aagayi ke kahin Huzoor mujhe khada na karein, meri to dargat ho rahi hai, lekin karta kya, Huzoor ﷺ ka farman tha, maine kaha Huzoor ﷺ sun raha hoon, irshad? Aap ne farmaya, dushmano mein ek nayi baat hone wali hai, jao un ki khabar lao. Wallah us waqt mujh se zyada na to kisi ko khauf tha, na ghabrahat thi, na sardi thi, lekin Huzoor ﷺ ka hukm sunte hi khada hogaya aur chalne laga, to maine suna ke aap mere liye dua kar rahe hain ke 'Ae Allah! Us ke aage se, peechhe se, daayein se, baayein se, upar se, neeche se is ki hifazat kar.' Huzoor ﷺ ki is dua ke sath hi maine dekha ke kisi qism ka khauf, dar, dehshat mere dil mein thi hi nahi. Phir Huzoor ﷺ ne mujhe aawaz de kar farmaya, dekho Huzaifa! Wahan ja kar mere pas wapas aane tak koi nayi baat na karna. Is riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke main Abu Sufiyan ko is se pehle pehchanta na tha, main gaya to wahan yehi aawazein lag rahi thi ke chalo kooch karo, wapas chalo. Ek ajeeb baat maine yeh bhi dekhi ke woh khatarnak hawa jo degein ulat deti thi, woh sirf un ke lashkar ke ahata tak hi thi, wallah is se ek baalisht bhar bahar na thi. Maine dekhi ke patthar ur ur kar un par girte the. Jab main wapas chala hoon, to maine dekhi ke taqreeban bees sawar hain jo amaame bandhe hue hain, unhon ne mujh se farmaya, jao aur Rasoolullah ﷺ ko khabar do ke Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko kifayat kar di aur aap ke dushmano ko maat di. Is mein yeh bhi bayan hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ki aadat mein dakhil tha ke jab kabhi koi ghabrahat aur diqqat ka waqt hota, to aap namaz shuru kar dete. Jab maine Huzoor ﷺ ko khabar pahunchayi, usi waqt yeh aayat utri. 

Pas aayat mein neeche ki taraf se aane walo se murad Bani Quraiza hain. Shiddat-e-khauf aur sakht ghabrahat se aankhein ulat gayin aur dil halqum tak pahunch gaye the aur tarah tarah ke guman ho rahe the, yahan tak ke ba'z munafiqon ne samajh liya tha ke ab ki ladai mein kafir ghalib aajayenge, aam munafiqon ka to puchna hi kya hai? Mu'tib bin Qushair kehne laga ke An-Hazrat ﷺ to hamein keh rahe the ke hum Qais-o-Kisra ke khazano ke malik banenge aur yahan halat yeh hai ke paakhane ko jana bhi dho-bhar ho raha hai. Yeh mukhtalif guman mukhtalif logon ke the, musalman to yaqeen karte the ke ghalib hamara hi hai, jaisa ke farman hai: 
(Wa lamma ra'al-mu'minoonal-ahzaba qalu haza ma wa'adanal-lahu wa Rasooluhu wa sadaqal-lahu wa Rasooluhu wa ma zadahum illa imaman wa tasleema) (33:22).

(Al-Ahzab: 22) Lekin munafiqin kehte thay ke ab ki martaba saare musalman ma'an An-Hazrat gajar muli ki tarah kaat kar rakh diye jayenge. Sahaba R.A ne ain us ghabrahat aur pareshani ke waqt Rasoolullah ﷺ se kaha ke Huzoor ﷺ us waqt hamein is se bachao ki koi talqin karein. Aap ne farmaya yeh dua mango (Allahumma-stur 'auratina wa amin rou'atina) Allah hamari parda poshi kar, Allah hamare khauf-o-dar ko amn-o-aman se badal de. Idhar musalmanon ki yeh dua buland hui idhar Allah ka lashkar hawaon ki shakal mein aaya aur kafiroon ka tiya pancha kar diya, falhamdulillah.

Albatta Amr bin Abd-e-Wud Aamiri jo Arab ka mashhoor shujaa pehlwan ko lekar khandaq se apne ghoron ko kooda laya. Yeh haal dekh kar Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apne sawaron ki taraf ishara kiya lekin kaha jata hai ke unhein tayyar na paakar Aap ne Hazrat Ali R.A ko hukam diya ke tum is ke muqabale par jao. Aap gaye, thori der tak to dono bahaduron mein talwar chalti rahi lekin bil-akhir Hazrat Ali R.A ne kufr ke is deo ko teh-e-tegh kiya jis se musalman bohat khush hue aur unhon ne samajh liya ke fateh hamari hai. Phir Parwardigar ne woh tund-o-tez aandhi bheji ke mushrikeen ke tamam khaime ukhad gaye, koi cheez qareene se na rahi, aag ka jalana mushkil ho gaya, koi jaye panah nazar na aayi, bil-akhir tang aa kar namuradi se wapas hue. Jis ka bayan is ayat mein hai. Jis hawa ka is ayat mein zikr hai, ba-qaul Mujahid Rahimahullah yeh saba hawaon se halak kiye gaye thay. Ikramah farmate hain janubi hawa ne shamali hawa se is jang-e-ahzab mein kaha ke chal hum tum jaakar Rasool Allah ﷺ ki madad karein, to shamali hawa ne kaha ke gahmi raat ko nahi chalati. Phir un par saba hawa bheji gayi. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A farmate hain mujhe mere mamoon Hazrat Usman bin Maz'oon R.A ne khandaq wali raat sakht jare aur tez hawa mein Madina Shareef bheja ke khana aur lihaf le aaon. Maine Huzoor se ijazat chahi to Aap ne ijazat marhamat farmai aur irshad farmaya ke mere jo sahabi tumhein mile unhein kehna ke mere paas chale aayein. Ab main chala, hawayein zanaate ki shain shain chal rahi theen. Mujhe jo musalman mila maine use Huzoor ﷺ ka paigham diya aur jis ne suna ulte paon furan Huzoor ki taraf chal diya yahan tak ke un mein se kisi ne peeche mur kar bhi na dekha. Hawa meri dhaal ko dhakke de rahi thi aur woh mujhe lag rahi thi yahan tak ke is ka loha mere paon par gir pada jise maine phenk diya. Is hawa ke sath hi sath Allah Ta'ala ne farishte bhi nazil farmaye thay jinhon ne mushrikeen ke dil aur seene khof aur roab se bhar diye. Yahan tak ke jitne sardaran-e-lashkar thay apne matehat sipahiyon ko apne paas bula bula kar kehne lage najat ki soorat talash karo. Bachao ka intzaam karo. Yeh tha farishton ka dala hua roab aur yehi woh lashkar hai jis ka bayan is ayat mein hai ke is lashkar ko tum ne nahi dekha. Hazrat Huzaifa bin Yaman R.A se ek nojawan shakhs ne jo Kufe ke rehne wale thay kaha ke اے Abu Abdullah tum bare khush naseeb ho ke tum ne Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ko dekha aur Aap ki majlis mein baithe, batao tum kya karte thay? Hazrat Huzaifa ne farmaya Wallah hum jaan nisariyan karte thay.

Naujawan farmane lage suniye chacha agar hum Huzoor ﷺ ke zamane ko pate toh wallah aap ko qadam bhi zameen par na rakhne dete apni gardanon par utha kar le jaate. Aap ne farmaya bhatije lo ek waqya suno Jang-e-Khandaq ke mauqe par Rasool Allah ﷺ bari raat tak namaz parhte rahe. Farigh ho kar daryaft farmaya ke koi hai jo ja kar lashkar-e-kuffar ki khabar laye? Allah ke Nabi ﷺ us se shart karte hain ke woh jannat mein dakhil hoga. Koi khara na hua kyunke khof ki, bhook ki aur sardi ki inteha thi. Par aap der tak namaz parhte rahe. Phir farmaya koi hai jo ja kar yeh khabar laye ke mukhalifein ne kya kiya? Allah ke Rasool ﷺ use mutmain karte hain ke woh zaroor wapas aayega aur meri dua hai ke Allah Ta'ala use jannat mein mera rafiq kare. Ab ke bhi koi khara na hua aur khara hota kaise? Bhook ke maare pait kamar se lag raha tha, sardi ke maare daant baj rahe the, khof ke maare patte pani ho rahe the. Bilakhir mera naam le kar Rasool Allah ﷺ ne aawaz di ab toh be-khare hue chara nahi tha. Farmane lage Huzaifa tu ja aur dekh ke woh us waqt kya kar rahe hain dekh jab tak mere pas wapas na pahunch jaye koi naya kaam na karna main ne bohat khoob keh kar apni raah li aur jurrat ke sath mushrikon mein ghus gaya wahan ja kar ajeeb haal dekha ke dikhai na dene wale Allah ke lashkar apna kaam phurti se kar rahe hain. Chulhon par se degen hawa ne ulat di hain, khaimon ke choben ukhad gayi hain, aag jala nahi sakte. Koi cheez apne thikane nahi rahi usi waqt Abu Sufiyan khara huwa aur ba-aawaz-e-buland munadi ki ke aey Quraishiyon apne apne sathi se hoshiyar ho jao. Apne sathi ko dekh bhal lo aisa na ho koi ghair khara ho. Main ne yeh sunte hi mere pas jo ek Quraishi jawan tha uska hath pakar liya aur us se pucha tu kaun hai? Us ne kaha main fulaan bin fulaan hoon. Main ne kaha ab hoshiyar rehna. Phir Abu Sufiyan ne kaha Allah gawah hai hum us waqt kisi theharne ki jagah par nahi hain. Hamare maweshi hamare oont halak ho rahe hain. Banu Quraiza ne hum se wada khilafi ki us ne hume bari takleef pahunchai phir us hawa ne toh hume pareshan kar rakha hai hum khana nahi paka sakte aag tak nahi jala sakte khaime dere thehar nahi sakte. Main toh tang aa gaya hoon aur main ne toh irada kar liya hai ke wapas ho jaoon pas main tum sab ko hukum deta hoon ke wapas chalo. Itna kehte hi apne oont par jo zanu bandha huwa baitha tha charh gaya aur use mara woh teen paon se hi khara ho gaya phir uska paon khola. Us waqt aisa acha mauqa tha ke agar main chahta ek teer mein hi Abu Sufiyan ka kaam tamam kar deta lekin Rasool Allah ﷺ ne mujh se farma diya tha ke koi naya kaam na karna is liye main ne apne dil ko rok liya. Ab main wapsi loota aur apne lashkar mein aa gaya jab main pahuncha hoon toh main ne dekha Rasool Allah ﷺ ek chadar ko lapete hue jo aap ki kisi biwi sahiba ki thi namaz mein mashghool hain. Aap ne mujhe dekh kar dono pairon ke darmiyan bitha liya aur chadar mujhe bhi orha di.

phir ruku aur sajdah kiya aur main wahin wohi chadar odhe baitha raha jab aap farigh hue toh main ne sara waqiah bayan kiya. Quraishiyon ke wapas laut jaane ki khabar jab qabilah Ghatafan ko puchi toh unhon ne bhi saaman bandha aur wapas laut gaye aur riwayat mein Hazrat Huzaifah R.A farmate hain jab main chala toh bawajood karake ki sakht sardi ke qasam Allah ki mujhe yeh maloom hota tha ki goya main kisi garam hammam mein hoon. Is mein yeh bhi hai ki jab main lashkar-e-kuffar mein pahuncha hoon us waqt Abu Sufyan aag sulagaye hue tap raha tha main ne use dekh kar pehchan kar apna teer kamaan mein chadhaliya aur chahta tha ki chala dun aur bilkul zad mein tha namumkin tha ki mera nishana khali jaye lekin mujhe Rasool Allah ﷺ ka yeh farman yaad aagaya ki koi aisi harkat na karna ki woh chaukne ho kar bhadak jayein toh main ne apna iradah tark kardiya. Jab main wapas aaya us waqt bhi mujhe koi sardi mehsoos na hui balki yeh maloom ho raha tha ki goya main hammam mein chal raha hoon. Haan jab Huzoor ﷺ ke paas pahunch gaya bade zor ki sardi lagne lagi aur main kapkapane laga toh Huzoor ﷺ ne apni chadar mujh ko odhadi. Main jo odh kar leta toh mujhe neend aagayi aur subah tak pada sota raha subah khud Huzoor ﷺ ne khud mujhe yeh keh kar jagaya ki aae sone wale bedar hoja. Aur riwayat mein hai ki jab us tabi ne kaha ki kaash hum Rasool Allah ﷺ ko dekhte aur aap ke zamane ko pate toh Huzaifah R.A ne kaha kaash ke tum jaisa iman hamein naseeb ho taaki bawajood na dekhne ke poora aur pukhta aqeedah rakhte ho. Baradar-zadhe jo tamna karte ho yeh tamna hi hai na jaane tum hote toh kya karte? Hum par toh aise kathan waqt aaye hain. Yeh keh kar phir aap ne mundarja-bala Khandaq ki raat ka waqiah bayan kiya. Is mein yeh bhi hai ki hawa jhhadi aandhi ke sath barish bhi thi. Aur riwayat mein hai ki Hazrat Huzaifah R.A Huzoor ﷺ ke sath ke waqiyat ko bayan farma rahe the jo ahl-e-majlis ne kaha ki agar hum us waqt maujood hote toh yun aur yun karte is par aap ne yeh waqiah bayan farmadiya ki bahar se toh das hazar ka lashkar ghere hue hai andar se Banu Quraiza ke aath so yahudi bigde hue hain baal-bachche aur auratein Madine mein hain khatra laga hua hai agar Banu Quraiza ne us taraf ka rukh kiya toh ek saahat mein hi auraton bachon ka faisla kar denge. Wallah us raat jaisi khauf-o-haras ki halat kabhi hum par nahi guzri. Phir woh hawayein chalti hain, aandhiyan uthti hain, andhera chha jata hai, kadak garaj aur bijli hoti hai ki Al-Azmatullah. Sathi ko dekhna toh kahan apni ungliyan bhi nazar na aati thin. Jo munafiq hamare sath the woh ek ek ho kar yeh bahana bana kar hamare baal-bachche aur auratein wahan hain aur ghar ka nigehban koi nahi. Huzoor ﷺ se aa kar ijazat chahne lage aur aap ne bhi kisi ek ko na roka jis ne kaha ki main jaon? Aap ne farmaya shauq se jao. Woh ek ek ho kar sarkne lage aur hum sirf teen sau ke qareeb reh gaye.

Huzoor ﷺ ab tashreef laye, ek ek ko dekha, meri ajeeb halat thi, na mere pas dushman se bachne ke liye koi aala tha, na sardi se mehfooz rehne ke liye koi kapra tha. Sirf meri biwi ki ek chhoti si chadar thi jo mere ghutno tak bhi nahi pahunchti thi. Jab Huzoor ﷺ mere pas pahunche, us waqt main apne ghutno mein sar daale hue dabak kar baitha hua kapkapara tha. Aap ne pucha yeh kaun hain? Maine kaha Huzaifa. Farmaya Huzaifa sun! Wallah mujh par to zameen tang aagayi ke kahin Huzoor mujhe khada na karein, meri to dargat ho rahi hai, lekin karta kya, Huzoor ﷺ ka farman tha, maine kaha Huzoor ﷺ sun raha hoon, irshad? Aap ne farmaya, dushmano mein ek nayi baat hone wali hai, jao un ki khabar lao. Wallah us waqt mujh se zyada na to kisi ko khauf tha, na ghabrahat thi, na sardi thi, lekin Huzoor ﷺ ka hukm sunte hi khada hogaya aur chalne laga, to maine suna ke aap mere liye dua kar rahe hain ke 'Ae Allah! Us ke aage se, peechhe se, daayein se, baayein se, upar se, neeche se is ki hifazat kar.' Huzoor ﷺ ki is dua ke sath hi maine dekha ke kisi qism ka khauf, dar, dehshat mere dil mein thi hi nahi. Phir Huzoor ﷺ ne mujhe aawaz de kar farmaya, dekho Huzaifa! Wahan ja kar mere pas wapas aane tak koi nayi baat na karna. Is riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke main Abu Sufiyan ko is se pehle pehchanta na tha, main gaya to wahan yehi aawazein lag rahi thi ke chalo kooch karo, wapas chalo. Ek ajeeb baat maine yeh bhi dekhi ke woh khatarnak hawa jo degein ulat deti thi, woh sirf un ke lashkar ke ahata tak hi thi, wallah is se ek baalisht bhar bahar na thi. Maine dekhi ke patthar ur ur kar un par girte the. Jab main wapas chala hoon, to maine dekhi ke taqreeban bees sawar hain jo amaame bandhe hue hain, unhon ne mujh se farmaya, jao aur Rasoolullah ﷺ ko khabar do ke Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko kifayat kar di aur aap ke dushmano ko maat di. Is mein yeh bhi bayan hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ki aadat mein dakhil tha ke jab kabhi koi ghabrahat aur diqqat ka waqt hota, to aap namaz shuru kar dete. Jab maine Huzoor ﷺ ko khabar pahunchayi, usi waqt yeh aayat utri. 

Pas aayat mein neeche ki taraf se aane walo se murad Bani Quraiza hain. Shiddat-e-khauf aur sakht ghabrahat se aankhein ulat gayin aur dil halqum tak pahunch gaye the aur tarah tarah ke guman ho rahe the, yahan tak ke ba'z munafiqon ne samajh liya tha ke ab ki ladai mein kafir ghalib aajayenge, aam munafiqon ka to puchna hi kya hai? Mu'tib bin Qushair kehne laga ke An-Hazrat ﷺ to hamein keh rahe the ke hum Qais-o-Kisra ke khazano ke malik banenge aur yahan halat yeh hai ke paakhane ko jana bhi dho-bhar ho raha hai. Yeh mukhtalif guman mukhtalif logon ke the, musalman to yaqeen karte the ke ghalib hamara hi hai, jaisa ke farman hai: 
(Wa lamma ra'al-mu'minoonal-ahzaba qalu haza ma wa'adanal-lahu wa Rasooluhu wa sadaqal-lahu wa Rasooluhu wa ma zadahum illa imaman wa tasleema) (33:22).

(Al-Ahzab: 22) Lekin munafiqin kehte thay ke ab ki martaba saare musalman ma'an An-Hazrat gajar muli ki tarah kaat kar rakh diye jayenge. Sahaba R.A ne ain us ghabrahat aur pareshani ke waqt Rasoolullah ﷺ se kaha ke Huzoor ﷺ us waqt hamein is se bachao ki koi talqin karein. Aap ne farmaya yeh dua mango (Allahumma-stur 'auratina wa amin rou'atina) Allah hamari parda poshi kar, Allah hamare khauf-o-dar ko amn-o-aman se badal de. Idhar musalmanon ki yeh dua buland hui idhar Allah ka lashkar hawaon ki shakal mein aaya aur kafiroon ka tiya pancha kar diya, falhamdulillah.

Munafiqon ka farar is ghabrahat aur pareshani ka haal bayaan ho raha hai jo Jang-e-Ahzab ke mauqe par Musalmanon ki thi ke bahar se dushman apni poori quwwat aur kafi lashkar se ghera daale khara hai. Androon-e-shehar mein baghawat ki aag bharki hui hai, yahoodiyon ne daf'atan sulah tod kar be-chaini ki baatein bana rahe hain, keh rahe hain ke bas Allah ke aur Rasool ﷺ ke waade dekh liye. Kuch log hain jo ek dusre ke kaan mein soor phonk rahe hain ke miyan pagal hue ho? Dekh nahi rahe do ghari mein naqsha palatne wala hai. Bhaag chalo, loto-loto, wapas chalo. 

Yathrib se murad Madina hai. Jaise sahih hadith mein hai ke mujhe khwab mein tumhari hijrat ki jagah dikhayi gayi hai, jo do sanglakh maidaanon ke darmiyan hai. Pehle to mera khayal hua tha ke yeh Hajar hai lekin nahi, woh jagah Yathrib hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke woh jagah Madina hai. Albatta yeh khayal rahe ke ek zaeef hadith mein hai ke jo Madine ko Yathrib kahe woh istighfar kar le. Madina to Taba hai, woh Taba hai. Yeh hadith sirf Musnad Ahmad mein hai aur iski asnad mein zof hai. 

Kaha gaya hai ke Amaliq mein se jo shakhs yahan aakar thehra tha, uska naam Yathrib bin Ubaid bin Mahla Beel bin Aus bin Amlaq bin Laad bin Adam bin Sam bin Nuh tha, isliye is shehar ko bhi usi ke naam se mashhoor kiya gaya. Yeh bhi qaul hai ke Taurat shareef mein iske gyarah naam aaye hain: Madina, Taba, Jalila, Jabira, Mahba, Mahbooba, Qasma, Majboora, Adrad, Marhooma. 

Ka'b Ahbar (Rahimahullah) farmate hain ke hum Taurat mein yeh ibarat pate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne Madina shareef se farmaya: Aye Tayyaba aur aye Taba aur aye Maskina khazanon mein mubtala na ho, tamam bastiyon par tera darja buland hoga. 

Kuch log to is mauqe Khandaq par kehne lage yahan Huzoor ﷺ ke paas thehrne ki jagah nahi, apne gharo ko laut chalo. Banu Haritha kehne lage, Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Hamare gharon mein chori hone ka khatra hai, woh khali pade hain, hamein wapas jaane ki ijazat milni chahiye. Aus bin Qainti ne bhi yahi kaha tha ke hamare gharon mein dushman ke ghus jaane ka andesha hai, hamein jaane ki ijazat dijiye. Allah Ta'ala ne unke dil ki baat batla di ke yeh to dhong rachaya hai, haqeeqat mein uzr kuch bhi nahi, namardi se bhagoda pan dikhate hain. Ladhai se ji chura kar sarakna chahte hain.

Jihad se peeth pherne walon se baaz-purs hogi. Jo log yeh uzr karke Jihad se bhaag rahe thay ke hamare ghar akele pade hain jiska bayaan oopar guzra, unki nisbat Janab-e-Bari farmata hai ke agar un par dushman Madina ke chau taraf se aur har har rukh se aa jaye phir unse kufr mein dakhil hone ka sawal kiya jaye toh yeh be-tammul kufr ko qabool kar lenge lekin thode khouf aur khayali dehshat ki bina par Imaan se dast-bardari kar rahe hain. Yeh unki muzammat bayaan hui hai. Phir farmata hai, yahi toh hain jo isse pehle lambi lambi dingein marte thay ke khwah kuch hi kyun na ho jaye hum maidan-e-jang se peeth pherne wale nahi. Kya yeh nahi jaante ke yeh jo waade unhon ne Allah Ta'ala se kiye thay, Allah Ta'ala unki baaz-purs karega. Phir irshad hota hai ke yeh maut-o-fout se bhagna, ladaai se munh chhupana, maidan mein peeth dikhana jaan nahi bacha sakta balke bahut mumkin hai ke Allah Ta'ala ki achanak pakar ke jald aa jaane ka baais ho jaye aur duniya ka thoda sa nafa bhi hasil na ho sake. Halanki duniya toh aakhirat jaisi baaqi cheez ke muqable par kul ki kul haqeer aur mahz na-cheez hai. Phir farmaya ke bajuz Allah ke koi na de sake, na dilasake, na madadgari kar sake, na himayat par aske. Allah apne iradon ko poora karke hi rehta hai.

Jihad se peeth pherne walon se baaz-purs hogi. Jo log yeh uzr karke Jihad se bhaag rahe thay ke hamare ghar akele pade hain jiska bayaan oopar guzra, unki nisbat Janab-e-Bari farmata hai ke agar un par dushman Madina ke chau taraf se aur har har rukh se aa jaye phir unse kufr mein dakhil hone ka sawal kiya jaye toh yeh be-tammul kufr ko qabool kar lenge lekin thode khouf aur khayali dehshat ki bina par Imaan se dast-bardari kar rahe hain. Yeh unki muzammat bayaan hui hai. Phir farmata hai, yahi toh hain jo isse pehle lambi lambi dingein marte thay ke khwah kuch hi kyun na ho jaye hum maidan-e-jang se peeth pherne wale nahi. Kya yeh nahi jaante ke yeh jo waade unhon ne Allah Ta'ala se kiye thay, Allah Ta'ala unki baaz-purs karega. Jihad se munh modne wale iman se khali log Allah Ta'ala apne muheet ilm se unhein khoob jaanta hai jo doosron ko bhi jihad se rokte hain. Apne ham-sohbaton se, yaar-doston se, kunbe qabeele walon se kehte hain ke aao tum bhi hamare sath raho, apne gharon ko, apne aaram ko, apni zameen ko, apne biwi bachon ko na chodo. Khud bhi jihad mein aate nahi, yeh aur baat hai ke kisi kisi waqt munh dikha jayen aur naam likhwa jayen. Yeh bade bukhil hain, na inhein tumse koi madad pahunche, na inke dil mein tumhari hamdardi, na maal-e-ghanimat mein tumhare hisse par yeh khush. Khauf ke waqt toh in namardon ke haath ke tote ud jate hain. Aankhein chhaachh pani ho jati hain, mayusana nigahon se takne lagte hain. Lekin khauf door hua ke unhon ne lambi lambi zubanein nikal daali aur badhe chadhke dawe karne lage aur shujaat-o-muruwwat ka dam bharne lage. Aur maal-e-ghanimat par be-tarah girne lage. Hamein do, hamein do ka ghul macha dete hain. Hum aapke sathi hain. Humne jangi khidmat anjam di hain, hamara hissa hai. Aur jang ke waqt soortein bhi nahi dikhate, bhagton ke aage aur ladton ke peeche raha karte hain, dono ayeb jiske mein jama hon us jaisa be-khair insan aur kaun hoga? Amn ke waqt ayyari, bad-khulqi, bad-zubani aur ladai ke waqt namardi, rubah-bazi aur zanana pan. Ladai ke waqt haiza aurton ki tarah alag aur yaksu aur maal lene ke waqt gadhoon ki tarah dhainchu dhainchu. Allah farmata hai baat yeh hai ke inke dil shuru se hi iman se khali hain. Isliye inke amaal bhi akart hain. Allah par yeh aasan hai.

In ki buzdli aur darpok-i ka yeh aalam hai ki ab tak unhein is baat ka yaqeen hi nahi hua ki lashkar-e-kuffar laut gaya aur khatra hai ki woh phir kahin aa na padein. Mushrikein ke lashkaron ko dekhte hi chhake chhoot jaate hain aur kehte hain kaash ki hum musalmanon ke saath is shehar mein hi na hote balki ganwaron ke saath kisi ujaad gaon ya kisi door-daraaz ke jangal mein hote, kisi aate-jaate se pooch lete ki kaho bhai ladai ka kya hashar hua? Allah farmata hai yeh agar tumhare saath bhi hon toh bekaar hain. In ke dil murda hain, namardi ke ghan ne inhein khokhla kar rakha hai. Yeh kya ladein ge aur kaunsi bahaduri dikhayenge?

Thoos dalaail Ittiba'-e-Rasool ﷺ ko lazam qarar dete hain. Yeh ayat bahut bari daleel hai is amr par ke An-Hazrat ﷺ ke tamam aqwal, af'al, ahwal, iqtida, pairoviyo aur tabedari ke laaiq hain. Jang-e-Ahzab mein jo sabr-o-tammul aur adeem-ul-misaal shujaat ki misal Huzoor ﷺ ne qaaim ki, misal ke taur par rah-e-Ilah ki tayari, shauq-e-jihad aur sakhti ke waqt bhi Rab se asani ki ummeed is waqt ap ne dikhai, yaqee-nan yeh tamam cheezein is qabil hain ke musalman unhein apni zindagi ka juz-o-azam bana lein aur apne pyare paighambar Allah ke habib Ahmad Mujtaba Muhammad Mustafa ﷺ ko apne liye behtareen namuna bana lein aur in ausaf se apne taiin bhi mausoof karein. Isi liye Quran-e-Kareem un logon ko jo us waqt sat-pata rahe thay aur ghabrahat aur pareshani ka izhar karte thay farmata hai ke tum ne mere Nabi ﷺ ki tabedari kyun na ki? Mere Rasool toh tum mein maujood thay, un ka namuna tumhare samne tha, tumhein sabr-o-istiqlal ki na sirf talqeen thi balki sabit-qadmi, istiqlal aur itminan ka pahar tumhari nigaahon ke samne tha. Tum jabke Allah par, Qayamat par iman rakhte ho, phir koi wajah na thi ke tum apne Rasool ko apne liye namuna aur nazeer na qaaim karte? 

Phir Allah ki fauj ke sachhe momino ko Huzoor ﷺ ke sachhe sathiyon ki iman ki pukhtagi bayan ho rahi hai ke unhon ne jab tiddi dal lashkar-e-kuffar ko dekha toh pehli nigaah mein hi bol uthe ke unhi par fatah pane ki humein khushkhabri di gayi hai. Un hi ki shikast ka hum se wada hua hai aur wada bhi kis ka? Allah ka aur us ke Rasool ka. Aur yeh namumkin mahz hai ke Allah aur Rasool ﷺ ka wada ghalat ho, yaqee-nan hamara sar aur is jang ki fatah ka sehra hoga. Un ke is kamil yaqeen aur sachhe iman ko Rab ne bhi dekh liya aur dunya-o-akhirat mein anjam ki behtari unhein ata farmai. 

Bahut mumkin hai ke Allah ke jis wade ki taraf is mein ishara hai woh ayat yeh ho jo Surah Al-Baqarah mein guzar chuki hai (Balki Surah Al-Ankabut ki ayat hai): 
Ahasiban-nasu an yutruku an yaqulu amanna wa hum la yuftanoon (Surah (Al-Ankabut: 2). 
Ya'ni kya tum ne yeh samajh liya? Ke baghair is ke ke tumhari aazmaish ho tum jannat mein chale jaoge? Tum se agle logon ki aazmaish bhi hui, unhein bhi dukh dard, larai-bharai mein mubtala kiya gaya yahan tak ke unhein hilaya gaya ke imandar aur khud Rasool ki zaban se nikal gaya ke Allah ki madad ko der kyun lag gayi? Yaad rakho Rab ki madad bahut hi qareeb hai, ya'ni yeh sirf imtehan hai, idhar tum ne sabit-qadmi dikhai idhar Rab ki madad aayi. 

Allah aur uska Rasool ﷺ sachha hai, farmata hai ke in ashab par Rasool ﷺ ka iman apne mukhalifein ki is qadr zabardast jammiyat dekh kar aur barh gaya. Yeh apne iman mein, apni tasleem mein aur barh gaye. Yaqeen-e-kamil ho gaya, farmanbardari aur barh gayi. Is ayat mein daleel hai iman ki ziyadati hone par, ba-nisbat auron ke un ke iman ke qawi hone par. Jamhoor Aimma-e-Kiram ka bhi yahi farman hai ke iman barhta aur ghatta hai. Hum ne bhi is ki taqreer Sharh-e-Bukhari ke shuru mein kar di hai, wa lillahil-hamd wal-minnah.

Pas farmata hai ki us ki tangi turshi ne us sakhti aur tang haali ne us haal aur us naqsha ne un ka jo iman Allah par tha use aur barha diya aur jo taslim ki kho un mein thi ki Allah Rasool ki baatein mana karte the aur un par amil the us ita'at mein aur barh gaye.)
