Us din momino aur kuffaar mein farq wazeh ho gaya, munafiqon ka zikr oopar guzar chuka hai ke waqt se pehle toh jaan-nisari ke lambe chaude daaway karte thay lekin waqt aane par poore buzdil aur namard sabit hue, saare daaway aur waade dhare ke dhare reh gaye aur bajaye sabit-qadami ke peeth mod kar bhaag khade hue. Saare daaway aur waade dhare ke dhare reh gaye aur bajaye sabit-qadami ke peeth mod kar bhaag khade hue. Yahan momino ka zikr ho raha hai ke unhon ne apne waade poore kar dikhaye. Baaz ne jaam-e-shahadat nosh farmaya aur baaz us ke nazaare mein be-chain hain. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Hazrat Sabit (R.A) farmate hain ke jab hum ne Quran likhna shuru kiya toh ek aayat mujhe nahi milti thi halanki Surah Ahzaab mein woh aayat main ne khud Rasulullah ﷺ ki zabaan-e-mubarak se suni thi. Aakhir Hazrat Khuzaimah bin Sabit Ansari (R.A) ke pas yeh aayat mili, yeh woh sahabi hain jin ki akele ki gawahi ko Rasul-e-Kareem alaih-afdal-us-salawati-wat-tasleem ne do gawahon ke baraabar kar diya tha. Woh aayat (Min-al-mu'minina rijalun sadaqu ma 'ahad-ullaha 'alaihi faminhum man qada nahbahu wa minhum man yantaziru wa ma baddalu tabdila) (Al-Ahzaab: 23) hai. Yeh aayat Hazrat Anas bin Nazir (R.A) ke baare mein nazil hui hai. Waqia yeh hai ke jang-e-badr mein shareek nahi hue thay jis ka unhe saqt afsos tha ke sab se pehli jang mein jis mein khud Rasulullah ﷺ ba-nafs-e-nafees shareek thay main shamil na ho saka, ab jo jihad ka mauqa aayega main Allah Ta'ala ko apni sachai dikha dunga aur yeh bhi ke main kya karta hoon? Is se zyada kehte hue khauf khaya. Ab jang-e-uhud ka mauqa aaya toh unhon ne dekha ke samne se Hazrat Sa'd bin Mu'aaz (R.A) wapas aa rahe hain, unhe dekh kar taajjub se farmaya ke Abu Amr kahan ja rahe ho? Wallah mujhe Uhud pahad ke is taraf se jannat ki khushbooyein aa rahi hain. Yeh kehte hi aap aage badhe aur mushrikon mein khoob talwar chalayi. Chunke musalman laut gaye thay yeh tanha the, unke be-panah hamlon ne kuffaar ke daant khatte kar diye thay aur kuffaar ladte ladte un ki taraf badhe aur chaaron taraf se gher liya aur shaheed kar diya. Aap ko (80) assi se oopar oopar zakm aaye the, koi neze ka, koi talwar ka, koi teer ka. Shahadat ke baad koi aap ko pehchan na saka yahan tak ke aap ki hamshira ne aap ko pehchana aur woh bhi haathon ki ungliyon ki porein dekh kar. Inhi ke baare mein yeh ayat nazil hui. Aur yahi aise the jinhon ne jo kaha tha kar dikhaya (R.A). Aur riwayat mein hai ke jab musalman bhaage toh aap ne farmaya: "A dispositivosAllah! unhon ne jo kiya main is se apni ma'zoori zahir karta hoon aur mushrikon ne jo kiya main is se bezaar hoon." Is mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Sa'd (R.A) ne un se farmaya: "Main aap ke sath hoon." Sath chale bhi lekin farmaye jo ho kar rahe the woh meri taqat se baahar tha.

Hazrat Talha R.A farmate hain yeh bayan Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Jang-e-Uhad se jab Rasool Allah ﷺ wapas Madine aaye toh mimbar par charh kar Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana bayan ki aur musalmanon se hamdardi zahir ki jo jo shaheed hogaye the un ke darjon ki khabar di. Phir usi ayat ki tilawat ki. Ek musalman ne khare ho kar pucha ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ jin logon ka is ayat mein zikr hai woh kaun hain? Us waqt main samne aa raha tha aur hazrami sabz rang ke do kapre pehne hue the. Aap ne meri taraf ishara karke farmaya ae puchne wale yeh bhi un hi mein se hain. Un ke sahibzade Hazrat Musa bin Talha Hazrat Muawiyah R.A ke darbar mein gaye jab wahan se wapas aane lage darwaze se bahar nikle hi the jo Janab Muawiyah R.A ne wapas bulaya aur farmaya aao mujh se ek hadith sunte jao main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai ke tumhare walid Talha R.A un mein se hai jin ka bayan is ayat mein hai ke unhon ne apna ahd aur nazr poori kardi. Rabb-ul-Alamin un ka bayan farma kar farmata hai ke ba'z is din ke muntazir hain ke phir larai ho aur woh apni kar guzari Allah ko dikhayen aur jam-e-shahadat nosh farmayen. Pas ba'z ne toh sachai aur wafadari sabit kardi aur ba'z mauqe ke muntazir hain unhon ne na ahd badla na nazr poori karne ka kabhi unhen khyal guzra balki woh apne waade par qayam hain woh munafiqon ki tarah bahane banane wale nahi. Yeh khauf aur zalzala mahz is waste tha ke khabees-o-tayyib ki tamiz hojaye aur bure bhale ka haal har ek par khul jaye. Kyunke Allah toh Alim-ul-Ghaib hai us ke nazdeek toh zahir-o-batin barabar hai jo nahi huwa use bhi woh toh usi tarah janta hai jis tarah use jo hochuka. Lekin us ki aadat hai ke jab tak makhlooq amal na karle unhen sirf apne ilm ki bina par jaza saza nahi deta. Jaise us ka farman hai ayat (Wa lanabluwannakum hatta na'lamal-mujahidina minkum was-sabirina wa nabluwa akhbarakum) (Muhammad: 31) hum tumhen khoob परख (parkh) kar mujahidin sabirin ko tum mein se mumtaz kardenge. Pas wajood se pehle ka ilm phir wajood ke baad ka ilm dono Allah ko hain aur us ke baad jaza saza. Jaise farmaya ayat (Ma kanallahu liyazaral-mu'minina 'ala ma antum 'alaihi hatta yamizal-khabitha minat-tayyib) (Al-i-Imran: 179) Allah Ta'ala jis haal par tum ho usi par momino ko chor de aisa nahi jab tak ke woh bhale bure ki tamiz na karle na Allah aisa hai ke tumhen ghaib par muttali kar de. Pas yahan bhi farmata hai ke yeh is liye ke sachon ko un ki sachai ka badla de aur ahd shikan munafiqon ko saza de. Ya unhen taufeq-e-tauba de ke yeh apni rosh badal dein aur sache dil se Allah ki taraf jhuk jayen toh Allah bhi un par meharban hojaye aur un ko maaf farmade. Is liye ke woh apni makhlooq ki khataen maaf farmane wala aur un par meharbani karne wala hai. Us ki rafat-o-rahmat ghazab-o-ghusse se barhi hui hai.

Us din momino aur kuffaar mein farq wazeh ho gaya, munafiqon ka zikr oopar guzar chuka hai ke waqt se pehle toh jaan-nisari ke lambe chaude daaway karte thay lekin waqt aane par poore buzdil aur namard sabit hue, saare daaway aur waade dhare ke dhare reh gaye aur bajaye sabit-qadami ke peeth mod kar bhaag khade hue. Saare daaway aur waade dhare ke dhare reh gaye aur bajaye sabit-qadami ke peeth mod kar bhaag khade hue. Yahan momino ka zikr ho raha hai ke unhon ne apne waade poore kar dikhaye. Baaz ne jaam-e-shahadat nosh farmaya aur baaz us ke nazaare mein be-chain hain. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Hazrat Sabit (R.A) farmate hain ke jab hum ne Quran likhna shuru kiya toh ek aayat mujhe nahi milti thi halanki Surah Ahzaab mein woh aayat main ne khud Rasulullah ﷺ ki zabaan-e-mubarak se suni thi. Aakhir Hazrat Khuzaimah bin Sabit Ansari (R.A) ke pas yeh aayat mili, yeh woh sahabi hain jin ki akele ki gawahi ko Rasul-e-Kareem alaih-afdal-us-salawati-wat-tasleem ne do gawahon ke baraabar kar diya tha. Woh aayat (Min-al-mu'minina rijalun sadaqu ma 'ahad-ullaha 'alaihi faminhum man qada nahbahu wa minhum man yantaziru wa ma baddalu tabdila) (Al-Ahzaab: 23) hai. Yeh aayat Hazrat Anas bin Nazir (R.A) ke baare mein nazil hui hai. Waqia yeh hai ke jang-e-badr mein shareek nahi hue thay jis ka unhe saqt afsos tha ke sab se pehli jang mein jis mein khud Rasulullah ﷺ ba-nafs-e-nafees shareek thay main shamil na ho saka, ab jo jihad ka mauqa aayega main Allah Ta'ala ko apni sachai dikha dunga aur yeh bhi ke main kya karta hoon? Is se zyada kehte hue khauf khaya. Ab jang-e-uhud ka mauqa aaya toh unhon ne dekha ke samne se Hazrat Sa'd bin Mu'aaz (R.A) wapas aa rahe hain, unhe dekh kar taajjub se farmaya ke Abu Amr kahan ja rahe ho? Wallah mujhe Uhud pahad ke is taraf se jannat ki khushbooyein aa rahi hain. Yeh kehte hi aap aage badhe aur mushrikon mein khoob talwar chalayi. Chunke musalman laut gaye thay yeh tanha the, unke be-panah hamlon ne kuffaar ke daant khatte kar diye thay aur kuffaar ladte ladte un ki taraf badhe aur chaaron taraf se gher liya aur shaheed kar diya. Aap ko (80) assi se oopar oopar zakm aaye the, koi neze ka, koi talwar ka, koi teer ka. Shahadat ke baad koi aap ko pehchan na saka yahan tak ke aap ki hamshira ne aap ko pehchana aur woh bhi haathon ki ungliyon ki porein dekh kar. Inhi ke baare mein yeh ayat nazil hui. Aur yahi aise the jinhon ne jo kaha tha kar dikhaya (R.A). Aur riwayat mein hai ke jab musalman bhaage toh aap ne farmaya: "A dispositivosAllah! unhon ne jo kiya main is se apni ma'zoori zahir karta hoon aur mushrikon ne jo kiya main is se bezaar hoon." Is mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Sa'd (R.A) ne un se farmaya: "Main aap ke sath hoon." Sath chale bhi lekin farmaye jo ho kar rahe the woh meri taqat se baahar tha.

Hazrat Talha R.A farmate hain yeh bayan Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Jang-e-Uhad se jab Rasool Allah ﷺ wapas Madine aaye toh mimbar par charh kar Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana bayan ki aur musalmanon se hamdardi zahir ki jo jo shaheed hogaye the un ke darjon ki khabar di. Phir usi ayat ki tilawat ki. Ek musalman ne khare ho kar pucha ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ jin logon ka is ayat mein zikr hai woh kaun hain? Us waqt main samne aa raha tha aur hazrami sabz rang ke do kapre pehne hue the. Aap ne meri taraf ishara karke farmaya ae puchne wale yeh bhi un hi mein se hain. Un ke sahibzade Hazrat Musa bin Talha Hazrat Muawiyah R.A ke darbar mein gaye jab wahan se wapas aane lage darwaze se bahar nikle hi the jo Janab Muawiyah R.A ne wapas bulaya aur farmaya aao mujh se ek hadith sunte jao main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai ke tumhare walid Talha R.A un mein se hai jin ka bayan is ayat mein hai ke unhon ne apna ahd aur nazr poori kardi. Rabb-ul-Alamin un ka bayan farma kar farmata hai ke ba'z is din ke muntazir hain ke phir larai ho aur woh apni kar guzari Allah ko dikhayen aur jam-e-shahadat nosh farmayen. Pas ba'z ne toh sachai aur wafadari sabit kardi aur ba'z mauqe ke muntazir hain unhon ne na ahd badla na nazr poori karne ka kabhi unhen khyal guzra balki woh apne waade par qayam hain woh munafiqon ki tarah bahane banane wale nahi. Yeh khauf aur zalzala mahz is waste tha ke khabees-o-tayyib ki tamiz hojaye aur bure bhale ka haal har ek par khul jaye. Kyunke Allah toh Alim-ul-Ghaib hai us ke nazdeek toh zahir-o-batin barabar hai jo nahi huwa use bhi woh toh usi tarah janta hai jis tarah use jo hochuka. Lekin us ki aadat hai ke jab tak makhlooq amal na karle unhen sirf apne ilm ki bina par jaza saza nahi deta. Jaise us ka farman hai ayat (Wa lanabluwannakum hatta na'lamal-mujahidina minkum was-sabirina wa nabluwa akhbarakum) (Muhammad: 31) hum tumhen khoob परख (parkh) kar mujahidin sabirin ko tum mein se mumtaz kardenge. Pas wajood se pehle ka ilm phir wajood ke baad ka ilm dono Allah ko hain aur us ke baad jaza saza. Jaise farmaya ayat (Ma kanallahu liyazaral-mu'minina 'ala ma antum 'alaihi hatta yamizal-khabitha minat-tayyib) (Al-i-Imran: 179) Allah Ta'ala jis haal par tum ho usi par momino ko chor de aisa nahi jab tak ke woh bhale bure ki tamiz na karle na Allah aisa hai ke tumhen ghaib par muttali kar de. Pas yahan bhi farmata hai ke yeh is liye ke sachon ko un ki sachai ka badla de aur ahd shikan munafiqon ko saza de. Ya unhen taufeq-e-tauba de ke yeh apni rosh badal dein aur sache dil se Allah ki taraf jhuk jayen toh Allah bhi un par meharban hojaye aur un ko maaf farmade. Is liye ke woh apni makhlooq ki khataen maaf farmane wala aur un par meharbani karne wala hai. Us ki rafat-o-rahmat ghazab-o-ghusse se barhi hui hai.

Allah Azzawajal kuffar se khud nipte. Allah Ta'ala apna ehsaan bayan farma raha hai ke usne toofan-e-bad-o-baran bhej kar aur apne na nazar aane wale lashkar utaar kar kafiron ki kamar tod di aur unhe sakht mayusi aur namuradi ke sath muhasira hatana pada. Balke agar Rahmat-e-Lil-Alamin ki ummat mein yeh na hote toh yeh hawayein unke sath wohi kartin jo Adiyon ke sath us be-barkat hawa ne kiya tha. Chunke Rabb-e-Alamin ka farman hai ke tu jab tak unmein hai Allah unhe aam azab nahi karega, lehaza unhe sirf unki shararat ka maza chakh diya. Unke majmua ko muntashir karke un par se apna azab hata liya. Chunke unka yeh ijtima mahz hawa-e-nafsani tha, isliye hawa ne hi unhe paraganda kar diya. Jo soch samajh kar aaye the sab khaak mein mil gaya. Kahan ki ghanimat? Kahan ki fateh? Jaan ke lale pad gaye aur hath malte, daant peeste, pech-o-tab khate, zillat-o-ruswai ke sath namuradi aur nakami se wapas hue. Duniya ka khasara alag hua aur aakhirat ka wabal alag. Kyunke jo koi shakhs kisi kaam ka qasd karta hai aur woh apne kaam ko amli surat bhi de de, phir woh us mein kamyab na ho toh gunehgaar toh woh ho hi gaya. Pas Rasulullah ﷺ ke qatl aur aap ke deen ko fana karne ki aarzu, phir ehtimam, phir iqdam, sab kuch unhone kar liya. Lekin qudrat ne dono jahan ka bojh un par laadh kar unhe jale dil se wapas kiya. Allah Ta'ala ne khud hi momino ki taraf se unka muqabla kiya. Na musalman unse lade na unhe hataya. Balke musalman apni jagah rahe aur woh bhagte rahe. Allah ne apne lashkar ki laaj rakh li aur apne bande ki madad ki aur khud hi kafi ho gaya. Isi liye Huzoor ﷺ farmaya karte the: Allah ke siva koi ma'bud nahi, woh akila hai, usne apne wade ko sacha kiya, apne bande ki madad ki, apne lashkar ki izzat ki, tamam dushmanon se aap hi nipat liya aur sab ko shikast de di. Us ke baad aur koi bhi nahi (Bukhari Muslim). 

Huzoor ﷺ ne Jang-e-Ahzaab ke mauqe par Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala se jo dua ki thi, woh bhi Bukhari Muslim mein marwi hai ke aap ne dua farmai: (Allahumma munzizal-kitabi, sari'al-hisabi, ihzimil-ahzaaba wa zزلzilhum) (Aie Allah! Aie kitab ke utaarne wale, jald hisab lene wale! In lashkaron ko shikast de aur unhe hila daal). 

Is farman-e-ayat: (WA KAFA-LLAHU AL-MU'MININA AL-QITAALA, WA KANA-LLAHU QAWIYYAN 'AZIZA) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 25) yani Allah ne momino ki kifayat jang se kar di. Is mein nihayat lateef baat yeh hai ke na sirf is jang se hi musalman chhoot gaye, balke آئندہ hamesha hi Sahaba is se bach gaye ke mushrikein un par chadh daudain. Chunache aap tareekh dekh lein, Jang-e-Khandaq ke baad kafiron ki himmat nahi padi ke woh Madine par ya Huzoor ﷺ par kisi jagah khud chadhai karte. Unke manhoos qadmon se Allah ne apne Nabi ke maskan-o-aramgah ko mehfooz kar liya, falhamdulillah. Balke barkhilaf is ke musalman un par chadh chadh gaye, yahan tak ke Arab ki sarzameen se Allah ne shirk-o-kufr khatam kar diya.

Jab is jang se kafir lotey usi waqt Rasul Akram ﷺ ne ba-taur pesh-goi farma diya tha ki is saal ke baad Quraish tum se jang nahi karenge balki tum un se jang karoge, chunache yehi hua. Yahan tak ke Makkah fath ho gaya. Allah ki quwat ka muqabla bande ke bas ka nahi. Allah ko koi maghlub nahi kar sakta. Isi ne apni madad-o-quwat se un biphre hue aur bikhre hue lashkaron ko paspa kiya. Unhein baraye naam bhi koi nafa na pahuncha. Us ne Islam aur Ahl-e-Islam ko ghalib kiya, apna wada sacha kar dikhaya aur apne Abd-o-Rasul ﷺ ki madad farmai. Fa-Alhamdulillah.)

Kuffar ne ain mauqa par dhoka diya. Itna hum pehle likh chuke hain jab mushrikeen-o-yahood ke lashkar Madine par aaye aur unhon ne ghera dala toh Bani Quraiza ke yahudi jo Madine mein the aur jin se Huzoor ﷺ ka ahd-o-paiman ho chuka tha, unhon ne bhi ain mauqa par bewafai ki aur ahd tod kar aankhein dikhane lage. Unka sardar Ka'ab bin Asad baaton mein aa gaya aur Huyai bin Akhtab khabees ne use bad-ahdi par aamada kar diya. Pehle toh yeh na mana aur apne ahd par qaim raha, Huyai ne kaha ke dekh toh sahi main toh tujhe izzat ka taj pehnane aaya hoon. Quraish aur unke sathi Ghatafan aur unke sathi aur hum sab ek sath hain. Hum ne qasam kha rakhi hai ke jab tak ek ek Musalman ka qeema na kar lein yahan se nahi hatne ke. Ka'ab kyunke jahandida shakhs tha, us ne jawab diya ke mahz ghalat hai. Yeh tumhare bas ke nahi, toh hamein zillat ka tauq pehnane aaya hai. Tu bada manhoos shakhs hai mere samne se hat ja aur mujhe apni makari ka shikaar na bana. Lekin Huyai phir bhi na tala aur use samjhata bujhata raha. Aakhir mein kaha sun agar bil-farz Quraish aur Ghatafan bhag bhi jayein toh main ma' apni jamaat ke teri garhi mein aa jaunga aur jo kuch tera aur teri qaum ka haal hoga, wahi mera aur meri qaum ka haal hoga. Bil-akhir Ka'ab par Huyai ka jadu chal gaya aur Bani Quraiza ne sulh tod di, jis se Huzoor ﷺ ko aur Sahaba ko sakht sadma hua aur bahut hi bhari pada. Phir jab Allah Ta'ala ne apne ghulamon ki madad ki aur Huzoor ﷺ ma' ashab ke muzaffar-o-mansoor Madine Shareef ko wapas aaye, Sahaba ؓ ne hathiyar khol diye aur Huzoor ﷺ bhi hathiyar utaar kar Hazrat Umme Salama ؓ ke ghar mein gard-o-ghubar se pak-saaf hone ke liye ghusal karne ko baithe hi the ke Hazrat Jibraeel zahir hue, aap ke sar par reshami amama tha, khachar par sawaar the jis par reshami gaddi thi, farmane lage ke Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ kya aap ne kamar khol li? Aap ne farmaya haan. Hazrat Jibraeel ne farmaya lekin farishton ne ab tak apne hathiyar alag nahi kiye. Main kafiron ke taaqub se abhi abhi aa raha hoon, suniye Allah Ta'ala ka hukum hai ke Bani Quraiza ki taraf chaliye aur unki poori goshmali kijiye. Mujhe bhi Allah ka hukum mil chuka hai ke main unhein thra dun. Huzoor ﷺ usi waqt uth khade hue, tayyar ho kar Sahaba ؓ anhum ajma'een ko hukum diya aur farmaya ke tum mein se har ek Asr ki namaz Bani Quraiza mein hi padhe. Zohar ke baad yeh hukum mila tha, Bani Quraiza ka qila yahan se kai mil par tha. Namaz ka waqt Sahaba ko raste mein aa gaya, toh baaz ne toh namaz ada kar li aur kaha ke Huzoor ka farman iska matlab yeh tha ke hum tez chalein aur baaz ne kaha hum toh wahan pahunche baghair namaz nahi padhenge. Jab aap ko yeh baat maloom hui toh aap ne dono mein se kisi ko dant-dupat nahi ki. Aap ne Madina par Hazrat Ibn Umm Maktoom ؓ ko khalifa banaya, Hazrat Ali ؓ ke hath lashkar ka jhanda diya aur aap bhi Sahaba ؓ ke peeche peeche Bani Quraiza ki taraf chale aur ja kar unke qila ko gher liya. Yeh mohasira pachis roz tak raha.

Jab Yahudiyon ke naak mein dam aagaya aur tang haal hogaye toh unhon ne apna hakim Hazrat Sa'ad bin Mu'az R.A ko banaya jo qabeela Aus ke sardار the. Banu Quraiza mein aur qabeela Aus mein zamana-e-jahiliyat mein ittefaq o yagangat thi, aik doosray ke haleef the, is liye un Yahudiyon ko yeh khayal raha ke Hazrat Sa'ad hamara lihaaz aur paas karenge, jaise ke Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul ne Banu Qainqa' ko chhudwaya tha. Idhar Hazrat Sa'ad R.A ki yeh halat thi ke Jang-e-Khandaq mein unhein akhal ki rag mein aik teer laga tha jis se khoon jari tha. Huzoor ﷺ ne zakhm par daagh lagwaya tha aur masjid ke khaime mein hi unhein rakha tha ke paas hi paas ayadat aur bimar-porsi kar liya karein. Hazrat Sa'ad R.A ne jo duaein keen un mein aik dua yeh thi ke "Aey Parvardigar! Agar ab bhi koi aisi ladai baqi hai jis mein kuffar-e-Quraish tere Nabi ﷺ par chadh aayein toh tu mujhe zinda rakh ke main is mein shirkat kar sakoon aur agar tu ne koi aik ladai bhi aisi baqi nahi rakhi toh khair mera zakhm khoob behata rahe, lekin aey mere Rab! Jab tak main Banu Quraiza qabeele ki sarkashi ki saza se apni aankhein thandi na kar loon, toh meri maut ko mo'akhkhar farmana." Hazrat Sa'ad R.A jaise mustajab-ud-da'awat ki dua ki qubooliyat ki shaan dekhiye ke aap dua karte hain idhar Yahudiyan-e-Banu Quraiza aap ke faisle par izhar-e-razamandi karke qile ko musalmanon ke supurd karte hain. Janab Rasool Allah ﷺ aadmi bhej kar aap ko Madina se bulwate hain ke aap aa kar un ke bare mein apna faisla suna dein. Yeh gadhe par sawar kara liye gaye aur sara qabeela un se lipat gaya ke "Dekhiye Hazrat! Khayal rakhiyega, Banu Quraiza aap ke aadmi hain, unhon ne aap par bharosa kiya hai, woh aap ke haleef hain, aap ki qaum ke dukh ke sathi hain, aap un par raham farmaiyega, un ke sath narmi se pesh aiyega. Dekhiye is waqt un ka koi nahi, woh aap ke bas mein hain" waghairah. Lekin Hazrat Sa'ad R.A mahz khamosh the, koi jawab nahi dete the. Un logon ne majboor kiya ke jawab dein, peecha hi na chhoda. Aakhir aap ne farmaya: "Waqt aagaya hai ke Sa'ad is baat ka saboot de ke use Allah ki rah mein kisi malamat karne wale ki malamat ki parwa nahi." Yeh sunte hi un logon ke toh dil doob gaye aur samajh liya ke Banu Quraiza ki khair nahi. Jab Hazrat Sa'ad R.A ki sawari us khaime ke qareeb pahunch gayi jis mein Janab Rasool Allah ﷺ the, toh aap ne farmaya: "Logo! Apne sardar ke istiqbal ke liye utho." Chunanche musalman uth khade huye aur aap ko izzat o ikram, waqqat o ahteram se sawari se utara. Yeh is liye tha ke is waqt aap hakim ki haisiyat mein the, un ke faisle poore natiq o naafiz samjhe jayenge. Aap ke baithte hi Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya ke yeh log aap ke faisle par razamand ho kar qile se nikal aaye hain, ab aap un ke bare mein jo chahein hukum deejiye. Aap ne kaha: "Jo main un par hukum karoon woh poora hoga?" Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya: "Haan, kyun nahi?" Kaha: "Aur is khaime walon par bhi is ki taamil zaroori hogi?" Aap ne farmaya: "Yaqeenan." Poocha: "Aur is taraf walon par bhi?" Aur ishara us taraf kiya jis taraf khud Rasool Akram ﷺ the.

Lekin Aap ki taraf nahin dekha Aap ki buzurgi aur izzat-o-azmat ki wajah se, Huzoor ﷺ ne jawab diya haan us taraf walon par bhi. Aap ne farmaya ab mera faisla suniye main kehta hoon Banu Quraiza mein jitne log ladne wale hain unhein qatl kar diya jaye aur un ki aulaad ko qaid kar liya jaye un ke maal qabze mein laye jayen. Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya, "He Sa'd R.H (Razi Allahu Anhu - Note: Saad bin Mu'aaz R.A) tum ne un ke bare mein wohi hukm kiya jo Allah Ta'ala ne saatwein aasman ke upar kiya hai." Ek riwayat mein hai ke Aap ne farmaya tum ne sachhe Malik Allah Ta'ala ka jo hukm tha wohi sunaya hai. Phir Huzoor ﷺ ke hukm se khandakein khudwa kar unhein bandha hua bulwa kar un ki gardanein mari gayeen. Yeh ginti mein saat aath sau thay un ki auratein na-baligh bachche aur maal le liye gaye. Hum ne yeh kul waqeat apni Kitab-us-Seer mein tafseel se likh diye hain. Walhamdulillah. 

Pas farmata hai ke jin Ahl-e-Kitab yaani yahudiyon ne kafiryon ke lashkaron ki himmat afzai ki thi aur un ka sath diya tha un se bhi Allah Ta'ala ne un ke qile khali kara diye. Is kaum Quraiza ke bade sardar jin se un ki nasl jari hui thi agle zamane mein aa kar Hijaz mein isi tama' mein base thay ke Nabi-e-Akhir-uz-Zaman ki peshgoi hamari kitabon mein hai woh chunke yahin hone wale hain to hum sab pehle Aap ki ittiba ki saadat se masood honge. Lekin in na-haq logon ne jab Allah ke woh Nabi aaye un ki takzeeb ki jis ki wajah se Allah ki la'nat un par nazil hui. "Siyasi" se murad qile hain isi mani ke lihaz se singon ko bhi Siyasi kehte hain is liye ke janwar ke sare jism ke upar aur sab se buland yahi hote hain, un ke dilon mein Allah ne rohb daal diya unhon ne hi mushrikeen ko bhadka kar Rasool Allah ﷺ par chadhai karai thi. 

Aalim-o-jahil barabar nahi hote. Yahi thay jinhon ne musalmanon ko jadon se akhed dena chaha tha lekin mamla bar-aks ho gaya paansa palat gaya quwat kamzori se aur murad na-muradi se badal gayi. Naqsha bigad gaya hamayati bhag khade hue. Yeh be-dast-o-pa reh gaye. Izzat ki khwahish ne zillat dikhai musalmanon ke barbad karne aur pees dalne ki khwahish ne apne tayin piswa diya. Aur abhi aakhirat ki mahroomi baqi hai. Kuch qatl kar diye gaye baqi qaid kar diye gaye. 

Atiyyah Qurazi ka bayan hai ke jab mujhe Huzoor ﷺ ke samne pesh kiya gaya to mere bare mein Huzoor ko kuch taraddud hua. Farmaya isse alag le jao dekho agar is ke naaf ke niche baal hon to qatl kar do warna qaidiyon mein bitha do, dekha to main bachcha hi tha zinda chhor diya gaya. Un ki zameen ghar un ke maal ke malik musalman ban gaye balke is zameen ke bhi jo ab tak padi thi aur jahan musalman ke nishan-e-qadam bhi na pade thay yaani Khaibar ki zameen ya Makkah Sharif ki zameen, ya Faris ya Rum ki zameen aur mumkin hai ke yeh kul khitte murad hon Allah badi qudrato wala hai. 

Musnad Ahmad mein Hazrat Aishah Siddiqa R.A ka bayan hai ke Khandaq wale din main lashkar ka kuch haal maloom karne nikli.

Mujhe apne peeche se kisi ke bahut tez aane ki aahat aur uske hathiyaron ki jhankar sunai di, main raaste se hat kar ek jagah baith gayi, dekha ke Hazrat Sa'ad bin Mu'az (R.A) lashkar ki taraf ja rahe hain aur unke saath unke bhai Haris bin Aus the, jin ke haath mein unki dhal thi. Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) lohe ki zirah pehne hue the lekin bare lambe chaure the, zirah poore badan par nahi aayi thi, haath khule the, ash'aar-e-rajaz padhte hue jhoomte jhaamte chale ja rahe the. Main yahan se aur aage badhi aur ek baagheche mein chali gayi, wahan kuch musalman maujood the jin mein Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) bhi the aur ek aur sahib jo khud odhe hue the. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne mujhe dekh liya, pas phir kya tha? Bade hi bigde aur mujh se farmane lage: Yeh daleri? Tum nahi jaanti ladai ho rahi hai? Allah jaane kya natija ho? Tum kaise yahan chali aayin waghera waghera. Jo sahib mighfar se apna munh chhupaye hue the, unhone Umar Farooq (R.A) ki yeh baatein sun kar apne sar se lohe ka top utara, dekha ab main pehchan gayi ke woh Hazrat Talha (R.A) the. Unhone Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko khamosh kiya ke kya malamat shuru kar rakhi hai? Natije ka kya dar hai? Kyun tumhe itni ghabrahat hai? Koi bhag ke jayega kahan? Sab kuch Allah ke haath hai. Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) ko ek Qurashi ne taak kar teer lagaya aur kaha: Le, main Ibn Arqah hoon. Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) ki rag-e-akhal par woh teer pada aur paiwast ho gaya. Khoon ke foware choot gaye, usi waqt aap ne dua ki ke: Aaye Allah! Mujhe maut na dena jab tak Bani Quraiza ki tabahi apni aankhon se na dekh loon. Allah ki shan se usi waqt khoon tham gaya. Mushrikeen ko hawaon ne bhaga diya aur Allah ne momino ki kifayat kar di. Abu Sufyan aur uske sathi to bhag kar Tihamah mein chale gaye, Uyainah bin Badr aur uske sathi Najd mein chale gaye. Bani Quraiza apne qile mein ja kar panah-guzin ho gaye. Maidan khali dekh kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Madine mein wapas tashreef le aaye. Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) ke liye masjid mein hi chamde ka ek khaima nasb kiya gaya. Usi waqt Hazrat Jibreel (A.S) aaye, aap ka chehra gard-alood tha, farmane lage: Aap ne hathiyar khol diye? Halanki farishte ab tak hathiyar-band hain. Uthiye, Bani Quraiza se bhi faisla kar lijiye, un par chadhai kijiye. Huzoor ne foran hathiyar laga liye aur sahaba mein bhi koch ki manadi kara di. Bani Tamim ke makanat Masjid-e-Nabwi se mutasil hi the, raah mein aap ne unse pucha: Kyun bhai? Kisi ko jaate hue dekha? Unhone kaha ke haan, abhi abhi Hazrat Dihyah Kalbi (R.A) gaye hain. Halanki the to woh Hazrat Jibreel (A.S) lekin aap ka dadhi, chehra waghera bilkul Hazrat Dihyah Kalbi se milta-julta tha. Ab aap ne ja kar Bani Quraiza ke qile ka muhasra kiya, pachis roz tak yeh muhasra jari raha. Jab woh ghabraye aur tang aa gaye to unse kaha gaya ke qila hamein saunp do aur tum apne aap ko hamare hawale kar do. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) tumhare bare mein jo chahenge faisla farma denge.

Unhon ne Hazrat Abu Lubabah bin Abdul Munzir se mashwara kiya to unhon ne kaha is soorat mein to apni jaan se haath dho lena hai. Unhon ne yeh maloom karke use to na manzoor kardiya aur kehne lage hum qila khali kardete hain aap ki fauj ko qabza dete hain hamare baare ka faisla hum Hazrat Sa'd bin Mu'az ko dete hain. Aap ne ise bhi manzoor farmaliya. Hazrat Sa'd (R.A) ko bulaya aap tashreef le aaye gadhe par sawar thay jis par khajoor ke darakht ki chaal ki gaddi thi aap us par ba-mushkil sawar karadiye gaye thay aap ki kaum aap ko ghere hue thi aur samjha rahi thi ke dekho Banu Quraiza hamare haleef hain hamare dost hain hamari maut zeest ke shareek hain aur un ke taalluqat jo hum se hain woh aap par poshida nahi. Aap khamoshi se sab ki baatein sunte jaate thay jab un ke mohalle mein pahuche toh un ki taraf nazar dali aur kaha waqt aagaya ke main Allah ki raah mein kisi malamat karne wale ki malamat ki mutlaqan parwah na karun. Jab Huzoor ke khaime ke paas un ki sawari pahuchi to Huzoor ne farmaya apne sayyed ki taraf utho aur unhe utaro. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya hamara sayyed to Allah hi hai. Aap ne farmaya utaro. Logon ne mil jul kar unhe sawari se utara Huzoor ne farmaya Sa'd (R.A) un ke baare mein jo hukm karna chaho kardo. Aap ne farmaya un ke bade qatal kardiye jayein aur un ke chhote ghulaam banaye jayein un ka maal taqseem karliya jaye. Aap ne farmaya Sa'd (R.A) tum ne is hukm mein Allah aur us ke Rasool ki poori muwafaqat ki. Phir Hazrat Sa'd (R.A) ne dua mangi ke اے اللہ agar tere Nabi ﷺ par Quraish ki koi aur chadhai abhi baaki ho toh mujhe us ki shumuliyat ke liye zinda rakh warna apni taraf bula le. Usi waqt zakm se khoon behne laga halanke woh poora bhar chuka tha yoon hi sa baaki tha chunache unhe phir usi khaime mein pahuncha diya gaya aur aap wahin shaheed hogaye (R.A). Khud Huzoor ﷺ aur aap ke sath Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A), Hazrat Umar (R.A) waghera bhi aaye sab ro rahe thay aur Abu Bakr (R.A) ki awaaz Umar (R.A) ki awaaz mein pehchan bhi ho rahi thi main us waqt apne hujre mein thi. Fi-l-waqia Ashaab-e-Rasoolullah aise hi thay jaise Allah ne farmaya ayat (Ruhama'u bainahum) (Surah (Al-Fath: 29). Aapas mein ek doosre ki poori mohabbat aur ek doosre se ulfat rakhne wale thay. Hazrat Alqamah (R.A) ne poocha Umm-ul-Momineen yeh toh farmaiye ke Rasoolullah ﷺ kis tarah roya karte thay? Farmaya aap ki aankhein kisi par aansu nahi bahati thin haan gham-o-ranj ke mauqe par aap daarhi mubarak apni muthi mein le lete thay.)

Kuffar ne ain mauqa par dhoka diya. Itna hum pehle likh chuke hain jab mushrikeen-o-yahood ke lashkar Madine par aaye aur unhon ne ghera dala toh Bani Quraiza ke yahudi jo Madine mein the aur jin se Huzoor ﷺ ka ahd-o-paiman ho chuka tha, unhon ne bhi ain mauqa par bewafai ki aur ahd tod kar aankhein dikhane lage. Unka sardar Ka'ab bin Asad baaton mein aa gaya aur Huyai bin Akhtab khabees ne use bad-ahdi par aamada kar diya. Pehle toh yeh na mana aur apne ahd par qaim raha, Huyai ne kaha ke dekh toh sahi main toh tujhe izzat ka taj pehnane aaya hoon. Quraish aur unke sathi Ghatafan aur unke sathi aur hum sab ek sath hain. Hum ne qasam kha rakhi hai ke jab tak ek ek Musalman ka qeema na kar lein yahan se nahi hatne ke. Ka'ab kyunke jahandida shakhs tha, us ne jawab diya ke mahz ghalat hai. Yeh tumhare bas ke nahi, toh hamein zillat ka tauq pehnane aaya hai. Tu bada manhoos shakhs hai mere samne se hat ja aur mujhe apni makari ka shikaar na bana. Lekin Huyai phir bhi na tala aur use samjhata bujhata raha. Aakhir mein kaha sun agar bil-farz Quraish aur Ghatafan bhag bhi jayein toh main ma' apni jamaat ke teri garhi mein aa jaunga aur jo kuch tera aur teri qaum ka haal hoga, wahi mera aur meri qaum ka haal hoga. Bil-akhir Ka'ab par Huyai ka jadu chal gaya aur Bani Quraiza ne sulh tod di, jis se Huzoor ﷺ ko aur Sahaba ko sakht sadma hua aur bahut hi bhari pada. Phir jab Allah Ta'ala ne apne ghulamon ki madad ki aur Huzoor ﷺ ma' ashab ke muzaffar-o-mansoor Madine Shareef ko wapas aaye, Sahaba ؓ ne hathiyar khol diye aur Huzoor ﷺ bhi hathiyar utaar kar Hazrat Umme Salama ؓ ke ghar mein gard-o-ghubar se pak-saaf hone ke liye ghusal karne ko baithe hi the ke Hazrat Jibraeel zahir hue, aap ke sar par reshami amama tha, khachar par sawaar the jis par reshami gaddi thi, farmane lage ke Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ kya aap ne kamar khol li? Aap ne farmaya haan. Hazrat Jibraeel ne farmaya lekin farishton ne ab tak apne hathiyar alag nahi kiye. Main kafiron ke taaqub se abhi abhi aa raha hoon, suniye Allah Ta'ala ka hukum hai ke Bani Quraiza ki taraf chaliye aur unki poori goshmali kijiye. Mujhe bhi Allah ka hukum mil chuka hai ke main unhein thra dun. Huzoor ﷺ usi waqt uth khade hue, tayyar ho kar Sahaba ؓ anhum ajma'een ko hukum diya aur farmaya ke tum mein se har ek Asr ki namaz Bani Quraiza mein hi padhe. Zohar ke baad yeh hukum mila tha, Bani Quraiza ka qila yahan se kai mil par tha. Namaz ka waqt Sahaba ko raste mein aa gaya, toh baaz ne toh namaz ada kar li aur kaha ke Huzoor ka farman iska matlab yeh tha ke hum tez chalein aur baaz ne kaha hum toh wahan pahunche baghair namaz nahi padhenge. Jab aap ko yeh baat maloom hui toh aap ne dono mein se kisi ko dant-dupat nahi ki. Aap ne Madina par Hazrat Ibn Umm Maktoom ؓ ko khalifa banaya, Hazrat Ali ؓ ke hath lashkar ka jhanda diya aur aap bhi Sahaba ؓ ke peeche peeche Bani Quraiza ki taraf chale aur ja kar unke qila ko gher liya. Yeh mohasira pachis roz tak raha.

Jab Yahudiyon ke naak mein dam aagaya aur tang haal hogaye toh unhon ne apna hakim Hazrat Sa'ad bin Mu'az R.A ko banaya jo qabeela Aus ke sardار the. Banu Quraiza mein aur qabeela Aus mein zamana-e-jahiliyat mein ittefaq o yagangat thi, aik doosray ke haleef the, is liye un Yahudiyon ko yeh khayal raha ke Hazrat Sa'ad hamara lihaaz aur paas karenge, jaise ke Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul ne Banu Qainqa' ko chhudwaya tha. Idhar Hazrat Sa'ad R.A ki yeh halat thi ke Jang-e-Khandaq mein unhein akhal ki rag mein aik teer laga tha jis se khoon jari tha. Huzoor ﷺ ne zakhm par daagh lagwaya tha aur masjid ke khaime mein hi unhein rakha tha ke paas hi paas ayadat aur bimar-porsi kar liya karein. Hazrat Sa'ad R.A ne jo duaein keen un mein aik dua yeh thi ke "Aey Parvardigar! Agar ab bhi koi aisi ladai baqi hai jis mein kuffar-e-Quraish tere Nabi ﷺ par chadh aayein toh tu mujhe zinda rakh ke main is mein shirkat kar sakoon aur agar tu ne koi aik ladai bhi aisi baqi nahi rakhi toh khair mera zakhm khoob behata rahe, lekin aey mere Rab! Jab tak main Banu Quraiza qabeele ki sarkashi ki saza se apni aankhein thandi na kar loon, toh meri maut ko mo'akhkhar farmana." Hazrat Sa'ad R.A jaise mustajab-ud-da'awat ki dua ki qubooliyat ki shaan dekhiye ke aap dua karte hain idhar Yahudiyan-e-Banu Quraiza aap ke faisle par izhar-e-razamandi karke qile ko musalmanon ke supurd karte hain. Janab Rasool Allah ﷺ aadmi bhej kar aap ko Madina se bulwate hain ke aap aa kar un ke bare mein apna faisla suna dein. Yeh gadhe par sawar kara liye gaye aur sara qabeela un se lipat gaya ke "Dekhiye Hazrat! Khayal rakhiyega, Banu Quraiza aap ke aadmi hain, unhon ne aap par bharosa kiya hai, woh aap ke haleef hain, aap ki qaum ke dukh ke sathi hain, aap un par raham farmaiyega, un ke sath narmi se pesh aiyega. Dekhiye is waqt un ka koi nahi, woh aap ke bas mein hain" waghairah. Lekin Hazrat Sa'ad R.A mahz khamosh the, koi jawab nahi dete the. Un logon ne majboor kiya ke jawab dein, peecha hi na chhoda. Aakhir aap ne farmaya: "Waqt aagaya hai ke Sa'ad is baat ka saboot de ke use Allah ki rah mein kisi malamat karne wale ki malamat ki parwa nahi." Yeh sunte hi un logon ke toh dil doob gaye aur samajh liya ke Banu Quraiza ki khair nahi. Jab Hazrat Sa'ad R.A ki sawari us khaime ke qareeb pahunch gayi jis mein Janab Rasool Allah ﷺ the, toh aap ne farmaya: "Logo! Apne sardar ke istiqbal ke liye utho." Chunanche musalman uth khade huye aur aap ko izzat o ikram, waqqat o ahteram se sawari se utara. Yeh is liye tha ke is waqt aap hakim ki haisiyat mein the, un ke faisle poore natiq o naafiz samjhe jayenge. Aap ke baithte hi Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya ke yeh log aap ke faisle par razamand ho kar qile se nikal aaye hain, ab aap un ke bare mein jo chahein hukum deejiye. Aap ne kaha: "Jo main un par hukum karoon woh poora hoga?" Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya: "Haan, kyun nahi?" Kaha: "Aur is khaime walon par bhi is ki taamil zaroori hogi?" Aap ne farmaya: "Yaqeenan." Poocha: "Aur is taraf walon par bhi?" Aur ishara us taraf kiya jis taraf khud Rasool Akram ﷺ the.

Lekin Aap ki taraf nahin dekha Aap ki buzurgi aur izzat-o-azmat ki wajah se, Huzoor ﷺ ne jawab diya haan us taraf walon par bhi. Aap ne farmaya ab mera faisla suniye main kehta hoon Banu Quraiza mein jitne log ladne wale hain unhein qatl kar diya jaye aur un ki aulaad ko qaid kar liya jaye un ke maal qabze mein laye jayen. Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya, "He Sa'd R.H (Razi Allahu Anhu - Note: Saad bin Mu'aaz R.A) tum ne un ke bare mein wohi hukm kiya jo Allah Ta'ala ne saatwein aasman ke upar kiya hai." Ek riwayat mein hai ke Aap ne farmaya tum ne sachhe Malik Allah Ta'ala ka jo hukm tha wohi sunaya hai. Phir Huzoor ﷺ ke hukm se khandakein khudwa kar unhein bandha hua bulwa kar un ki gardanein mari gayeen. Yeh ginti mein saat aath sau thay un ki auratein na-baligh bachche aur maal le liye gaye. Hum ne yeh kul waqeat apni Kitab-us-Seer mein tafseel se likh diye hain. Walhamdulillah. 

Pas farmata hai ke jin Ahl-e-Kitab yaani yahudiyon ne kafiryon ke lashkaron ki himmat afzai ki thi aur un ka sath diya tha un se bhi Allah Ta'ala ne un ke qile khali kara diye. Is kaum Quraiza ke bade sardar jin se un ki nasl jari hui thi agle zamane mein aa kar Hijaz mein isi tama' mein base thay ke Nabi-e-Akhir-uz-Zaman ki peshgoi hamari kitabon mein hai woh chunke yahin hone wale hain to hum sab pehle Aap ki ittiba ki saadat se masood honge. Lekin in na-haq logon ne jab Allah ke woh Nabi aaye un ki takzeeb ki jis ki wajah se Allah ki la'nat un par nazil hui. "Siyasi" se murad qile hain isi mani ke lihaz se singon ko bhi Siyasi kehte hain is liye ke janwar ke sare jism ke upar aur sab se buland yahi hote hain, un ke dilon mein Allah ne rohb daal diya unhon ne hi mushrikeen ko bhadka kar Rasool Allah ﷺ par chadhai karai thi. 

Aalim-o-jahil barabar nahi hote. Yahi thay jinhon ne musalmanon ko jadon se akhed dena chaha tha lekin mamla bar-aks ho gaya paansa palat gaya quwat kamzori se aur murad na-muradi se badal gayi. Naqsha bigad gaya hamayati bhag khade hue. Yeh be-dast-o-pa reh gaye. Izzat ki khwahish ne zillat dikhai musalmanon ke barbad karne aur pees dalne ki khwahish ne apne tayin piswa diya. Aur abhi aakhirat ki mahroomi baqi hai. Kuch qatl kar diye gaye baqi qaid kar diye gaye. 

Atiyyah Qurazi ka bayan hai ke jab mujhe Huzoor ﷺ ke samne pesh kiya gaya to mere bare mein Huzoor ko kuch taraddud hua. Farmaya isse alag le jao dekho agar is ke naaf ke niche baal hon to qatl kar do warna qaidiyon mein bitha do, dekha to main bachcha hi tha zinda chhor diya gaya. Un ki zameen ghar un ke maal ke malik musalman ban gaye balke is zameen ke bhi jo ab tak padi thi aur jahan musalman ke nishan-e-qadam bhi na pade thay yaani Khaibar ki zameen ya Makkah Sharif ki zameen, ya Faris ya Rum ki zameen aur mumkin hai ke yeh kul khitte murad hon Allah badi qudrato wala hai. 

Musnad Ahmad mein Hazrat Aishah Siddiqa R.A ka bayan hai ke Khandaq wale din main lashkar ka kuch haal maloom karne nikli.

Mujhe apne peeche se kisi ke bahut tez aane ki aahat aur uske hathiyaron ki jhankar sunai di, main raaste se hat kar ek jagah baith gayi, dekha ke Hazrat Sa'ad bin Mu'az (R.A) lashkar ki taraf ja rahe hain aur unke saath unke bhai Haris bin Aus the, jin ke haath mein unki dhal thi. Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) lohe ki zirah pehne hue the lekin bare lambe chaure the, zirah poore badan par nahi aayi thi, haath khule the, ash'aar-e-rajaz padhte hue jhoomte jhaamte chale ja rahe the. Main yahan se aur aage badhi aur ek baagheche mein chali gayi, wahan kuch musalman maujood the jin mein Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) bhi the aur ek aur sahib jo khud odhe hue the. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne mujhe dekh liya, pas phir kya tha? Bade hi bigde aur mujh se farmane lage: Yeh daleri? Tum nahi jaanti ladai ho rahi hai? Allah jaane kya natija ho? Tum kaise yahan chali aayin waghera waghera. Jo sahib mighfar se apna munh chhupaye hue the, unhone Umar Farooq (R.A) ki yeh baatein sun kar apne sar se lohe ka top utara, dekha ab main pehchan gayi ke woh Hazrat Talha (R.A) the. Unhone Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko khamosh kiya ke kya malamat shuru kar rakhi hai? Natije ka kya dar hai? Kyun tumhe itni ghabrahat hai? Koi bhag ke jayega kahan? Sab kuch Allah ke haath hai. Ummahat-ul-Mumineen se pursish! Deen ya duniya? In aayton mein Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi ﷺ ko hukm deta hai ke apni biwiyon ko do baaton mein se ek ki qubuliyat ka ikhtiyar dein. Agar tum duniya par aur is ki raunak par mail hui ho toh aao main tumhein apne nikah se alag karta hoon aur agar tum tangi-tarshi par yahan sabr kar ke Allah ki khushi, Rasul ﷺ ki razamandi chahti ho aur aakhirat ki raunak pasand hai toh sabr-o-sahar se mere sath zindagi guzaro. Allah tumhein wahan ki nemato se sarfraz farmayega. Allah aap ki tamam biwiyon se jo hamari maaein hain khush rahe. Sab ne Allah ko, us ke Rasul ﷺ ko aur dar-e-aakhirat ko hi pasand farmaya jis par Rabb raazi ho aur phir aakhirat ke sath hi duniya ki musarratein bhi ata farmayein. 

Hadhrat Ayesha ka bayan hai ke is aayat ke utarte hi Allah ke Nabi ﷺ mere paas aaye aur mujh se farmane lage ke main ek baat ka tum se zikr karne wala hoon tum jawab mein jaldi na karna apne maa-baap se mashwara kar ke jawab dena. Yeh toh aap jaante hi the ke namumkin hai ke mere walidain mujhe aap se judai karne ka mashwara dein. Phir aap ne yeh aayat parh kar sunayi. Main ne foran jawab diya ke Ya Rasulullah ﷺ is mein maa-baap se mashwara karne ki kaunsi baat hai. Mujhe Allah pasand hai, us ke Rasul ﷺ pasand hain aur aakhirat ka ghar pasand hai. Aap ki aur tamam biwiyon ne bhi wahi kiya jo main ne kiya tha aur riwayat mein hai ke teen dafa Huzoor ﷺ ne Hadhrat Ayesha se farmaya ke dekho baghair apne maa-baap se mashwara kiye koi faisla na kar lena phir jab Huzoor ﷺ ne mera jawab suna toh aap khush ho gaye aur hans diye, phir aap dusri azwaj-e-mutahrat ke hujron mein tashrif le gaye un se pehle hi farma dete the ke Ayesha ؓ ne toh yeh jawab diya hai woh kehti thin yehi jawab hamara bhi hai. Farmati hain ke is ikhtiyar ke baad jab hum ne aap ko ikhtiyar kiya toh ikhtiyar talaq mein shumar nahi hua. 

Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Hadhrat Abu Bakr ne Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hona chaha log aap ke darwaze par baithe hue the aur aap andar tashrif farma the ijazat mili nahi. Itne mein Hadhrat Umar bhi aa gaye ijazat chahi lekin unhein bhi ijazat na mili thodi der mein dono ko yaad farmaya gaya. Gaye dekha ke aap ki azwaj-e-mutahrat aap ke paas baithi hain aur aap khamosh hain. Hadhrat Umar ne kaha dekho main Allah ke paighambar ko hansa deta hoon. Phir kehne lage Ya Rasulullah ﷺ kash ke aap dekhte meri biwi ne aaj mujh se rupiya paisa manga mere paas tha nahi jab zyada zid karne lagein toh main ne uth kar gardan napi. Yeh sunte hi Huzoor ﷺ hans pade aur farmane lage yahan bhi yehi qissa hai dekho yeh sab baithi hui mujh se maal talab kar rahi hain? 

Abu Bakr Hadhrat Ayesha ki taraf lapke aur Umar Hadhrat Hafsa ki taraf aur farmane lage afsos tum Rasulullah ﷺ se woh mangti ho jo aap ke paas nahi. Woh toh kahiye khair guzri jo Rasulullah ﷺ ne unhein rok liya warna ajab nahi dono buzurgh apni apni sahabzadiyon ko marte.

Ab toh sab biwiyan kehne lagin ke acha qusoor hua ab se hum Huzoor ﷺ ko hargaz is tarah tang na karein gi. Ab yeh aatein utrin aur duniya aur aakhirat ki pasandidgi mein ikhtiyar diya gaya. Sab se pehle Aap Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) ke paas gaye unhon ne aakhirat ko pasand kiya jaise ke tafseel waar bayaan guzar chuka. Saath hi darkhwast ki ke Ya Rasulallah (ﷺ) aap apni kisi biwi se yeh na farmaiyega ke main ne aap ko ikhtiyar diya. Aap ne jawab diya ke Allah ne mujhe chupane wala bana kar nahi bheja balki main sikhane wala aasaani karne wala bana kar bheja gaya hoon mujh se toh jo daryaft karegi main saaf saaf bata doon ga. Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka farmaan hai ke talaq ka ikhtiyar nahi diya gaya tha balki duniya ya aakhirat ki tarjeeh ka ikhtiyar diya tha lekin is ki sanad mein bhi inqitaa hai aur yeh aayat ke zahiri lafzon ke bhi khilaf hai kyunke pehli aayat ke aakhir mein saaf maujood hai ke aao main tumhare huqooq ada kar doon aur tumhein rihai de doon is mein ulama-e-kiram ka go ikhtiyar hai ke agar aap talaq de dein toh phir kisi ko un se nikah jaiz hai ya nahi? Lekin sahih qaul yeh hai ke jaiz hai taake is talaq se woh nateeja mile yaani duniya talbi aur duniya ki zeenat-o-ronaq woh unhein hasil ho sake Wallahu A'lam. Jab yeh aayat utri aur jab is ka hukum Huzoor ﷺ ne azwaaj-e-mutahharat ummahaat-ul-mumineen Rizanullahi Alaihin ko sunaya us waqt aap ki nau biwiyan theen. Paanch toh Quraish se talluq rakhti theen Aishah, Hafsah, Saudah aur Umme Salmah (R.A) aur Safiyah bint Huyayy qabilah Nazr se theen, Maimoonah bint Haris Hilaliyah theen, Zainab bint Jahsh Asadiyah theen aur Juwairiyah bint Haris jo Mustaliqiyah theen (R.A) warazahum ajma'een.

Ummahat-ul-Mumineen se pursish! Deen ya duniya? In aayton mein Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi ﷺ ko hukm deta hai ke apni biwiyon ko do baaton mein se ek ki qubuliyat ka ikhtiyar dein. Agar tum duniya par aur is ki raunak par mail hui ho toh aao main tumhein apne nikah se alag karta hoon aur agar tum tangi-tarshi par yahan sabr kar ke Allah ki khushi, Rasul ﷺ ki razamandi chahti ho aur aakhirat ki raunak pasand hai toh sabr-o-sahar se mere sath zindagi guzaro. Allah tumhein wahan ki nemato se sarfraz farmayega. Allah aap ki tamam biwiyon se jo hamari maaein hain khush rahe. Sab ne Allah ko, us ke Rasul ﷺ ko aur dar-e-aakhirat ko hi pasand farmaya jis par Rabb raazi ho aur phir aakhirat ke sath hi duniya ki musarratein bhi ata farmayein. 

Hadhrat Ayesha ka bayan hai ke is aayat ke utarte hi Allah ke Nabi ﷺ mere paas aaye aur mujh se farmane lage ke main ek baat ka tum se zikr karne wala hoon tum jawab mein jaldi na karna apne maa-baap se mashwara kar ke jawab dena. Ummahat-ul-Momineen sab se mu'azzaz qarar de di gayin. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyon ne yani mominon ki maon ne jab Allah ko, us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko aur aakhirat ke pehle ghar ko pasand kar liya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ghar mein woh hamesha ke liye muqarrar ho chukin, to ab Janab-e-Bari Azza Ismuhu is aayat mein unhein wa'z farma raha hai aur batla diya hai ke tumhara mu'amala aam aurton jaisa nahin hai. Agar bilfarz tum se Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki farmanbardari se sartabi aur badkhulqi sarzad hui to tumhein duniya aur aakhirat mein itaab hoga, chunke tumhare bade rutbe hain tumhein gunahon se bilkul door rehna chahiye, warna rutbe ke mutabiq mushkil bhi badh jayegi. Allah par sab baatein sahl aur aasaan hain. Yeh yaad rakhna chahiye ke yeh farman bator-e-shart ke hai aur shart ka hona zaroori nahin hota, jaise farman hai aayat: (La'in ashrakta la-yahbatanna 'amaluka wa la-takunanna minal-khasireen) (Surah (Az-Zumar: 65). Ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) agar tum shirk karoge to tumhare a'maal akaarat ho jayenge. Nabiyon ka zikr kar ke farmaya aayat: (Wa law ashraku la-habita 'anhum ma kanu ya'malun) (Surah (Al-An'am: 88). Agar yeh shirk karein to un ki nekiyan bekar ho jayen aur aayat mein hai: (Qul in kana lir-Rahmani waladun fa-ana awwalul-'abideen) (Surah (Az-Zukhruf: 81). Agar Rahman ke aulad ho to main to sab se pehle aabid hoon aur aayat mein irshad ho raha hai: (Law aradallahu an yattakhiza waladan lastafa mimma yakhluqu ma yasha'u subhanahu huwallahul-wahidul-qahhar) (Surah (Az-Zumar: 4). Yani agar Allah ko aulad manzoor hoti to woh apni makhlooq mein se jise chahta pasand farma leta, woh paak hai, woh yakta aur ek hai, woh ghalib aur sab par hukmran hai. Pas in paanchon aayaton mein shart ke sath bayan hai lekin aisa hua nahin. Na nabiyon se shirk hona mumkin, na sardar-e-rasoolan Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh mumkin, na Allah ki aulad. Isi tarah Ummahat-ul-Momineen ki nisbat bhi jo farmaya ke agar tum mein se koi khuli laghw harkat kare to use dugni saza hogi, is se yeh na samjha jaye ke waqai un mein se kisi ne koi aisi nafarmani aur badkhulqi ki ho. Na'oozubillah.))))

Is aayat mein Allah Ta'ala apne adl-o-fazl ka bayan farma raha hai aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki azwaj-e-mutahharat se khitab kar ke farma raha hai ke tumhari itaat-guzari aur nek-kari par tumhein dugna ajr hai aur tumhare liye jannat mein ba-izzat rozi hai. Kyunke yeh Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath aap ki manzil mein hongi aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki manzil Aala-e-Illiyeen mein hai jo tamam logon se bala-tar hai. Isi ka naam waseela hai. Yeh jannat ki sab se aala aur sab se oonchi manzil hai jis ki chhat Arsh-e-Allah hai.

Irshadat-e-Ilahi ki roshni mein Uswa-e-Ummahat-ul-Momineen. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyon ko aadab sikhata hai aur chunke tamam auratein inhi ke matahat hain, is liye yeh ahkaam sab musalman aurton ke liye hain. Pas farmaya ke tum mein se jo parhezgari karein woh bahut badi fazeelat aur martabe wali hain. Mardon se jab tumhein koi baat karni pade toh aawaz bana kar baat na karo ke jin ke dilon mein rog hai unhein tama' paida ho, balkeh baat achi aur mutabiq-e-dastoor karo. Pas aurton ko ghair mardon se nazakat ke sath khush-aawazi se baatein karni mana hain. Ghul mil kar woh sirf apne khawandon se hi kalam kar sakti hain. Phir farmaya baghair kisi zaroori kaam ke ghar se bahar na niklo. Masjid mein namaz ke liye aana bhi shar'i zaroorat hai jaise ke hadith mein hai Allah ki londiyon ko Allah ki masjidon se na roko, lekin unhein chahiye ke saadgi se jis tarah gharon mein rehti hain isi tarah aaein. Ek riwayat mein hai ke un ke liye un ke ghar behtar hain. Bazzar mein hai ke aurton ne hazir ho kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke jihad waghera ki kul fazeelatein mard hi le gaye, ab aap hamein koi aisa amal batayein jis se hum mujahideen ki fazeelat ko pa sakein. Aap ne farmaya tum mein se jo apne ghar mein parde aur ismat ke sath baithi rahe woh jihad ki fazeelat pa legi. Tirmidhi waghera mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain aurat sar-ta-pa parde ki cheez hai, yeh jab ghar se bahar qadam nikalti hai toh shaitan jhankne lagta hai. Yeh sab se zyada Allah ke qareeb us waqt hoti hai jab yeh apne ghar ke androoni hujre mein ho. Abu Dawood waghera mein hai aurat ki apne ghar ki androoni kothri ki namaz ghar ki namaz se afzal hai aur ghar ki namaz sehan ki namaz se behtar hai. Jahiliyat mein auratein be-parda phira karti thin, ab Islam be-pardagi ko haram qarar deta hai. Naaz se uthla kar chalna mamnoo hai. Dupatta gale mein daal liya lekin use lapeta nahin jis se gardan aur kaanon ke zevar dusron ko nazar aaein, yeh jahiliyat ka banao singhar tha jis se is aayat mein roka gaya hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke Hazrat Nuh (A.S) aur Hazrat Idris (A.S) ki do naslein aabad thin, ek toh pahad par dusre narm zameen par. Pahadiyon ke mard khush-shakal thay auratein siyah-faam thin aur zameen walon ki auratein khubsurat thin aur mardon ke rang saanwale thay. Iblees insani surat ikhtiyar kar ke unhein behkane ke liye narm zameen walon ke paas aaya aur ek shakhs ka ghulam ban kar rehne laga. Phir us ne bansuri waza ki ek cheez banai aur use bajane laga, us ki aawaz par log lattoo ho gaye aur phir bheed lagne lagi aur ek din mele ka muqarrar ho gaya jis mein hazarha mard-o-aurat jama hone lage. Ittefaqan ek din ek pahadi aadmi bhi aa gaya aur un ki aurton ko dekh kar wapas ja kar apne qabile walon mein us ke husn ka charcha karne laga. Ab woh log bakasrat aane lage aur aahista aahista un aurton mardon mein ikhtilat badh gaya aur badkari aur zina-kari ka aam riwaj ho gaya. Yehi jahiliyat ka banao hai jis se yeh aayat rok rahi hai.

In kaamon se rokne ke baad ab kuch ahkaam bayan ho rahe hain ke Allah ki ibadat mein sab se badi ibadat namaz hai us ki pabandi karo aur bahut achi tarah se ise ada karti raho. Isi tarah makhlooq ke sath bhi nek sulook karo. Yani Zakat nikalti raho. In khaas ahkaam ki baja-awari ka hukum de kar phir aam taur par Allah ki aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki farmanbardari karne ka hukum diya. Phir farmaya is Ahl-e-Bait se har qisam ke mail-kuchail ko door karne ka irada Allah Ta'ala ka ho chuka hai woh tumhein bilkul paak saaf kar de ga. Yeh aayat is baat par nass hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyan in aayaton mein Ahl-e-Bait mein dakhil hain. Is liye ke yeh aayat inhi ke bare mein utri hai. Aayat ka shaan-e-nuzool toh aayat ke hukum mein dakhil hota hi hai go baaz kehte hain ke sirf wahi dakhil hota hai aur baaz kehte hain woh bhi aur us ke siwa bhi. Aur yeh dusra qaul hi zyada sahih hai. Hazrat Ikrama (R.H) toh bazaron mein munadi karte phirte the ke yeh aayat Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyon hi ke bare mein khalistan nazil hui hai (Ibn-e-Jarir). Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ikrama toh yahan tak farmate hain ke jo chahe mujh se mubahila kar le. Yeh aayat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki azwaj-e-mutahharat hi ki shaan mein nazil hui hai. Is qaul se agar yeh matlab hai ke shaan-e-nuzool yahi hai aur nahin, toh yeh toh theek hai aur agar is se murad yeh hai ke Ahl-e-Bait mein aur koi in ke siwa dakhil hi nahin toh is mein nazar hai is liye ke ahadees se Ahl-e-Bait mein azwaj-e-mutahharat ke siwa auron ka dakhil hona bhi paya jata hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad aur Tirmidhi mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) subah ki namaz ke liye jab nikalte toh Hazrat Fatima (R.A) ke darwaze par pahunch kar farmate ae Ahl-e-Bait namaz ka waqt aa gaya hai phir isi aayat-e-tathir ki tilawat karte. Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Gharib batlate hain. Ibn-e-Jarir ki ek isi hadees mein saat mahine ka bayan hai. Is mein ek rawi Abu Dawood A'ma Nafee bin Haris kazzab hai. Yeh riwayat theek nahin. Musnad mein hai Shaddad bin Ammar kehte hain main ek din Hazrat Wasila bin Asqa (R.A) ke paas gaya us waqt wahan kuch aur log bhi baithe hue the aur Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka zikr ho raha tha. Woh aap ko bura bhala keh rahe the main ne bhi un ka sath diya jab woh log gaye toh mujh se Hazrat Wasila (R.H) ne farmaya tu ne bhi Hazrat Ali (R.A) ki shaan mein gustakhana alfaaz kahe? Main ne kaha haan main ne bhi sab ki zaban mein zaban milai. Toh farmaya sun main ne jo dekha hai tujhe sunata hoon. Main ek martaba Hazrat Ali (R.A) ke ghar gaya toh maloom hua ke aap (R.A) Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki majlis mein gaye hue hain. Main un ke intezar mein baitha raha thodi der mein dekha ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aa rahe hain aur aap ke sath Hazrat Ali (R.A) aur Hazrat Hasan (R.A) aur Hazrat Hussain (R.A) bhi hain dono bache aap ki ungli thame hue the aap ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) aur Hazrat Fatima (R.A) ko toh apne samne bitha liya aur dono nawason ko apne ghutnon par bitha liya aur ek kapde se dhak liya phir isi aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya ae Allah yeh hain mere Ahl-e-Bait aur mere Ahl-e-Bait zyada haqdar hain.

Doosri riwayat mein itni ziyadati bhi hai ke Hazrat Wathila R.A kehte hain main ne yeh dekh kar kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ main bhi aap ki Ahl-e-Bait mein se hoon? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya tu bhi mere ahl mein se hai. Hazrat Wathila R.A farmate hain Huzoor ﷺ ka yeh farman mere liye bahut hi badi umeed ka hai aur riwayat mein hai Hazrat Wathila R.A farmate hain main Huzoor ﷺ ke paas tha jab Hazrat Ali, Hazrat Fatima, Hazrat Hassan, Hazrat Hussain R.A ajma'een aaye aap ﷺ ne apni chadar un par daal kar farmaya: "Aye Allah! Yeh mere Ahl-e-Bait hain, ya Allah! In se napaki ko door farma aur inhe paak kar de." Main ne kaha main bhi? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya haan tu bhi. Mere nazdeek sab se zyada mera mazboot amal yahi hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Umme Salma R.A farmati hain Huzoor ﷺ mere ghar mein the jab Hazrat Fatima R.A harire ki ek pateeli bhari hui layin. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya apne miyan ko aur apne dono bachon ko bhi bula lo. Chunancha woh bhi aa gaye aur khana shuru hua, aap ﷺ apne bistar par the. Khaibar ki ek chadar aap ﷺ ke neeche bichhi hui thi. Main hujre mein namaz ada kar rahi thi jab yeh aayat utri. Pas Huzoor ﷺ ne chadar inhe odha di aur chadar mein se ek haath nikal kar aasman ki taraf utha kar yeh dua ki ke: "Ilahi! Yeh mere Ahl-e-Bait aur hamayati hain, tu in se napaki door kar aur inhe zahir kar." Main ne apna sar ghar mein se nikal kar kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ main bhi aap sab ke saath hoon? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya yaqeenan tu behtari ki taraf hai, filwaqay tu khair ki taraf hai. Is riwayat ke rawayon mein Atta ke ustad ka naam nahin jo muallim ho sake ke woh kaise rawi hain, baqi rawi siqa hain. Doosri sanad se inhi Hazrat Umme Salma R.A se marwi hai ke ek martaba un ke saath Hazrat Ali R.A ka zikr aaya to aap ﷺ ne farmaya aayat-e-tathir to mere ghar mein utri hai. Aap ﷺ mere haan aaye aur farmaya kisi aur ko aane ki ijazat na dena. Thodi der mein Hazrat Fatima R.A ayin. Ab bhala main beti ko baap se kaise rokti? Phir Hazrat Hassan R.A aaye to nawase ko nana se kaun roke? Phir Hazrat Hussain R.A aaye main ne inhe bhi na roka. Phir Hazrat Ali R.A aaye main inhe bhi na rok saki. Jab yeh sab jama ho gaye to jo chadar Huzoor ﷺ odhe hue the usi mein in sab ko le liya aur kaha: "Ilahi! Yeh mere Ahl-e-Bait hain in se paleedi door kar de aur inhe khoob paak kar de." Pas yeh aayat us waqt utri jabke yeh chadar mein jama ho chuke the, main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ main bhi? Lekin Allah jaanta hai aap ﷺ is par khush na hue aur farmaya tu khair ki taraf hai. Musnad ki aur riwayat mein hai ke mere ghar mein Huzoor ﷺ the jab khadim ne aa kar khabar ki ke Fatima R.A aur Ali R.A aa gaye hain to aap ﷺ ne mujh se farmaya ek taraf ho jao mere Ahl-e-Bait aa gaye hain. Main ghar ke ek kone mein baith gayi jab dono nanhe bache aur yeh dono sahab tashreef laye.

Aap ne dono bachon ko godi mein le liya aur pyar kiya phir ek hath Hazrat Ali R.A ki gardan mein dusra Hazrat Fatima R.A ki gardan mein daal kar un dono ko bhi pyar kiya aur ek siyah chadar sab par daal kar farmaya ya Allah teri taraf na ke aag ki taraf main aur meri Ahl-e-Bait. Main ne kaha main bhi? Farmaya haan tu bhi. Aur riwayat mein hai ke main us waqt ghar ke darwaze par baithi hui thi aur main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ kya main Ahl-e-Bait mein se nahin hoon? Aap ne farmaya tu bhalai ki taraf hai aur Nabi ﷺ ki biwiyon mein se hai aur riwayat mein hai main ne kaha mujhe bhi un ke sath shamil kar lijiye to farmaya tu meri ahl hai. Hazrat Aisha R.A se marwi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ siyah chadar orhay huay ek din subh hi subh niklay aur un charon ko apni chadar talay le kar yeh aayat parhi (Muslim waghera). Hazrat Aisha R.A se ek martaba kisi ne Hazrat Ali R.A ke baray mein sawal kiya to aap ne farmaya woh sab se zyada Rasool Allah ﷺ ke mehboob thay un ke ghar mein aap ki sahibzadi thin jo sab se zyada aap ki mehboob thin. Phir chadar ka waqia bayan farma kar farmaya main ne qareeb ja kar kaha Ya Rasool Allah main bhi aap ke Ahl-e-Bait se hoon aap ne farmaya door raho tum yaqeenan khair par ho (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Hazrat Saeed R.A se marwi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya mere aur un charon ke baray mein yeh aayat utri hai. Aur sanad se yeh Abu Saeed R.A ka apna qaul hona marwi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Saad R.A farmatay hain jab Huzoor ﷺ par wahi utri to aap ne un charon ko apne kapray talay le kar farmaya Ya Rabb yeh mere ahl hain aur mere Ahl-e-Bait hain (Ibn-e-Jareer). Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai Hazrat Yazeed bin Hayyan farmatay hain main aur Haseen bin Seera aur Umar bin Muslima mil kar Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam R.A ke paas gaye. Haseen kehnay lagay ae Zaid aap ko to bohat si bhalaiyan mil gayin. Aap ne Huzoor ﷺ ki ziyarat ki, aap ki hadeesain sunin, aap ke sath jihad kiye, aap ke peechay namazain parhin garz aap ne bohat khair-o-barkat pa liya acha hamain koi hadees to sunao. Aap ne farmaya bhatijay ab meri umar bari ho gayi. Huzoor ﷺ ka zamana door ho gaya. Baaz batain zehan se jati rahin. Ab tum aisa karo jo batain main az-khud bayan karoon unhain tum qabool kar lo warna mujhe takleef na do. Suno! Makkah aur Madine ke darmiyan ek pani ki jagah par jisay Khum kaha jata hai Huzoor ﷺ ne kharay ho kar hamain ek khutba sunaya. Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana aur waz-o-pand ke baad farmaya main ek insaan hoon. Bohat mumkin hai ke mere paas mere Rab ka qasid aaye aur main us ki maan loon main tum mein do cheezain choray ja raha hoon. Pehli to Kitabullah jis par hidayat-o-noor hai. Tum Allah ki kitab ko lo aur usay mazbooti se tham lo phir to aap ne Kitabullah ki bari raghbat dilai aur us ki taraf hamain khoob mutawaja farmaya. Phir farmaya aur meri Ahl-e-Bait ke baray mein Allah ko yaad dilata hoon teen martaba yahi kalma farmaya. To Haseen ne Hazrat Zaid R.A se poocha aap ke Ahl-e-Bait kaun hain? Kya aap ki biwiyan aap ki Ahl-e-Bait nahin hain?

Farmaya aap ki biwiyan toh aap ki Ahl-e-Bait hain hi. Lekin aap ki Ahl-e-Bait woh hain jin par aap ke baad sadaqa khana haram hai, poocha woh kaun hain? Farmaya Aal-e-Ali, Aal-e-Aqeel, Aal-e-Jafar, Aal-e-Abbas R.A. Poocha kya in sab par aap ke baad sadaqa haram hai? Kaha haan! Dusri sanad se yeh bhi marwi hai ke main ne poocha kya aap ki biwiyan bhi Ahl-e-Bait mein dakhil hain? Kaha nahin qasam hai Allah ki, biwi ka toh yeh haal hai ke woh apne khawand ke paas go arsa-e-daraz se ho lekin phir agar woh talaq de de toh apne maike mein aur apni qaum mein chali jati hai. Aap ke Ahl-e-Bait aap ki asal aur asaba hain jin par aap ke baad sadaqa haram hai. Is riwayat mein yahi hai lekin pehli riwayat hi aula hai aur isi ko lena theek hai aur is dusri mein jo hai is se murad sirf hadith mein jin Ahl-e-Bait ka zikr hai woh hai kyunke wahan woh Aal murad hai jin par sadaqa khori haram hai ya yeh ke murad sirf biwiyan nahin hain balkay woh ma'a aap ki aur Aal ke hain. Yahi baat zyada rajeh hai aur is se is riwayat aur is se pehle ki riwayat mein jama bhi ho jati hai aur Quran aur pehli ahadith mein bhi jama ho jati hai lekin yeh is surat mein ke in ahadith ki sehat ko tasleem kar liya jaye. Kyunke in ki ba'az asnadon mein nazar hai, Wallahu Ta'ala A'lam. Jis shakhs ko noor-e-ma'arifat hasil ho aur Quran mein tadabbur karne ki aadat ho woh yaqeenan baik nigah jaan le ga ke is aayat mein Huzoor ﷺ ki biwiyan bila-shubk-o-shuba dakhil hain is liye ke upar se kalam hi un ke sath aur unhi ke bare mein chal raha hai. Yahi wajah hai ke is ke baad hi farmaya ke Allah ki aayatein aur Rasool ﷺ ki baatein jin ka dars tumhare gharon mein ho raha hai unhein yaad rakho aur un par amal karo. Pas Allah ki aayat aur hikmat se murad ba-qaul-e-Hazrat Qatada waghera Kitab-o-Sunnat hai. Pas yeh khaas khusoosiyat hai jo un ke siwa kisi aur ko nahin mili ke un ke gharon mein Allah ki wahi aur Rahmat-e-Ilahi nazil hua karti hai aur un mein bhi yeh sharaf Hazrat Umm-ul-Momineen Aisha Siddiqa R.A ko bator-e-aula aur sab se zyada hasil hai kyunke hadith-e-shareef mein saaf warid hai ke kisi aurat ke bistar par Huzoor ﷺ ki taraf wahi nahin aati bajuz aap ﷺ ke bistare ke, yeh is liye bhi ke Huzoor ﷺ ne aap ke siwa kisi aur bakira se nikah nahin kiya tha. Un ka bistar bajuz Rasool Allah ﷺ ke aur kisi ke liye na tha. Pas is ziyadati-e-darja aur bulandi-e-martaba ki woh sahih taur par mustahiq thin. Haan jabke aap ki biwiyan aap ki Ahl-e-Bait huin toh aap ke qareebi rishte-dar bator-e-aula aap ki Ahl-e-Bait hain. Jaise hadith mein guzar chuka ke mere Ahl-e-Bait zyada haqdar hain. Is ki misaal mein yeh aayat theek taur par pesh ho sakti hai: (Lamasjidun ussisa 'alat-taqwa min awwali yawmin ahaqqu an taqooma feehi, feehi rijalun yuhibboona an yatatahharoo, wallahu yuhibbul muttahhireen) (Surah (At-Tawbah: 108) ke yeh utri toh hai Masjid-e-Quba ke bare mein jaisa ke saaf saaf ahadith mein maujood hai.

Lekin Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai ke jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hua ke is masjid se kaun si masjid murad hai? To Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya woh meri hi masjid hai yani Masjid-e-Nabvi. Pas jo sifat Masjid-e-Quba mein thi wahi sifat chunke Masjid-e-Nabvi mein bhi hai is liye is masjid ko bhi isi naam se is aayat ke tehat dakhil kardiya. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Ali (R.A) ki shahadat ke baad Hazrat Hasan (R.A) ko khalifa banaya gaya. Aap (R.A) ek martaba namaz padha rahe the ke Banu Asad ka ek shakhs kood kar aaya aur sajde ki halat mein aap ke jism mein khanjar ghonp diya jo aap ke narm gosht mein laga jis se aap kai mahine bimar rahe jab achhe ho gaye to masjid mein aaye minbar par baith kar khutba padha jis mein farmaya ae Iraqiyo! Hamare bare mein Allah ka khauf kiya karo hum tumhare hakim hain, tumhare mehman hain, hum Ahl-e-Bait hain jin ke bare mein aayat (وَقَرْنَ فِيْ بُيُوْتِكُنَّ وَلَا تَبَرَّجْنَ تَــبَرُّجَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ الْاُوْلٰى وَاَقِمْنَ الصَّلٰوةَ وَاٰتِيْنَ الزَّكٰوةَ وَاَطِعْنَ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوْلَهٗ ۭ اِنَّمَا يُرِيْدُ اللّٰهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ الرِّجْسَ اَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيْرًا 33؀ۚ) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 33) utri hai. Is par aap ne khoob zor diya aur is mazmoon ko baar baar ada kiya jis se masjid wale rone lage. Ek martaba aap ne ek Shami se farmaya tha kya tu ne Surah Ahzab ki aayat-e-tathir nahin padhi? Us ne kaha haan kya is se murad tum ho? Farmaya haan! Allah Ta'ala bade lutf-o-karam wala, bade ilm aur poori khabar wala hai. Us ne jaan liya ke tum us ke lutf ke ahl ho, is liye us ne tumhein yeh ne'matein ata farmayin aur yeh fazilatein tumhein dein. Pas is aayat ke ma'ani mutabiq Tafsir-e-Ibn-e-Jarir yeh hue ke ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyo! Allah ki jo ne'mat tum par hai use tum yaad karo ke us ne tumhein in gharon mein kiya jahan Allah ki aayat aur hikmat padhi jati hai tumhein Allah Ta'ala ki is ne'mat par us ka shukr karna chahiye aur us ki hamd padhni chahiye ke tum par Allah ka lutf-o-karam hai ke us ne tumhein in gharon mein abad kiya. Hikmat se murad Sunnat-o-Hadith hai. Allah anjam tak se khabardar hai. Us ne apne poore aur sahih ilm se jaanch kar tumhein apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyan banne ke liye muntakhab kar liya. Pas darasal yeh bhi Allah ka tum par ehsan hai jo Latif-o-Khabir hai har cheez ke juz-o-kul se.))

Irshadat-e-Ilahi ki roshni mein Uswa-e-Ummahat-ul-Momineen. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyon ko aadab sikhata hai aur chunke tamam auratein inhi ke matahat hain, is liye yeh ahkaam sab musalman aurton ke liye hain. Pas farmaya ke tum mein se jo parhezgari karein woh bahut badi fazeelat aur martabe wali hain. Mardon se jab tumhein koi baat karni pade toh aawaz bana kar baat na karo ke jin ke dilon mein rog hai unhein tama' paida ho, balkeh baat achi aur mutabiq-e-dastoor karo. Pas aurton ko ghair mardon se nazakat ke sath khush-aawazi se baatein karni mana hain. Ghul mil kar woh sirf apne khawandon se hi kalam kar sakti hain. Phir farmaya baghair kisi zaroori kaam ke ghar se bahar na niklo. Masjid mein namaz ke liye aana bhi shar'i zaroorat hai jaise ke hadith mein hai Allah ki londiyon ko Allah ki masjidon se na roko, lekin unhein chahiye ke saadgi se jis tarah gharon mein rehti hain isi tarah aaein. Ek riwayat mein hai ke un ke liye un ke ghar behtar hain. Bazzar mein hai ke aurton ne hazir ho kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke jihad waghera ki kul fazeelatein mard hi le gaye, ab aap hamein koi aisa amal batayein jis se hum mujahideen ki fazeelat ko pa sakein. Aap ne farmaya tum mein se jo apne ghar mein parde aur ismat ke sath baithi rahe woh jihad ki fazeelat pa legi. Tirmidhi waghera mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain aurat sar-ta-pa parde ki cheez hai, yeh jab ghar se bahar qadam nikalti hai toh shaitan jhankne lagta hai. Yeh sab se zyada Allah ke qareeb us waqt hoti hai jab yeh apne ghar ke androoni hujre mein ho. Abu Dawood waghera mein hai aurat ki apne ghar ki androoni kothri ki namaz ghar ki namaz se afzal hai aur ghar ki namaz sehan ki namaz se behtar hai. Jahiliyat mein auratein be-parda phira karti thin, ab Islam be-pardagi ko haram qarar deta hai. Naaz se uthla kar chalna mamnoo hai. Dupatta gale mein daal liya lekin use lapeta nahin jis se gardan aur kaanon ke zevar dusron ko nazar aaein, yeh jahiliyat ka banao singhar tha jis se is aayat mein roka gaya hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke Hazrat Nuh (A.S) aur Hazrat Idris (A.S) ki do naslein aabad thin, ek toh pahad par dusre narm zameen par. Pahadiyon ke mard khush-shakal thay auratein siyah-faam thin aur zameen walon ki auratein khubsurat thin aur mardon ke rang saanwale thay. Iblees insani surat ikhtiyar kar ke unhein behkane ke liye narm zameen walon ke paas aaya aur ek shakhs ka ghulam ban kar rehne laga. Phir us ne bansuri waza ki ek cheez banai aur use bajane laga, us ki aawaz par log lattoo ho gaye aur phir bheed lagne lagi aur ek din mele ka muqarrar ho gaya jis mein hazarha mard-o-aurat jama hone lage. Ittefaqan ek din ek pahadi aadmi bhi aa gaya aur un ki aurton ko dekh kar wapas ja kar apne qabile walon mein us ke husn ka charcha karne laga. Ab woh log bakasrat aane lage aur aahista aahista un aurton mardon mein ikhtilat badh gaya aur badkari aur zina-kari ka aam riwaj ho gaya. Yehi jahiliyat ka banao hai jis se yeh aayat rok rahi hai.

In kaamon se rokne ke baad ab kuch ahkaam bayan ho rahe hain ke Allah ki ibadat mein sab se badi ibadat namaz hai us ki pabandi karo aur bahut achi tarah se ise ada karti raho. Isi tarah makhlooq ke sath bhi nek sulook karo. Yani Zakat nikalti raho. In khaas ahkaam ki baja-awari ka hukum de kar phir aam taur par Allah ki aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki farmanbardari karne ka hukum diya. Phir farmaya is Ahl-e-Bait se har qisam ke mail-kuchail ko door karne ka irada Allah Ta'ala ka ho chuka hai woh tumhein bilkul paak saaf kar de ga. Yeh aayat is baat par nass hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyan in aayaton mein Ahl-e-Bait mein dakhil hain. Is liye ke yeh aayat inhi ke bare mein utri hai. Aayat ka shaan-e-nuzool toh aayat ke hukum mein dakhil hota hi hai go baaz kehte hain ke sirf wahi dakhil hota hai aur baaz kehte hain woh bhi aur us ke siwa bhi. Aur yeh dusra qaul hi zyada sahih hai. Hazrat Ikrama (R.H) toh bazaron mein munadi karte phirte the ke yeh aayat Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyon hi ke bare mein khalistan nazil hui hai (Ibn-e-Jarir). Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ikrama toh yahan tak farmate hain ke jo chahe mujh se mubahila kar le. Yeh aayat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki azwaj-e-mutahharat hi ki shaan mein nazil hui hai. Is qaul se agar yeh matlab hai ke shaan-e-nuzool yahi hai aur nahin, toh yeh toh theek hai aur agar is se murad yeh hai ke Ahl-e-Bait mein aur koi in ke siwa dakhil hi nahin toh is mein nazar hai is liye ke ahadees se Ahl-e-Bait mein azwaj-e-mutahharat ke siwa auron ka dakhil hona bhi paya jata hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad aur Tirmidhi mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) subah ki namaz ke liye jab nikalte toh Hazrat Fatima (R.A) ke darwaze par pahunch kar farmate ae Ahl-e-Bait namaz ka waqt aa gaya hai phir isi aayat-e-tathir ki tilawat karte. Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Gharib batlate hain. Ibn-e-Jarir ki ek isi hadees mein saat mahine ka bayan hai. Is mein ek rawi Abu Dawood A'ma Nafee bin Haris kazzab hai. Yeh riwayat theek nahin. Musnad mein hai Shaddad bin Ammar kehte hain main ek din Hazrat Wasila bin Asqa (R.A) ke paas gaya us waqt wahan kuch aur log bhi baithe hue the aur Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka zikr ho raha tha. Woh aap ko bura bhala keh rahe the main ne bhi un ka sath diya jab woh log gaye toh mujh se Hazrat Wasila (R.H) ne farmaya tu ne bhi Hazrat Ali (R.A) ki shaan mein gustakhana alfaaz kahe? Main ne kaha haan main ne bhi sab ki zaban mein zaban milai. Toh farmaya sun main ne jo dekha hai tujhe sunata hoon. Main ek martaba Hazrat Ali (R.A) ke ghar gaya toh maloom hua ke aap (R.A) Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki majlis mein gaye hue hain. Main un ke intezar mein baitha raha thodi der mein dekha ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aa rahe hain aur aap ke sath Hazrat Ali (R.A) aur Hazrat Hasan (R.A) aur Hazrat Hussain (R.A) bhi hain dono bache aap ki ungli thame hue the aap ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) aur Hazrat Fatima (R.A) ko toh apne samne bitha liya aur dono nawason ko apne ghutnon par bitha liya aur ek kapde se dhak liya phir isi aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya ae Allah yeh hain mere Ahl-e-Bait aur mere Ahl-e-Bait zyada haqdar hain.

Doosri riwayat mein itni ziyadati bhi hai ke Hazrat Wathila R.A kehte hain main ne yeh dekh kar kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ main bhi aap ki Ahl-e-Bait mein se hoon? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya tu bhi mere ahl mein se hai. Hazrat Wathila R.A farmate hain Huzoor ﷺ ka yeh farman mere liye bahut hi badi umeed ka hai aur riwayat mein hai Hazrat Wathila R.A farmate hain main Huzoor ﷺ ke paas tha jab Hazrat Ali, Hazrat Fatima, Hazrat Hassan, Hazrat Hussain R.A ajma'een aaye aap ﷺ ne apni chadar un par daal kar farmaya: "Aye Allah! Yeh mere Ahl-e-Bait hain, ya Allah! In se napaki ko door farma aur inhe paak kar de." Main ne kaha main bhi? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya haan tu bhi. Mere nazdeek sab se zyada mera mazboot amal yahi hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Umme Salma R.A farmati hain Huzoor ﷺ mere ghar mein the jab Hazrat Fatima R.A harire ki ek pateeli bhari hui layin. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya apne miyan ko aur apne dono bachon ko bhi bula lo. Chunancha woh bhi aa gaye aur khana shuru hua, aap ﷺ apne bistar par the. Khaibar ki ek chadar aap ﷺ ke neeche bichhi hui thi. Main hujre mein namaz ada kar rahi thi jab yeh aayat utri. Pas Huzoor ﷺ ne chadar inhe odha di aur chadar mein se ek haath nikal kar aasman ki taraf utha kar yeh dua ki ke: "Ilahi! Yeh mere Ahl-e-Bait aur hamayati hain, tu in se napaki door kar aur inhe zahir kar." Main ne apna sar ghar mein se nikal kar kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ main bhi aap sab ke saath hoon? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya yaqeenan tu behtari ki taraf hai, filwaqay tu khair ki taraf hai. Is riwayat ke rawayon mein Atta ke ustad ka naam nahin jo muallim ho sake ke woh kaise rawi hain, baqi rawi siqa hain. Doosri sanad se inhi Hazrat Umme Salma R.A se marwi hai ke ek martaba un ke saath Hazrat Ali R.A ka zikr aaya to aap ﷺ ne farmaya aayat-e-tathir to mere ghar mein utri hai. Aap ﷺ mere haan aaye aur farmaya kisi aur ko aane ki ijazat na dena. Thodi der mein Hazrat Fatima R.A ayin. Ab bhala main beti ko baap se kaise rokti? Phir Hazrat Hassan R.A aaye to nawase ko nana se kaun roke? Phir Hazrat Hussain R.A aaye main ne inhe bhi na roka. Phir Hazrat Ali R.A aaye main inhe bhi na rok saki. Jab yeh sab jama ho gaye to jo chadar Huzoor ﷺ odhe hue the usi mein in sab ko le liya aur kaha: "Ilahi! Yeh mere Ahl-e-Bait hain in se paleedi door kar de aur inhe khoob paak kar de." Pas yeh aayat us waqt utri jabke yeh chadar mein jama ho chuke the, main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ main bhi? Lekin Allah jaanta hai aap ﷺ is par khush na hue aur farmaya tu khair ki taraf hai. Musnad ki aur riwayat mein hai ke mere ghar mein Huzoor ﷺ the jab khadim ne aa kar khabar ki ke Fatima R.A aur Ali R.A aa gaye hain to aap ﷺ ne mujh se farmaya ek taraf ho jao mere Ahl-e-Bait aa gaye hain. Main ghar ke ek kone mein baith gayi jab dono nanhe bache aur yeh dono sahab tashreef laye.

Aap ne dono bachon ko godi mein le liya aur pyar kiya phir ek hath Hazrat Ali R.A ki gardan mein dusra Hazrat Fatima R.A ki gardan mein daal kar un dono ko bhi pyar kiya aur ek siyah chadar sab par daal kar farmaya ya Allah teri taraf na ke aag ki taraf main aur meri Ahl-e-Bait. Main ne kaha main bhi? Farmaya haan tu bhi. Aur riwayat mein hai ke main us waqt ghar ke darwaze par baithi hui thi aur main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ kya main Ahl-e-Bait mein se nahin hoon? Aap ne farmaya tu bhalai ki taraf hai aur Nabi ﷺ ki biwiyon mein se hai aur riwayat mein hai main ne kaha mujhe bhi un ke sath shamil kar lijiye to farmaya tu meri ahl hai. Hazrat Aisha R.A se marwi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ siyah chadar orhay huay ek din subh hi subh niklay aur un charon ko apni chadar talay le kar yeh aayat parhi (Muslim waghera). Hazrat Aisha R.A se ek martaba kisi ne Hazrat Ali R.A ke baray mein sawal kiya to aap ne farmaya woh sab se zyada Rasool Allah ﷺ ke mehboob thay un ke ghar mein aap ki sahibzadi thin jo sab se zyada aap ki mehboob thin. Phir chadar ka waqia bayan farma kar farmaya main ne qareeb ja kar kaha Ya Rasool Allah main bhi aap ke Ahl-e-Bait se hoon aap ne farmaya door raho tum yaqeenan khair par ho (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Hazrat Saeed R.A se marwi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya mere aur un charon ke baray mein yeh aayat utri hai. Aur sanad se yeh Abu Saeed R.A ka apna qaul hona marwi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Saad R.A farmatay hain jab Huzoor ﷺ par wahi utri to aap ne un charon ko apne kapray talay le kar farmaya Ya Rabb yeh mere ahl hain aur mere Ahl-e-Bait hain (Ibn-e-Jareer). Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai Hazrat Yazeed bin Hayyan farmatay hain main aur Haseen bin Seera aur Umar bin Muslima mil kar Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam R.A ke paas gaye. Haseen kehnay lagay ae Zaid aap ko to bohat si bhalaiyan mil gayin. Aap ne Huzoor ﷺ ki ziyarat ki, aap ki hadeesain sunin, aap ke sath jihad kiye, aap ke peechay namazain parhin garz aap ne bohat khair-o-barkat pa liya acha hamain koi hadees to sunao. Aap ne farmaya bhatijay ab meri umar bari ho gayi. Huzoor ﷺ ka zamana door ho gaya. Baaz batain zehan se jati rahin. Ab tum aisa karo jo batain main az-khud bayan karoon unhain tum qabool kar lo warna mujhe takleef na do. Suno! Makkah aur Madine ke darmiyan ek pani ki jagah par jisay Khum kaha jata hai Huzoor ﷺ ne kharay ho kar hamain ek khutba sunaya. Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana aur waz-o-pand ke baad farmaya main ek insaan hoon. Bohat mumkin hai ke mere paas mere Rab ka qasid aaye aur main us ki maan loon main tum mein do cheezain choray ja raha hoon. Pehli to Kitabullah jis par hidayat-o-noor hai. Tum Allah ki kitab ko lo aur usay mazbooti se tham lo phir to aap ne Kitabullah ki bari raghbat dilai aur us ki taraf hamain khoob mutawaja farmaya. Phir farmaya aur meri Ahl-e-Bait ke baray mein Allah ko yaad dilata hoon teen martaba yahi kalma farmaya. To Haseen ne Hazrat Zaid R.A se poocha aap ke Ahl-e-Bait kaun hain? Kya aap ki biwiyan aap ki Ahl-e-Bait nahin hain?

Farmaya aap ki biwiyan toh aap ki Ahl-e-Bait hain hi. Lekin aap ki Ahl-e-Bait woh hain jin par aap ke baad sadaqa khana haram hai, poocha woh kaun hain? Farmaya Aal-e-Ali, Aal-e-Aqeel, Aal-e-Jafar, Aal-e-Abbas R.A. Poocha kya in sab par aap ke baad sadaqa haram hai? Kaha haan! Dusri sanad se yeh bhi marwi hai ke main ne poocha kya aap ki biwiyan bhi Ahl-e-Bait mein dakhil hain? Kaha nahin qasam hai Allah ki, biwi ka toh yeh haal hai ke woh apne khawand ke paas go arsa-e-daraz se ho lekin phir agar woh talaq de de toh apne maike mein aur apni qaum mein chali jati hai. Aap ke Ahl-e-Bait aap ki asal aur asaba hain jin par aap ke baad sadaqa haram hai. Is riwayat mein yahi hai lekin pehli riwayat hi aula hai aur isi ko lena theek hai aur is dusri mein jo hai is se murad sirf hadith mein jin Ahl-e-Bait ka zikr hai woh hai kyunke wahan woh Aal murad hai jin par sadaqa khori haram hai ya yeh ke murad sirf biwiyan nahin hain balkay woh ma'a aap ki aur Aal ke hain. Yahi baat zyada rajeh hai aur is se is riwayat aur is se pehle ki riwayat mein jama bhi ho jati hai aur Quran aur pehli ahadith mein bhi jama ho jati hai lekin yeh is surat mein ke in ahadith ki sehat ko tasleem kar liya jaye. Kyunke in ki ba'az asnadon mein nazar hai, Wallahu Ta'ala A'lam. Jis shakhs ko noor-e-ma'arifat hasil ho aur Quran mein tadabbur karne ki aadat ho woh yaqeenan baik nigah jaan le ga ke is aayat mein Huzoor ﷺ ki biwiyan bila-shubk-o-shuba dakhil hain is liye ke upar se kalam hi un ke sath aur unhi ke bare mein chal raha hai. Yahi wajah hai ke is ke baad hi farmaya ke Allah ki aayatein aur Rasool ﷺ ki baatein jin ka dars tumhare gharon mein ho raha hai unhein yaad rakho aur un par amal karo. Pas Allah ki aayat aur hikmat se murad ba-qaul-e-Hazrat Qatada waghera Kitab-o-Sunnat hai. Pas yeh khaas khusoosiyat hai jo un ke siwa kisi aur ko nahin mili ke un ke gharon mein Allah ki wahi aur Rahmat-e-Ilahi nazil hua karti hai aur un mein bhi yeh sharaf Hazrat Umm-ul-Momineen Aisha Siddiqa R.A ko bator-e-aula aur sab se zyada hasil hai kyunke hadith-e-shareef mein saaf warid hai ke kisi aurat ke bistar par Huzoor ﷺ ki taraf wahi nahin aati bajuz aap ﷺ ke bistare ke, yeh is liye bhi ke Huzoor ﷺ ne aap ke siwa kisi aur bakira se nikah nahin kiya tha. Un ka bistar bajuz Rasool Allah ﷺ ke aur kisi ke liye na tha. Pas is ziyadati-e-darja aur bulandi-e-martaba ki woh sahih taur par mustahiq thin. Haan jabke aap ki biwiyan aap ki Ahl-e-Bait huin toh aap ke qareebi rishte-dar bator-e-aula aap ki Ahl-e-Bait hain. Jaise hadith mein guzar chuka ke mere Ahl-e-Bait zyada haqdar hain. Is ki misaal mein yeh aayat theek taur par pesh ho sakti hai: (Lamasjidun ussisa 'alat-taqwa min awwali yawmin ahaqqu an taqooma feehi, feehi rijalun yuhibboona an yatatahharoo, wallahu yuhibbul muttahhireen) (Surah (At-Tawbah: 108) ke yeh utri toh hai Masjid-e-Quba ke bare mein jaisa ke saaf saaf ahadith mein maujood hai.

Lekin Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai ke jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hua ke is masjid se kaun si masjid murad hai? To Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya woh meri hi masjid hai yani Masjid-e-Nabvi.
