Pas jo sifat Masjid-e-Quba mein thi wahi sifat chunke Masjid-e-Nabvi mein bhi hai is liye is masjid ko bhi isi naam se is aayat ke tehat dakhil kardiya. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Ali (R.A) ki shahadat ke baad Hazrat Hasan (R.A) ko khalifa banaya gaya. Aap (R.A) ek martaba namaz padha rahe the ke Banu Asad ka ek shakhs kood kar aaya aur sajde ki halat mein aap ke jism mein khanjar ghonp diya jo aap ke narm gosht mein laga jis se aap kai mahine bimar rahe jab achhe ho gaye to masjid mein aaye minbar par baith kar khutba padha jis mein farmaya ae Iraqiyo! Hamare bare mein Allah ka khauf kiya karo hum tumhare hakim hain, tumhare mehman hain, hum Ahl-e-Bait hain jin ke bare mein aayat (وَقَرْنَ فِيْ بُيُوْتِكُنَّ وَلَا تَبَرَّجْنَ تَــبَرُّجَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ الْاُوْلٰى وَاَقِمْنَ الصَّلٰوةَ وَاٰتِيْنَ الزَّكٰوةَ وَاَطِعْنَ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوْلَهٗ ۭ اِنَّمَا يُرِيْدُ اللّٰهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ الرِّجْسَ اَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيْرًا 33؀ۚ) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 33) utri hai. Is par aap ne khoob zor diya aur is mazmoon ko baar baar ada kiya jis se masjid wale rone lage. Ek martaba aap ne ek Shami se farmaya tha kya tu ne Surah Ahzab ki aayat-e-tathir nahin padhi? Us ne kaha haan kya is se murad tum ho? Farmaya haan! Allah Ta'ala bade lutf-o-karam wala, bade ilm aur poori khabar wala hai. Us ne jaan liya ke tum us ke lutf ke ahl ho, is liye us ne tumhein yeh ne'matein ata farmayin aur yeh fazilatein tumhein dein. Pas is aayat ke ma'ani mutabiq Tafsir-e-Ibn-e-Jarir yeh hue ke ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyo! Allah ki jo ne'mat tum par hai use tum yaad karo ke us ne tumhein in gharon mein kiya jahan Allah ki aayat aur hikmat padhi jati hai tumhein Allah Ta'ala ki is ne'mat par us ka shukr karna chahiye aur us ki hamd padhni chahiye ke tum par Allah ka lutf-o-karam hai ke us ne tumhein in gharon mein abad kiya. Hikmat se murad Sunnat-o-Hadith hai. Allah anjam tak se khabardar hai. Us ne apne poore aur sahih ilm se jaanch kar tumhein apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyan banne ke liye muntakhab kar liya. Pas darasal yeh bhi Allah ka tum par ehsan hai jo Latif-o-Khabir hai har cheez ke juz-o-kul se.))

Irshadat-e-Ilahi ki roshni mein Uswa-e-Ummahat-ul-Momineen. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyon ko aadab sikhata hai aur chunke tamam auratein inhi ke matahat hain, is liye yeh ahkaam sab musalman aurton ke liye hain. Pas farmaya ke tum mein se jo parhezgari karein woh bahut badi fazeelat aur martabe wali hain. Mardon se jab tumhein koi baat karni pade toh aawaz bana kar baat na karo ke jin ke dilon mein rog hai unhein tama' paida ho, balkeh baat achi aur mutabiq-e-dastoor karo. Pas aurton ko ghair mardon se nazakat ke sath khush-aawazi se baatein karni mana hain. Ghul mil kar woh sirf apne khawandon se hi kalam kar sakti hain. Phir farmaya baghair kisi zaroori kaam ke ghar se bahar na niklo. Masjid mein namaz ke liye aana bhi shar'i zaroorat hai jaise ke hadith mein hai Allah ki londiyon ko Allah ki masjidon se na roko, lekin unhein chahiye ke saadgi se jis tarah gharon mein rehti hain isi tarah aaein. Ek riwayat mein hai ke un ke liye un ke ghar behtar hain. Bazzar mein hai ke aurton ne hazir ho kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke jihad waghera ki kul fazeelatein mard hi le gaye, ab aap hamein koi aisa amal batayein jis se hum mujahideen ki fazeelat ko pa sakein. Aap ne farmaya tum mein se jo apne ghar mein parde aur ismat ke sath baithi rahe woh jihad ki fazeelat pa legi. Tirmidhi waghera mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain aurat sar-ta-pa parde ki cheez hai, yeh jab ghar se bahar qadam nikalti hai toh shaitan jhankne lagta hai. Yeh sab se zyada Allah ke qareeb us waqt hoti hai jab yeh apne ghar ke androoni hujre mein ho. Abu Dawood waghera mein hai aurat ki apne ghar ki androoni kothri ki namaz ghar ki namaz se afzal hai aur ghar ki namaz sehan ki namaz se behtar hai. Jahiliyat mein auratein be-parda phira karti thin, ab Islam be-pardagi ko haram qarar deta hai. Naaz se uthla kar chalna mamnoo hai. Dupatta gale mein daal liya lekin use lapeta nahin jis se gardan aur kaanon ke zevar dusron ko nazar aaein, yeh jahiliyat ka banao singhar tha jis se is aayat mein roka gaya hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke Hazrat Nuh (A.S) aur Hazrat Idris (A.S) ki do naslein aabad thin, ek toh pahad par dusre narm zameen par. Pahadiyon ke mard khush-shakal thay auratein siyah-faam thin aur zameen walon ki auratein khubsurat thin aur mardon ke rang saanwale thay. Iblees insani surat ikhtiyar kar ke unhein behkane ke liye narm zameen walon ke paas aaya aur ek shakhs ka ghulam ban kar rehne laga. Phir us ne bansuri waza ki ek cheez banai aur use bajane laga, us ki aawaz par log lattoo ho gaye aur phir bheed lagne lagi aur ek din mele ka muqarrar ho gaya jis mein hazarha mard-o-aurat jama hone lage. Ittefaqan ek din ek pahadi aadmi bhi aa gaya aur un ki aurton ko dekh kar wapas ja kar apne qabile walon mein us ke husn ka charcha karne laga. Ab woh log bakasrat aane lage aur aahista aahista un aurton mardon mein ikhtilat badh gaya aur badkari aur zina-kari ka aam riwaj ho gaya. Yehi jahiliyat ka banao hai jis se yeh aayat rok rahi hai.

In kaamon se rokne ke baad ab kuch ahkaam bayan ho rahe hain ke Allah ki ibadat mein sab se badi ibadat namaz hai us ki pabandi karo aur bahut achi tarah se ise ada karti raho. Isi tarah makhlooq ke sath bhi nek sulook karo. Yani Zakat nikalti raho. In khaas ahkaam ki baja-awari ka hukum de kar phir aam taur par Allah ki aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki farmanbardari karne ka hukum diya. Phir farmaya is Ahl-e-Bait se har qisam ke mail-kuchail ko door karne ka irada Allah Ta'ala ka ho chuka hai woh tumhein bilkul paak saaf kar de ga. Yeh aayat is baat par nass hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyan in aayaton mein Ahl-e-Bait mein dakhil hain. Is liye ke yeh aayat inhi ke bare mein utri hai. Aayat ka shaan-e-nuzool toh aayat ke hukum mein dakhil hota hi hai go baaz kehte hain ke sirf wahi dakhil hota hai aur baaz kehte hain woh bhi aur us ke siwa bhi. Aur yeh dusra qaul hi zyada sahih hai. Hazrat Ikrama (R.H) toh bazaron mein munadi karte phirte the ke yeh aayat Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyon hi ke bare mein khalistan nazil hui hai (Ibn-e-Jarir). Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ikrama toh yahan tak farmate hain ke jo chahe mujh se mubahila kar le. Yeh aayat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki azwaj-e-mutahharat hi ki shaan mein nazil hui hai. Is qaul se agar yeh matlab hai ke shaan-e-nuzool yahi hai aur nahin, toh yeh toh theek hai aur agar is se murad yeh hai ke Ahl-e-Bait mein aur koi in ke siwa dakhil hi nahin toh is mein nazar hai is liye ke ahadees se Ahl-e-Bait mein azwaj-e-mutahharat ke siwa auron ka dakhil hona bhi paya jata hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad aur Tirmidhi mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) subah ki namaz ke liye jab nikalte toh Hazrat Fatima (R.A) ke darwaze par pahunch kar farmate ae Ahl-e-Bait namaz ka waqt aa gaya hai phir isi aayat-e-tathir ki tilawat karte. Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Gharib batlate hain. Ibn-e-Jarir ki ek isi hadees mein saat mahine ka bayan hai. Is mein ek rawi Abu Dawood A'ma Nafee bin Haris kazzab hai. Yeh riwayat theek nahin. Musnad mein hai Shaddad bin Ammar kehte hain main ek din Hazrat Wasila bin Asqa (R.A) ke paas gaya us waqt wahan kuch aur log bhi baithe hue the aur Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka zikr ho raha tha. Woh aap ko bura bhala keh rahe the main ne bhi un ka sath diya jab woh log gaye toh mujh se Hazrat Wasila (R.H) ne farmaya tu ne bhi Hazrat Ali (R.A) ki shaan mein gustakhana alfaaz kahe? Main ne kaha haan main ne bhi sab ki zaban mein zaban milai. Toh farmaya sun main ne jo dekha hai tujhe sunata hoon. Main ek martaba Hazrat Ali (R.A) ke ghar gaya toh maloom hua ke aap (R.A) Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki majlis mein gaye hue hain. Main un ke intezar mein baitha raha thodi der mein dekha ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aa rahe hain aur aap ke sath Hazrat Ali (R.A) aur Hazrat Hasan (R.A) aur Hazrat Hussain (R.A) bhi hain dono bache aap ki ungli thame hue the aap ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) aur Hazrat Fatima (R.A) ko toh apne samne bitha liya aur dono nawason ko apne ghutnon par bitha liya aur ek kapde se dhak liya phir isi aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya ae Allah yeh hain mere Ahl-e-Bait aur mere Ahl-e-Bait zyada haqdar hain.

Doosri riwayat mein itni ziyadati bhi hai ke Hazrat Wathila R.A kehte hain main ne yeh dekh kar kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ main bhi aap ki Ahl-e-Bait mein se hoon? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya tu bhi mere ahl mein se hai. Hazrat Wathila R.A farmate hain Huzoor ﷺ ka yeh farman mere liye bahut hi badi umeed ka hai aur riwayat mein hai Hazrat Wathila R.A farmate hain main Huzoor ﷺ ke paas tha jab Hazrat Ali, Hazrat Fatima, Hazrat Hassan, Hazrat Hussain R.A ajma'een aaye aap ﷺ ne apni chadar un par daal kar farmaya: "Aye Allah! Yeh mere Ahl-e-Bait hain, ya Allah! In se napaki ko door farma aur inhe paak kar de." Main ne kaha main bhi? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya haan tu bhi. Mere nazdeek sab se zyada mera mazboot amal yahi hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Umme Salma R.A farmati hain Huzoor ﷺ mere ghar mein the jab Hazrat Fatima R.A harire ki ek pateeli bhari hui layin. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya apne miyan ko aur apne dono bachon ko bhi bula lo. Chunancha woh bhi aa gaye aur khana shuru hua, aap ﷺ apne bistar par the. Khaibar ki ek chadar aap ﷺ ke neeche bichhi hui thi. Main hujre mein namaz ada kar rahi thi jab yeh aayat utri. Pas Huzoor ﷺ ne chadar inhe odha di aur chadar mein se ek haath nikal kar aasman ki taraf utha kar yeh dua ki ke: "Ilahi! Yeh mere Ahl-e-Bait aur hamayati hain, tu in se napaki door kar aur inhe zahir kar." Main ne apna sar ghar mein se nikal kar kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ main bhi aap sab ke saath hoon? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya yaqeenan tu behtari ki taraf hai, filwaqay tu khair ki taraf hai. Is riwayat ke rawayon mein Atta ke ustad ka naam nahin jo muallim ho sake ke woh kaise rawi hain, baqi rawi siqa hain. Doosri sanad se inhi Hazrat Umme Salma R.A se marwi hai ke ek martaba un ke saath Hazrat Ali R.A ka zikr aaya to aap ﷺ ne farmaya aayat-e-tathir to mere ghar mein utri hai. Aap ﷺ mere haan aaye aur farmaya kisi aur ko aane ki ijazat na dena. Thodi der mein Hazrat Fatima R.A ayin. Ab bhala main beti ko baap se kaise rokti? Phir Hazrat Hassan R.A aaye to nawase ko nana se kaun roke? Phir Hazrat Hussain R.A aaye main ne inhe bhi na roka. Phir Hazrat Ali R.A aaye main inhe bhi na rok saki. Jab yeh sab jama ho gaye to jo chadar Huzoor ﷺ odhe hue the usi mein in sab ko le liya aur kaha: "Ilahi! Yeh mere Ahl-e-Bait hain in se paleedi door kar de aur inhe khoob paak kar de." Pas yeh aayat us waqt utri jabke yeh chadar mein jama ho chuke the, main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ main bhi? Lekin Allah jaanta hai aap ﷺ is par khush na hue aur farmaya tu khair ki taraf hai. Musnad ki aur riwayat mein hai ke mere ghar mein Huzoor ﷺ the jab khadim ne aa kar khabar ki ke Fatima R.A aur Ali R.A aa gaye hain to aap ﷺ ne mujh se farmaya ek taraf ho jao mere Ahl-e-Bait aa gaye hain. Main ghar ke ek kone mein baith gayi jab dono nanhe bache aur yeh dono sahab tashreef laye.

Aap ne dono bachon ko godi mein le liya aur pyar kiya phir ek hath Hazrat Ali R.A ki gardan mein dusra Hazrat Fatima R.A ki gardan mein daal kar un dono ko bhi pyar kiya aur ek siyah chadar sab par daal kar farmaya ya Allah teri taraf na ke aag ki taraf main aur meri Ahl-e-Bait. Main ne kaha main bhi? Farmaya haan tu bhi. Aur riwayat mein hai ke main us waqt ghar ke darwaze par baithi hui thi aur main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ kya main Ahl-e-Bait mein se nahin hoon? Aap ne farmaya tu bhalai ki taraf hai aur Nabi ﷺ ki biwiyon mein se hai aur riwayat mein hai main ne kaha mujhe bhi un ke sath shamil kar lijiye to farmaya tu meri ahl hai. Hazrat Aisha R.A se marwi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ siyah chadar orhay huay ek din subh hi subh niklay aur un charon ko apni chadar talay le kar yeh aayat parhi (Muslim waghera). Hazrat Aisha R.A se ek martaba kisi ne Hazrat Ali R.A ke baray mein sawal kiya to aap ne farmaya woh sab se zyada Rasool Allah ﷺ ke mehboob thay un ke ghar mein aap ki sahibzadi thin jo sab se zyada aap ki mehboob thin. Phir chadar ka waqia bayan farma kar farmaya main ne qareeb ja kar kaha Ya Rasool Allah main bhi aap ke Ahl-e-Bait se hoon aap ne farmaya door raho tum yaqeenan khair par ho (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Hazrat Saeed R.A se marwi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya mere aur un charon ke baray mein yeh aayat utri hai. Aur sanad se yeh Abu Saeed R.A ka apna qaul hona marwi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Saad R.A farmatay hain jab Huzoor ﷺ par wahi utri to aap ne un charon ko apne kapray talay le kar farmaya Ya Rabb yeh mere ahl hain aur mere Ahl-e-Bait hain (Ibn-e-Jareer). Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai Hazrat Yazeed bin Hayyan farmatay hain main aur Haseen bin Seera aur Umar bin Muslima mil kar Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam R.A ke paas gaye. Haseen kehnay lagay ae Zaid aap ko to bohat si bhalaiyan mil gayin. Aap ne Huzoor ﷺ ki ziyarat ki, aap ki hadeesain sunin, aap ke sath jihad kiye, aap ke peechay namazain parhin garz aap ne bohat khair-o-barkat pa liya acha hamain koi hadees to sunao. Aap ne farmaya bhatijay ab meri umar bari ho gayi. Huzoor ﷺ ka zamana door ho gaya. Baaz batain zehan se jati rahin. Ab tum aisa karo jo batain main az-khud bayan karoon unhain tum qabool kar lo warna mujhe takleef na do. Suno! Makkah aur Madine ke darmiyan ek pani ki jagah par jisay Khum kaha jata hai Huzoor ﷺ ne kharay ho kar hamain ek khutba sunaya. Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana aur waz-o-pand ke baad farmaya main ek insaan hoon. Bohat mumkin hai ke mere paas mere Rab ka qasid aaye aur main us ki maan loon main tum mein do cheezain choray ja raha hoon. Pehli to Kitabullah jis par hidayat-o-noor hai. Tum Allah ki kitab ko lo aur usay mazbooti se tham lo phir to aap ne Kitabullah ki bari raghbat dilai aur us ki taraf hamain khoob mutawaja farmaya. Phir farmaya aur meri Ahl-e-Bait ke baray mein Allah ko yaad dilata hoon teen martaba yahi kalma farmaya. To Haseen ne Hazrat Zaid R.A se poocha aap ke Ahl-e-Bait kaun hain? Kya aap ki biwiyan aap ki Ahl-e-Bait nahin hain?

Farmaya aap ki biwiyan toh aap ki Ahl-e-Bait hain hi. Lekin aap ki Ahl-e-Bait woh hain jin par aap ke baad sadaqa khana haram hai, poocha woh kaun hain? Farmaya Aal-e-Ali, Aal-e-Aqeel, Aal-e-Jafar, Aal-e-Abbas R.A. Poocha kya in sab par aap ke baad sadaqa haram hai? Kaha haan! Dusri sanad se yeh bhi marwi hai ke main ne poocha kya aap ki biwiyan bhi Ahl-e-Bait mein dakhil hain? Kaha nahin qasam hai Allah ki, biwi ka toh yeh haal hai ke woh apne khawand ke paas go arsa-e-daraz se ho lekin phir agar woh talaq de de toh apne maike mein aur apni qaum mein chali jati hai. Aap ke Ahl-e-Bait aap ki asal aur asaba hain jin par aap ke baad sadaqa haram hai. Is riwayat mein yahi hai lekin pehli riwayat hi aula hai aur isi ko lena theek hai aur is dusri mein jo hai is se murad sirf hadith mein jin Ahl-e-Bait ka zikr hai woh hai kyunke wahan woh Aal murad hai jin par sadaqa khori haram hai ya yeh ke murad sirf biwiyan nahin hain balkay woh ma'a aap ki aur Aal ke hain. Yahi baat zyada rajeh hai aur is se is riwayat aur is se pehle ki riwayat mein jama bhi ho jati hai aur Quran aur pehli ahadith mein bhi jama ho jati hai lekin yeh is surat mein ke in ahadith ki sehat ko tasleem kar liya jaye. Kyunke in ki ba'az asnadon mein nazar hai, Wallahu Ta'ala A'lam. Jis shakhs ko noor-e-ma'arifat hasil ho aur Quran mein tadabbur karne ki aadat ho woh yaqeenan baik nigah jaan le ga ke is aayat mein Huzoor ﷺ ki biwiyan bila-shubk-o-shuba dakhil hain is liye ke upar se kalam hi un ke sath aur unhi ke bare mein chal raha hai. Yahi wajah hai ke is ke baad hi farmaya ke Allah ki aayatein aur Rasool ﷺ ki baatein jin ka dars tumhare gharon mein ho raha hai unhein yaad rakho aur un par amal karo. Pas Allah ki aayat aur hikmat se murad ba-qaul-e-Hazrat Qatada waghera Kitab-o-Sunnat hai. Pas yeh khaas khusoosiyat hai jo un ke siwa kisi aur ko nahin mili ke un ke gharon mein Allah ki wahi aur Rahmat-e-Ilahi nazil hua karti hai aur un mein bhi yeh sharaf Hazrat Umm-ul-Momineen Aisha Siddiqa R.A ko bator-e-aula aur sab se zyada hasil hai kyunke hadith-e-shareef mein saaf warid hai ke kisi aurat ke bistar par Huzoor ﷺ ki taraf wahi nahin aati bajuz aap ﷺ ke bistare ke, yeh is liye bhi ke Huzoor ﷺ ne aap ke siwa kisi aur bakira se nikah nahin kiya tha. Un ka bistar bajuz Rasool Allah ﷺ ke aur kisi ke liye na tha. Pas is ziyadati-e-darja aur bulandi-e-martaba ki woh sahih taur par mustahiq thin. Haan jabke aap ki biwiyan aap ki Ahl-e-Bait huin toh aap ke qareebi rishte-dar bator-e-aula aap ki Ahl-e-Bait hain. Jaise hadith mein guzar chuka ke mere Ahl-e-Bait zyada haqdar hain. Is ki misaal mein yeh aayat theek taur par pesh ho sakti hai: (Lamasjidun ussisa 'alat-taqwa min awwali yawmin ahaqqu an taqooma feehi, feehi rijalun yuhibboona an yatatahharoo, wallahu yuhibbul muttahhireen) (Surah (At-Tawbah: 108) ke yeh utri toh hai Masjid-e-Quba ke bare mein jaisa ke saaf saaf ahadith mein maujood hai.

Lekin Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai ke jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hua ke is masjid se kaun si masjid murad hai? To Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya woh meri hi masjid hai yani Masjid-e-Nabvi. Pas jo sifat Masjid-e-Quba mein thi wahi sifat chunke Masjid-e-Nabvi mein bhi hai is liye is masjid ko bhi isi naam se is aayat ke tehat dakhil kardiya. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Ali (R.A) ki shahadat ke baad Hazrat Hasan (R.A) ko khalifa banaya gaya. Aap (R.A) ek martaba namaz padha rahe the ke Banu Asad ka ek shakhs kood kar aaya aur sajde ki halat mein aap ke jism mein khanjar ghonp diya jo aap ke narm gosht mein laga jis se aap kai mahine bimar rahe jab achhe ho gaye to masjid mein aaye minbar par baith kar khutba padha jis mein farmaya ae Iraqiyo! Hamare bare mein Allah ka khauf kiya karo hum tumhare hakim hain, tumhare mehman hain, hum Ahl-e-Bait hain jin ke bare mein aayat (وَقَرْنَ فِيْ بُيُوْتِكُنَّ وَلَا تَبَرَّجْنَ تَــبَرُّجَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ الْاُوْلٰى وَاَقِمْنَ الصَّلٰوةَ وَاٰتِيْنَ الزَّكٰوةَ وَاَطِعْنَ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوْلَهٗ ۭ اِنَّمَا يُرِيْدُ اللّٰهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ الرِّجْسَ اَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيْرًا 33؀ۚ) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 33) utri hai. Is par aap ne khoob zor diya aur is mazmoon ko baar baar ada kiya jis se masjid wale rone lage. Ek martaba aap ne ek Shami se farmaya tha kya tu ne Surah Ahzab ki aayat-e-tathir nahin padhi? Us ne kaha haan kya is se murad tum ho? Farmaya haan! Allah Ta'ala bade lutf-o-karam wala, bade ilm aur poori khabar wala hai. Us ne jaan liya ke tum us ke lutf ke ahl ho, is liye us ne tumhein yeh ne'matein ata farmayin aur yeh fazilatein tumhein dein. Pas is aayat ke ma'ani mutabiq Tafsir-e-Ibn-e-Jarir yeh hue ke ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyo! Allah ki jo ne'mat tum par hai use tum yaad karo ke us ne tumhein in gharon mein kiya jahan Allah ki aayat aur hikmat padhi jati hai tumhein Allah Ta'ala ki is ne'mat par us ka shukr karna chahiye aur us ki hamd padhni chahiye ke tum par Allah ka lutf-o-karam hai ke us ne tumhein in gharon mein abad kiya. Hikmat se murad Sunnat-o-Hadith hai. Allah anjam tak se khabardar hai. Us ne apne poore aur sahih ilm se jaanch kar tumhein apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyan banne ke liye muntakhab kar liya. Pas darasal yeh bhi Allah ka tum par ehsan hai jo Latif-o-Khabir hai har cheez ke juz-o-kul se.))

Islam aur Iman mein farq aur zikr-e-Ilahi. Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umm-e-Salma R.A ne ek martaba Rasool Allah ﷺ ki khidmat mein arz kiya ke aakhir is ki kya wajah hai ke mardon ka zikr toh Quran mein aata rehta hai lekin aurton ka toh zikr hi nahin kiya jata. Ek din mein apne ghar mein baithi apne sar ke baal suljha rahi thi jab mein ne Huzoor ﷺ ki aawaz mimbar par suni, mein ne baalon ko toh yunhi lapet liya aur hujre mein aa kar aap ki baatein sunne lagi toh aap us waqt yahi aayat tilawat farma rahe thay. Nasai waghera. Aur bahut si riwayatein aap se mukhtasaran marwi hain. Ek riwayat mein hai ke chand aurton ne Huzoor ﷺ se yeh kaha tha aur riwayat mein hai ke aurton ne Azwaj-e-Mutahharat se yeh kaha tha. Islam-o-Iman ko alag alag bayan karna daleel hai is baat ki ke Iman Islam ka ghair hai aur Iman Islam se makhsoos-o-mumtaz hai (QALATIL A'RABU AAMANNA 14) 49. (Al-Hujurat: 14) wali aayat aur Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith ke zani zina ke waqt momin nahin hota phir is par ijma ke zina se kufr lazim nahin aata. Yeh is par daleel hai aur hum sharah-e-Bukhari ki ibtida mein ise sabit kar chuke hain. (Yeh yaad rahe ke in mein farq us waqt hai jab Islam haqiqi na ho jaise ke Imam-ul-Muhaddiseen Hazrat Imam Bukhari R.H ne Sahih Bukhari Kitab-ul-Iman mein badalayil-e-kaseera sabit kiya hai, Wallahu A'lam, (Mutarjim). Qunoot se murad sukoon ke sath ki itaat guzari hai jaise (AMMAN HUWA QANITUN AANA-AL-LAILI SAJIDAN WA QA'IMAN YAHZARUL AAKHIRATA WA YARJU RAHMATA RABBIHI QUL HAL YASTAWILLAZINA YA'LAMUNA WALLAZINA LA YA'LAMUNA INNAMA YATAZAKKARU ULUL ALBAB) 39. (Az-Zumar: 9) mein hai aur farman hai (WA LAHU MAN FIS-SAMAWATI WAL ARDI KULLUN LAHU QANITUN 26) 30. (Ar-Rum: 26) yani aasman-o-zameen ki har cheez Allah ki farman-bardar hai aur farmata hai (YA MARYAMU UQNUTI LI-RABBIKI WASJUDI WARKA'I MA'AR-RAKI'IN 43) 3. (Aal-e-Imran: 43) aur farmata hai (WA QUMU LILLAHI QANITIN) 2. (Al-Baqarah: 238) yani Allah ke samne ba-adab farman-bardari ki surat mein khade hua karo. Pas Islam ke upar ka martaba Iman hai aur in ke ijtima se insan mein farman-bardari aur itaat guzari paida ho jati hai. Baaton ki sachai Allah ko bahut hi mehboob hai aur yeh aadat har tarah mahmood hai. Sahaba-e-Kibar mein toh woh buzurg bhi thay jinhon ne jahiliyat ke zamane mein bhi koi jhoot nahin bola tha, sachai Iman ki nishani hai aur jhoot nifaq ki alamat hai. Sacha nijat pata hai. Sach hi bola karo. Sachai neki ki taraf rahbari karti hai aur neki jannat ki taraf. Jhoot se bacho. Jhoot badkari ki taraf rahbari karta hai aur fisq-o-fujoor insan ko jahannam ki taraf le jata hai.

Insaan sach bolte bolte aur sachai ka qasd karte karte Allah ke haan Siddiq likh liya jata hai aur jhoot bolte hue aur jhoot ka qasd karte hue Allah ke nazdeek jhoota likh liya jata hai aur bhi is baare ki bahut si hadeesein hain. Sabr sabit qadmi ka natija hai. Museebaton par sabr hota hai is ilm par ke taqdeer ka likha talta nahin. Sab se zyada sakht sabr sadme ke ibtidai waqt par hai aur isi ka ajar zyada hai. Phir toh joon joon zamana guzarta hai khwah makhwah hi sabr aa jata hai. Khushoo se murad taskeen, diljam'i, tawazu, farotni aur aajizi hai. Yeh insaan mein us waqt aati hai jabke dil mein Allah ka khauf aur Rabb ko har waqt hazir nazir janta ho aur is tarah Allah ki ibadat karta ho jaise ke woh Allah ko dekh raha hai aur yeh nahin toh kam az kam is darje par woh zaroor ho ke Allah use dekh raha hai. Sadqe se murad mohtaj zaeefon ko jin ki koi kamai na ho na jin ka koi kamane wala ho unhein apna faltu maal dena is niyat se ke Allah ki ita'at ho aur us ki makhlooq ka kaam bane. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadees mein hai saat qisam ke logon ko Allah Ta'ala apne arsh tale saya dega jis din us ke saaye ke siwa koi saya na hoga un mein ek woh bhi hai jo sadqa deta hai lekin is tarah posheeda taur par ke dahine haath ke kharch ki baayein haath ko khabar nahin lagti aur hadees mein hai sadqa khataon ko is tarah mita deta hai jis tarah pani aag ko bujha deta hai aur bhi is baare ki bahut si hadeesein hain jo apni apni jagah majood hain. Rozay ki babat hadees mein hai ke yeh badan ki zakat hai yani use paak saaf kar deta hai aur tibbi taur par bhi raddi akhlaat ko mita deta hai. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.A) farmate hain Ramzan ke rozay rakh kar jis ne har mahine mein teen rozay rakh liye woh (Wassaimina wassaaimati wal-hafizina furoojahum wal-hafizati wazzakirinallaha kaseeran wazzakirati a'addallahu lahum maghfiratan wa ajran azeema) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 35) mein dakhil ho gaya. Roza shahwat ko bhi jhuka dene wala hai. Hadees mein hai ae naujawano tum mein se jise taqat ho woh toh apna nikah kar le taake is se nigahain neechi rahein aur paak damni hasil ho jaye aur jise apne nikah ki taqat na ho woh rozay rakhe, yahi is ke liye goya khasi hona hai. Isi liye rozon ke zikr ke baad hi badkari se bachne ka zikr kiya aur farmaya ke aise musalman mard-o-aurat haram se aur gunah ke kamon se bachte rehte hain. Apni is khaas quwwat ko jaiz jagah sarf karte hain. Jaise aur aayat mein hai ke yeh log apne badan ko roke rehte hain. Magar apni biwiyon se aur laundiyon se un par koi malamat nahin. Haan is ke siwa jo aur kuch talab kare woh had se guzar jane wala hai.

Zikr-e-Allah ki nisbat ek hadith mein hai ke jab miyan apni biwi ko raat ke waqt jaga kar do rakat namaz dono parh lein toh woh Allah ka zikr karne walon mein likh liye jate hain (mulahiza ho Abu Dawood wagaira). Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) ne poocha ke ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) sab se baray darjay wala banda qayamat ke din Allah ke nazdeek kaun hai? Aap ne farmaya kasrat se Allah ka zikr karne wala. Main ne kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Allah ki rah ke mujahid se bhi? Aap ne farmaya agarcheh woh kafiron par talwar chalaye yahan tak ke talwar toot jaye aur woh khoon mein rang jaye tab bhi Allah Ta'ala ka bakasrat zikr karne wala us se afzal hi rahe ga. (Musnad Ahmad). Musnad hi mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) Makkah ke rastay mein ja rahe thay, Jamdan par pahunch kar farmaya yeh Jamdan hai, mufarrid ban kar chalo. Aagay barhne walon ne poocha mufarrid se kya murad hai? Farmaya Allah Ta'ala ka bohat zyada zikr karne walay. Phir farmaya ae Allah hajj-o-umray mein apna sar mundwanay walon par raham farma! Logon ne kaha baal katwanay walon ke liye bhi dua kijiye, aap ne farmaya ya Allah sar mundwanay walon ko bakhash. Logon ne phir katwanay walon ke liye darkhwast ki toh aap ne farmaya katwanay walay bhi. Aap ka farman hai ke Allah ke azabon se nijat dene wala koi amal Allah ke zikr se bara nahin. Ek martaba aap ne farmaya main tumhein sab se behtar, sab se pak aur sab se buland darjay ka amal na bataoon jo tumhare haq mein sona chandi Allah ki rah mein lutane se bhi behtar ho aur us se bhi afzal ho jab tum kal dushman se milo ge aur un ki gardanein maro ge aur woh tumhari gardanein marenge. Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) zaroor batlaye, farmaya Allah Azza-wa-Jal ka zikr. Musnad Ahmad ki ek hadith mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se daryaft kiya ke kaun sa mujahid afzal hai? Aap ne farmaya sab se zyada Allah ka zikr karne wala. Us ne phir rozay dar ki nisbat poocha yahi jawab mila, phir namaz, zakat, hajj, sadaqa, sab ki babat poocha aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ne sab ka yahi jawab diya toh Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) ne Hazrat Umar (R.A) se kaha phir Allah ka zikr karne walay toh bohat hi barh gaye, Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya haan. Kasrat-e-Zikr-e-Allah ki fazeelat mein aur bhi bohat si hadeesein aayi hain. Isi surat ki ayat (Yaa Ayyuhallazeena Aamanoozkurullaha Zikran Kaseera) (Al-Ahzab: 41) ki tafseer mein hum in ahadees ko bayan karenge Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Phir farmaya yeh nek sifatein jin mein hon hum ne un ke liye maghfirat tayyar kar rakhi hai aur ajr-e-azeem yani jannat.))

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paigham ko rad karna gunah-e-azeem hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hazrat Zaid bin Harith (R.A) ka paigham le kar Hazrat Zainab bint Jahsh (R.A) ke paas gaye. Unhon ne kaha "Main is se nikah nahin karungi." Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya! Aisa na kaho aur in se nikah kar lo. Hazrat Zainab (R.A) ne jawab diya ke achha phir kuch mohlat dijiye main soch loon. Abhi yeh baatein ho rahi thin ke wahi nazil hui aur yeh aayat utri. Ise sun kar Hazrat Zainab (R.A) ne farmaya. Ya Rasool Allah! Kya aap is nikah se razamand hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan. To Hazrat Zainab (R.A) ne jawab diya ke bas phir mujhe koi inkar nahin, main Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nafarmani nahin karungi. Main ne apna nafs in ke nikah mein de diya aur riwayat mein hai ke wajah-e-inkar yeh thi ke nasab ke aitbar se yeh ba-nisbat Hazrat Zaid ke zyada shareef thin. Hazrat Zaid Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke azad karda ghulam the. Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam (R.A) farmate hain ke yeh aayat Uqba bin Abu Mu'ait ki sahibzadi Hazrat Umme Kulsoom (R.A) ke bare mein nazil hui hai. Sulh-e-Hudaibiya ke baad sab se pehle muhajir aurat yahi thi. Unhon ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main apna nafs aap ko hiba karti hoon. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mujhe qabool hai. Phir Hazrat Zaid bin Harith (R.A) se in ka nikah kara diya. Ghaliban yeh nikah Hazrat Zainab (R.A) ki alaidgi ke baad hua hoga. Is se Hazrat Umme Kulsoom naraz huin aur in ke bhai bhi bigar baithe ke hamara apna irada khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se nikah ka tha na ke aap ke ghulam se nikah karne ka, is par yeh aayat utri balkay is se bhi zyada mamla saaf kar diya gaya aur farma diya gaya ke (An-Nabiyyu awla bil-mu'mineena min anfusihim wa azwajuhu ummahatuhum, wa ulul-arhame ba'duhum awla bi-ba'din fi kitabillahi minal-mu'mineena wal-muhajireena illa an taf'alu ila awliya'ikum ma'rufan, kana dhalika fil-kitabi mastura) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 6). Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mominon ki apni janon se bhi zyada awla hain. Pas aayat (Wa ma kana li-mu'minin wa la mu'minatin idha qadal-lahu wa rasuluhu amran an yakuna lahumul-khiyatu min amrihim, wa man ya'sil-laha wa rasulahu faqad dalla dalalan mubina) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 36) khas hai aur is se bhi jame aayat yeh hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek Ansari ko Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tum apni larki ka nikah Julaibib (R.A) se kar do. Unhon ne jawab diya ke achhi baat hai. Main is ki maa se bhi mashwara kar loon. Ja kar un se mashwara kiya to unhon ne kaha yeh nahin ho sakta, hum ne falan falan in se bare bare admiyon ke paigham ko rad kar diya aur ab Julaibib (R.A) se nikah kar dein. Ansari apni biwi ka yeh jawab sun kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein jana chahte hi the ke larki jo parde ke peeche se yeh tamam guftagu sun rahi thi bol pari ke tum Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki baat ko rad karte ho? Jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is se khush hain to tumhein inkar na karna chahiye.

Ab dono ne kaha ke bachi theek keh rahi hai. Beech mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) hain, is nikah se inkar karna goya Huzoor (ﷺ) ke paigham aur khwahish ko rad karna hai, yeh theek nahin. Chunancha Ansari seedhay Huzoor (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur arz kiya ke kya aap is baat se khush hain? Aap ne farmaya! Haan main toh is se razamand hoon. Kaha phir aap ko ikhtiyar hai aap nikah kar dijiye, chunancha nikah ho gaya. Ek martaba Ahl-e-Islam Madina walay dushmanon ke muqablay ke liye niklay, ladai hui jis mein Hazrat Julaibib (R.A) shaheed ho gaye, unhon ne bhi bohat se kafiron ko qatl kiya tha jin ki lashein un ke aas paas padi hui thin. Hazrat Anas (R.A) ka bayan hai ke main ne khud dekha un ka ghar bada aasooda haal tha. Tamam Madinay mein un se zyada kharchila koi na tha. Ek aur riwayat mein Hazrat Abu Burdah Aslami (R.A) ka bayan hai ke Hazrat Julaibib (R.A) ki tabiyat khush-mazaj thi is liye main ne apne ghar mein keh diya tha ke yeh tumhare paas na aayen. Ansariyon ki aadat thi ke woh kisi aurat ka nikah nahin karte thay yahan tak ke yeh maloom kar lein ke Huzoor (ﷺ) un ki babat kuch nahin farmatay. Phir woh waqia bayan farmaya jo oopar mazkoor hua. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Julaibib (R.A) ne saat kafiron ko is ghazway mein qatl kiya tha. Phir kafiron ne yak-musht ho kar aap ko shaheed kar diya. Huzoor (ﷺ) un ko talash karte hue jab un ki na'ash ke paas aaye toh farmaya saat ko maar kar phir shaheed hue hain. Yeh mere hain aur main in ka hoon. Do ya teen martaba yahi farmaya phir qabr khudwa kar apne hathon par unhein utha kar qabr mein utara. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ka dast-e-mubarak hi un ka janaza tha aur koi charpai waghera na thi. Yeh bhi mazkoor nahin ke unhein ghusl diya gaya ho. Is nek-bakht Ansariyah aurat ke liye jinhon ne Huzoor (ﷺ) ki baat ki izzat rakh kar apne maa baap ko samjhaya tha ke inkar na karo. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne yeh dua ki thi ke Allah is par apni rehmaton ki barish barsa aur isay zindagi ke pooray lutf ata farma. Tamam Ansar mein un se zyada kharch karne wali aurat na thi. Unhon ne jab parday ke peechay se apne walidain se kaha tha ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ki baat rad na karo us waqt yeh aayat (وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ وَّلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ اِذَا قَضَى اللّٰهُ وَرَسُوْلُهٗٓ اَمْرًا اَنْ يَّكُوْنَ لَهُمُ الْخِـيَرَةُ مِنْ اَمْرِهِمْ ۭ وَمَنْ يَّعْصِ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوْلَهٗ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلٰلًا مُّبِيْنًا) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 36) nazil hui thi. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se Hazrat Ta'oos ne poocha ke Asr ke baad do rakat padh sakte hain? Aap ne mana farmaya aur isi aayat ki tilawat ki, pas yeh aayat goya shaan-e-nuzool ke aitbar se makhsoos hai lekin hukm ke aitbar se aam hai. Allah aur us ke Rasool ke farman ke hotay hue na toh koi mukhalifat kar sakta hai na usay mannay na mannay ka ikhtiyar kisi ko baqi rehta hai. Na raye aur qiyas karne ka haq, na kisi aur baat ka.

Jaise farmaya (FALA WARABBIKA LA YU'MINUNA HATTA YU HAKKIMUKA FIMA SHAJARA BAINAHUM THUMMA LA YAJIDU FI ANFUSIHIM HARAJAM MIMMA QADAYTA WA YUSALLIMU TASLIMA 65) (Surah (An-Nisa: 65), yani qasam hai tere Rab ki log imandar na honge jab tak ke woh aapas ke tamam ikhtilafat mein tujhe hakim na maan lein. Phir tere farman se apne dil mein kisi qisam ki tangi na rakhein balkay khulay dil se tasleem kar lein. Sahih hadith mein hai us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai ke tum mein se koi momin nahin hoga jab tak ke us ki khwahish us cheez ki tabe-dar na ban jaye jisay main laya hoon. Isi liye yahan bhi us ki nafarmani ki burai bayan farma di ke Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nafarmani karne wala khullam khulla gumrah hai. Jaise farman hai (FAL YAHZARILLAZINA YUKHALIFUNA AN AMRIHI AN TUSIBAHUM FITNATUN AW YUSIBAHUM AZABUN ALIM 63) (Surah (An-Nur: 63), yani jo log irshad-e-Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka khilaf karte hain unhein dartay rehna chahiye ke aisa na ho un par koi fitna aa paray ya unhein dard-naak azab ho.)))))

Azmat-e-Zaid bin Haritha (R.A). Allah Ta'ala khabar deta hai ke uske Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne azad karda ghulam Hazrat Zaid bin Haritha ko har tarah samjhaya. Un par Allah ka in'aam tha ke Islam aur mutaba'at-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taufiq di. Aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka bhi un par ehsan tha ke unhein ghulami se azad kardiya. Yeh badi shaan wale thay aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko bahut hi pyare thay yahan tak ke unhein sab musalman Hib-ur-Rasool kehte thay. Unke sahibzade Usama ko bhi Hib-ibn-Hib kehte thay. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ka farman hai ke jis lashkar mein unhein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhejte thay us lashkar ka sardar unhi ko banate thay. Agar yeh zinda rehte to Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke khalifa ban jate (Ahmad). Bazzar mein hai Hazrat Usama (R.A) farmate hain main masjid mein tha mere paas Hazrat Abbas aur Hazrat Ali (R.A) aaye aur mujh se kaha jao Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se hamare liye ijazat talab karo. Main ne aap ko khabar ki aap ne farmaya jante ho woh kyun aaye hain? Main ne kaha nahin! Aap ne farmaya lekin main janta hoon jao bula lao. Yeh aaye aur kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) zara batayein aap ko apne ahl mein sab se zyada kaun mehboob hai? Aap ne farmaya meri beti Fatima. Unhon ne kaha hum Hazrat Fatima ke bare mein nahin poochte. Aap ne farmaya phir Usama bin Zaid bin Haritha (R.A) jin par Allah ne in'aam kiya aur main ne bhi. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unka nikah apni phuphi Umaima bint Jahsh Asadiya se karadiya tha. Das dinar aur saat dirham mehar diya tha, ek dupatta, ek chadar, ek kurta, pachaas mudd anaj aur das mudd khajoorein di thin. Ek saal ya kuch oopar tak to yeh ghar basa lekin phir nachaqi shuru hogayi. Hazrat Zaid ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aakar shikayat shuru ki to aap unhein samjhane lage ke ghar na todo Allah se daro. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim aur Ibn-e-Jarir ne is jagah bahut se ghair sahih aasar naqal kiye hain jin ka naqal karna hum namunasib jaankar tark karte hain kyunke un mein se ek bhi sabit aur sahih nahin. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi ek riwayat Hazrat Anas se hai lekin us mein bhi badi gharabat hai is liye hum ne use bhi warid nahin kiya. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke yeh aayat Hazrat Zainab bint Jahsh aur Hazrat Zaid bin Haritha (R.A) ke bare mein utri hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne pehle hi se apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko khabar de di thi ke Hazrat Zainab (R.A) aap ke nikah mein aayengi. Yehi baat thi jise aap ne zahir na farmaya aur Hazrat Zaid ko samjhaya ke woh apni biwi ko alag na karein. Hazrat Ayesha farmati hain Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) agar Allah ki wahi Kitabullah mein se ek aayat bhi chupane wale hote to is aayat ko chupalete. Watar ke ma'ani haajat ke hain. Matlab yeh hai ke jab Zaid un se sair hogaye aur bawajood samjhane bujhane ke bhi mel milap qaim na reh saka balkeh talaq hogayi to Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Zainab ko apne Nabi ke nikah mein dediya. Is liye wali ke ijab-o-qabool se mehar aur gawahon ki zaroorat na rahi. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Zainab ki iddat poori ho chuki to Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Zaid bin Haritha se kaha ke tum jao aur unhein mujh se nikah karne ka paigham pahunchao.

Hazrat Zaid gaye us waqt aap aata goondh rahi thin. Hazrat Zaid par un ki azmat is qadar chhayi ke samne par kar baat na kar sake, munh pher kar baith gaye aur zikr kiya. Hazrat Zainab ne farmaya thehro! Main Allah Ta'ala se istikhara kar loon. Yeh toh khari ho kar namaz parhne lagin, idhar Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par wahi utri jis mein Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya main ne un ka nikah tujh se kar diya. Chunancha usi waqt Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) be-ittila chale aaye, phir walime ki dawat mein aap ne hum sab ko gosht roti khilayi. Log kha pee kar chale gaye magar chand aadmi wahin baithe baatein karte rahe. Aap bahar nikal kar apni biwiyon ke hujre ke paas gaye. Aap unhein Assalamu Alaikum karte the aur woh aap se daryaft karti thin ke farmayiye biwi sahiba se khush toh hain? Mujhe yeh yaad nahin ke main ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko khabar di ya aap khabar diye gaye ke log wahan se chale gaye. Is ke baad aap us ghar ki taraf tashreef le gaye, main bhi aap ke hamrah tha, main ne aap ke sath hi jaane ka irada kiya lekin aap ne parda gira diya aur mere aur aap ke darmiyan hijab ho gaya aur parde ki aayatein utrin aur Sahaba ko nasihat ki gayi aur farma diya gaya ke Nabi ke gharon mein be-ijazat na jao. (Muslim waghera). Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Hazrat Zainab (R.A) aur azwaj-e-mutahharat se fakhran kaha karti thin ke tum sab ke nikah tumhare wali warison ne kiye aur mera nikah khud Allah Ta'ala ne saatwein aasman par kara diya. Surah Noor ki tafsir mein hum yeh riwayat bayan kar chuke hain ke Hazrat Zainab ne kaha mera nikah aasman se utra aur un ke muqable par Hazrat Aisha ne farmaya meri barat ki aayatein aasman se utrin jis ka Hazrat Zainab ne iqrar kiya. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Hazrat Zainab ne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ek martaba kaha mujh mein Allah Ta'ala ne teen khusoosiyat rakhi hain jo aap ki aur biwiyon mein nahin, ek toh yeh ke mera aur aap ka dada ek hai. Dusre yeh ke Allah Ta'ala ne aasman se mujhe aap ke nikah mein diya. Teesre yeh ke hamare darmiyan safeer Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) the. Phir farmata hai hum ne un se nikah karna tere liye jaiz kar diya taake musalmanon par un ke le palak larkon ki biwiyon ke bare mein jab unhein talaq de di jaye koi haraj na rahe. Yani woh agar chahein un se nikah kar sakein. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne nabuwat se pehle Hazrat Zaid ko apna mutabanna bana rakha tha. Aam taur par unhein Zaid bin Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kaha jata tha. Quran ne is nisbat se bhi mumanat kar di aur hukum diya ke unhein apne haqiqi baap ki taraf nisbat kar ke pukara karo. Phir Hazrat Zaid ne jab Hazrat Zainab ko talaq de di toh Allah Pak ne unhein apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke nikah mein de kar yeh baat bhi hata di. Jis aayat mein haram aurton ka zikr kiya hai wahan bhi yahi farmaya ke tumhare apne sulbi larkon ki biwiyan tum par haram hain. Taake le palak larkon ki larkiyan is hukum se kharij rahein. Kyunke aise larke Arab mein bahut the. Yeh amr-e-Ilahi ke nazdeek muqarrar ho chuka tha. Is ka hona hatmi, yaqeeni aur zaroori tha.

Aur Hazrat Zainab ko yeh sharaf milna pehle hi se likha ja chuka tha ke woh Azwaj-e-Mutahharat, Ummahat-ul-Momineen mein dakhil hon (Razi Allahu Anha).

Le-paalak ki biwi se mutaliq hukum. Farmata hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek apne le-paalak mutabanni ki biwi se uski talaq ke baad nikah karna halal hai phir is mein Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par kya haraj hai. Agle nabiyon par jo jo hukum Allah Ta'ala nazil farmate the, un par amal karne mein un par koi haraj na tha. Is se munafiqon ke is qaul ka radd karna hai ke dekho apne azaad karda ghulam aur le-paalak ladke ki biwi se nikah kar liya. Yeh Allah Ta'ala ke muqaddar karda umoor ho kar hi rehte hain, woh jo chahta hai hota hai, jo nahin chahta nahin hota.

Ummi Khatam-ul-Anbiya (ﷺ). In ki tareef ho rahi hai jo Allah ki makhlooq ko Allah ka paigham pohanchate hain aur amanat-e-Ilahi ki adaigi karte hain aur us se darte rehte hain aur siwaye Allah ke kisi ka khauf nahin karte, kisi ki satwat-o-shan se mar'oob ho kar paigham-e-Allah ka pohanchane mein khauf nahin khate. Allah Ta'ala ki nusrat-o-imdad kaafi hai. Is mansab ki adaigi mein sab ke peshwa balkeh har ek amr mein sab ke sardar Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) hain. Khayal farmayiye ke mashriq-o-maghrib ke har ek bani-e-Adam ko Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Allah ke deen ki tableegh ki. Aur jab tak Allah ka deen char-dang-e-alam mein phail na gaya, aap musalsal mushaqqat ke sath Allah ke deen ki isha'at mein masroof rahe. Aap se pehle tamam ambiya (Alaihimas Salam) apni apni qoum hi ki taraf aate rahe lekin Huzoor (ﷺ) sari duniya ki taraf Allah ke Rasool ban kar aaye thay. Quran mein farman-e-Ilahi hai ke logon mein elaan kar do ke main tum sab ki taraf Allah ka Rasool hoon. Salam alaihi. Phir aap ke baad mansab-e-tableegh aap ki ummat ko mila. In mein sab ke sardar aap ke sahaba hain (Razi Allahu Anhum). Jo kuch unhon ne Huzoor (ﷺ) se seekha tha, sab kuch baad walon ko sikha diya. Tamam aqwal-o-af'aal jo ahwal din aur raat ke, safar-o-hazar ke, zahir-o-poshida duniya ke samne rakh diye. Allah un par apni razamandi nazil farmaye. Phir un ke baad wale un ke waris huye aur isi tarah phir baad wale apne se pehle walon ke waris bane aur Allah ka deen un se phailta raha. Aur Quran-o-Hadith logon tak pohanchte rahe, hidayat wale un ki iqtida se munawwar hote rahe aur taufeeq-e-khair wale un ke maslak par chalte rahe. Allah Kareem se hamari dua hai ke woh hamain bhi un mein se kar de. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai tum mein se koi apna aap zaleel na kare. Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) yeh kaise! Farmaya khilaf-e-shar'a kaam dekh kar, logon ke khauf ke mare khamosh ho rahe. Qayamat ke din us se baz-purs hogi ke tu kyun khamosh raha? Yeh kahega ke logon ke dar se. Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga sab se zyada khauf rakhne ke qabil to meri zaat thi. Phir Allah Ta'ala mana farmata hai ke kisi ko Huzoor (ﷺ) ka sahibzada kaha jaye. Log jo Zaid bin Muhammad kehte thay jis ka bayan oopar guzar chuka hai. To Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) Zaid ke walid nahin. Yehi hua ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ki koi narina aulad bulooghat ko pohanchi hi nahin. Qasim, Tayyab aur Tahir teen bache Hazrat Khadija (R.A) ke batn se, Hazrat Mariya Qibtiya (R.A) se ek bacha hua jis ka naam Hazrat Ibrahim lekin yeh bhi doodh pilane ke zamane mein hi inteqal kar gaye. Aap ki ladkiyan Hazrat Khadija se char thin Zainab, Ruqayya, Umme Kulsoom aur Fatima (R.A) ajma'een. In mein se teen to aap ki zindagi mein hi rihlat farma gayin sirf Hazrat Fatima (R.A) ka inteqal aap ke chhay mah baad hua. Phir farmata hai balkeh aap Allah ke Rasool aur Khatam-ul-Anbiya hain jaise farmaya Allah khoob janta hai jahan apni risalat rakhta hai. Yeh aayat nass hai is amr par ke aap ke baad koi nabi nahin. Aur jab nabi hi nahin to rasool kahan?

Koi Nabi, Rasool aap ke baad nahin aayega. Risalat toh Nabuwwat se bhi khaas cheez hai. Har Rasool Nabi hai lekin har Nabi Rasool nahin. Mutawatir ahadees se bhi Huzoor ﷺ ka Khatam-ul-Anbiya hona sabit hai. Bahut se Sahaba se yeh hadeesein riwayat ki gayi hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain: Meri misaal nabiyon mein aisi hai jaise kisi shakhs ne ek bahut achha aur poora makaan banaya lekin us mein ek eent ki jagah chhod di jahan kuch na rakha, log use charon taraf se dekhte bhalte aur us ki banawat se khush hote lekin kehte kya achha ho taake is eent ki jagah pur kar li jaati. Pas main nabiyon mein isi eent ki jagah hoon. Imam Tirmidhi bhi is hadees ko laye hain aur ise Hasan Sahih kaha hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool ﷺ farmate hain: Risalat aur Nabuwwat khatam ho gayi, mere baad na koi Rasool hai na Nabi. Sahaba R.A par yeh baat garan guzri toh aap ne farmaya lekin khushkhabriyaan dene wale. Sahaba ne poocha khushkhabriyaan dene wale kya hain? Farmaya musalmanon ke khwab jo nabuwwat ke ajza mein se ek juz hain. Yeh hadees bhi Tirmidhi Sharif mein hai aur Imam Tirmidhi ise Sahih Ghareeb kehte hain. Mahal ki misaal wali hadees Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein bhi hai. Is ke aakhir mein yeh hai ke main is eent ki jagah hoon, mujh se Anbiya Alaihimus Salam khatam kiye gaye. Ise Bukhari, Muslim aur Tirmidhi bhi laye hain. Musnad ki is hadees ki ek sanad mein hai ke main aaya aur main ne is khaali eent ki jagah pur kar di. Musnad mein hai mere baad nabuwwat nahin magar khushkhabri wale. Poocha gaya Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ woh kya hain? Farmaya achhe khwab ya farmaya nek khwab. Abdur Razzaq wagaira mein mahal ki eent ki misaal wali hadees mein hai ke log use dekh kar mahal wale se kehte hain ke tu ne is eent ki jagah kyun chhod di? Pas main woh eent hoon. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai Rasool ﷺ farmate hain: Mujhe tamam Anbiya par chhe fazilatein di gayi hain, mujhe Jame-ul-Kalimat ata farmaye gaye hain. Sirf raub se meri madad ki gayi hai. Mere liye ghaneemat ka maal halal kiya gaya. Mere liye saari zameen masjid aur wuzu banayi gayi, main saari makhlooq ki taraf Nabi bana kar bheja gaya hoon aur mere saath nabiyon ko khatam kar diya gaya. Yeh hadees Tirmidhi mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Sahih kehte hain. Sahih Muslim wagaira mein mahal misaal wali riwayat mein yeh alfaaz bhi aaye hain ke main aaya aur main ne is eent ki jagah poori kar di. Musnad mein hai main Allah ke nazdeek nabiyon ka ilm karne wala tha us waqt jabke Adam poori tarah paida bhi nahin huye the. Aur hadees mein hai mere kayi naam hain, main Muhammad hoon aur main Ahmad hoon aur main Mahi hoon Allah Ta'ala meri wajah se kufr ko mita dega aur main Hashir hoon tamam logon ka hashr mere qadmon tale hoga aur main Aaqib hoon jis ke baad koi Nabi nahin (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr R.A farmate hain ek roz Huzoor ﷺ hamare paas aaye goya ke aap rukhsat kar rahe hain aur teen martaba farmaya main Ummi Nabi hoon mere baad koi Nabi nahin.

Main fatih kalmaat diya gaya hoon jo nihayat jame aur pooray hain. Main jaanta hoon ke jahannam ke daroghay kitnay hain aur arsh ke uthanay walay kitnay hain. Mera apni ummat se ta'aruf karaya gaya hai. Jab tak main tum mein hoon meri suntay raho aur mantay chalay jao. Jab main rukhsat ho jaoon toh Kitabullah ko mazboot thaam lo us ke halal ko halal aur us ke haram ko haram samjho (Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad). Is baray mein aur bhi bohat si hadeesein hain. Allah Ta'ala ki is wasee rahmat par us ka shukar karna chahiye ke us ne apnay raham-o-karam se aisay azeem Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hamari taraf bheja aur unhein Khatam-ul-Mursaleen aur Khatam-ul-Anbiya banaya aur yaksooi wala, aasaan, sacha aur sahal deen aap ke hathon kamal ko pohanchaya. Rabb-ul-Aalameen ne apni kitab mein aur Rahmat-ul-lil-Aalameen ne apni mutawatir ahadees mein yeh khabar di ke aap ke baad koi nabi nahin. Pas jo shakhs bhi aap ke baad nabuwat ya risalat ka da'wa karay woh jhoota, muftari, dajjal, gumrah aur gumrah karnay wala hai. Go woh shabday dikhaye aur jadugari karay aur baray kamalat aur aql ko hairan kar denay wali cheezein pesh karay aur tarah tarah ki bairangiyan dikhaye lekin aqalmand jaantay hain ke yeh sab fareb, dhoka aur makkari hai. Yaman ke mudda'i-e-nabuwat Ansi aur Yamama ke mudda'i-e-nabuwat Musailama Kazzab ko dekh lo ke duniya ne unhein jaisay yeh thay samajh liya aur un ki asliyat sab par zahir ho gayi. Yehi haal hoga har us shakhs ka jo qayamat tak is da'way se makhlooq ke samnay aayega ke us ka jhoot aur us ki gumrahi sab par khul jayegi. Yahan tak ke sab se aakhri Dajjal Maseeh aayega. Us ki alamaton se bhi har aalim aur har momin us ka kazzab hona jaan le ga pas yeh bhi Allah ki aik naimat hai ke aisay jhootay da'way daron ko yeh naseeb hi nahin hota ke woh neki ke ahkaam dein aur burai se rokein. Haan jin ahkaam mein un ka apna koi maqsad hota hai un par bohat zor detay hain. Un ke aqwal, af'aal iftira aur fujoor walay hotay hain. Jaisay farman-e-bari hai: (Hal unabbikum 'ala man tanazzalush-shayateen) (Surah (Ash-Shu'ara: 221) yani kya main tumhein bataoon ke shayateen kin ke paas aatay hain? Har aik bohtan baaz gunahgar ke paas. Sachay nabiyon ka haal us ke bilkul bar-aks hota hai woh nihayat neki walay, bohat sachay hidayat walay, istiqamat walay, qaul-o-fe'l ke achay, nekiyon ka hukum denay walay, buraiyon se rokne walay hotay hain. Saath hi Allah ki taraf se un ki ta'eed hoti hai. Mojzon se aur khariq-e-aadat cheezon se un ki sachai aur zyada zahir hoti hai. Aur is qadar zahir, wazeh aur saaf daleelein un ki nabuwat par hoti hain ke har qalb-e-saleem un ke mann-nay par majboor ho jata hai. Allah Ta'ala apnay tamam sachay nabiyon par qayamat tak durood-o-salam nazil farmata rahay.)

Ummi Khatam-ul-Anbiya (ﷺ). In ki tareef ho rahi hai jo Allah ki makhlooq ko Allah ka paigham pohanchate hain aur amanat-e-Ilahi ki adaigi karte hain aur us se darte rehte hain aur siwaye Allah ke kisi ka khauf nahin karte, kisi ki satwat-o-shan se mar'oob ho kar paigham-e-Allah ka pohanchane mein khauf nahin khate. Allah Ta'ala ki nusrat-o-imdad kaafi hai. Is mansab ki adaigi mein sab ke peshwa balkeh har ek amr mein sab ke sardar Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) hain. Khayal farmayiye ke mashriq-o-maghrib ke har ek bani-e-Adam ko Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Allah ke deen ki tableegh ki. Aur jab tak Allah ka deen char-dang-e-alam mein phail na gaya, aap musalsal mushaqqat ke sath Allah ke deen ki isha'at mein masroof rahe. Aap se pehle tamam ambiya (Alaihimas Salam) apni apni qoum hi ki taraf aate rahe lekin Huzoor (ﷺ) sari duniya ki taraf Allah ke Rasool ban kar aaye thay. Quran mein farman-e-Ilahi hai ke logon mein elaan kar do ke main tum sab ki taraf Allah ka Rasool hoon. Salam alaihi. Phir aap ke baad mansab-e-tableegh aap ki ummat ko mila. In mein sab ke sardar aap ke sahaba hain (Razi Allahu Anhum). Jo kuch unhon ne Huzoor (ﷺ) se seekha tha, sab kuch baad walon ko sikha diya. Tamam aqwal-o-af'aal jo ahwal din aur raat ke, safar-o-hazar ke, zahir-o-poshida duniya ke samne rakh diye. Allah un par apni razamandi nazil farmaye. Phir un ke baad wale un ke waris huye aur isi tarah phir baad wale apne se pehle walon ke waris bane aur Allah ka deen un se phailta raha. Aur Quran-o-Hadith logon tak pohanchte rahe, hidayat wale un ki iqtida se munawwar hote rahe aur taufeeq-e-khair wale un ke maslak par chalte rahe. Allah Kareem se hamari dua hai ke woh hamain bhi un mein se kar de. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai tum mein se koi apna aap zaleel na kare. Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) yeh kaise! Farmaya khilaf-e-shar'a kaam dekh kar, logon ke khauf ke mare khamosh ho rahe. Qayamat ke din us se baz-purs hogi ke tu kyun khamosh raha? Yeh kahega ke logon ke dar se. Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga sab se zyada khauf rakhne ke qabil to meri zaat thi. Phir Allah Ta'ala mana farmata hai ke kisi ko Huzoor (ﷺ) ka sahibzada kaha jaye. Log jo Zaid bin Muhammad kehte thay jis ka bayan oopar guzar chuka hai. To Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) Zaid ke walid nahin. Yehi hua ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ki koi narina aulad bulooghat ko pohanchi hi nahin. Qasim, Tayyab aur Tahir teen bache Hazrat Khadija (R.A) ke batn se, Hazrat Mariya Qibtiya (R.A) se ek bacha hua jis ka naam Hazrat Ibrahim lekin yeh bhi doodh pilane ke zamane mein hi inteqal kar gaye. Aap ki ladkiyan Hazrat Khadija se char thin Zainab, Ruqayya, Umme Kulsoom aur Fatima (R.A) ajma'een. In mein se teen to aap ki zindagi mein hi rihlat farma gayin sirf Hazrat Fatima (R.A) ka inteqal aap ke chhay mah baad hua. Phir farmata hai balkeh aap Allah ke Rasool aur Khatam-ul-Anbiya hain jaise farmaya Allah khoob janta hai jahan apni risalat rakhta hai. Yeh aayat nass hai is amr par ke aap ke baad koi nabi nahin. Aur jab nabi hi nahin to rasool kahan?

Koi Nabi, Rasool aap ke baad nahin aayega. Risalat toh Nabuwwat se bhi khaas cheez hai. Har Rasool Nabi hai lekin har Nabi Rasool nahin. Mutawatir ahadees se bhi Huzoor ﷺ ka Khatam-ul-Anbiya hona sabit hai. Bahut se Sahaba se yeh hadeesein riwayat ki gayi hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain: Meri misaal nabiyon mein aisi hai jaise kisi shakhs ne ek bahut achha aur poora makaan banaya lekin us mein ek eent ki jagah chhod di jahan kuch na rakha, log use charon taraf se dekhte bhalte aur us ki banawat se khush hote lekin kehte kya achha ho taake is eent ki jagah pur kar li jaati. Pas main nabiyon mein isi eent ki jagah hoon. Imam Tirmidhi bhi is hadees ko laye hain aur ise Hasan Sahih kaha hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool ﷺ farmate hain: Risalat aur Nabuwwat khatam ho gayi, mere baad na koi Rasool hai na Nabi. Sahaba R.A par yeh baat garan guzri toh aap ne farmaya lekin khushkhabriyaan dene wale. Sahaba ne poocha khushkhabriyaan dene wale kya hain? Farmaya musalmanon ke khwab jo nabuwwat ke ajza mein se ek juz hain. Yeh hadees bhi Tirmidhi Sharif mein hai aur Imam Tirmidhi ise Sahih Ghareeb kehte hain. Mahal ki misaal wali hadees Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein bhi hai. Is ke aakhir mein yeh hai ke main is eent ki jagah hoon, mujh se Anbiya Alaihimus Salam khatam kiye gaye. Ise Bukhari, Muslim aur Tirmidhi bhi laye hain. Musnad ki is hadees ki ek sanad mein hai ke main aaya aur main ne is khaali eent ki jagah pur kar di. Musnad mein hai mere baad nabuwwat nahin magar khushkhabri wale. Poocha gaya Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ woh kya hain? Farmaya achhe khwab ya farmaya nek khwab. Abdur Razzaq wagaira mein mahal ki eent ki misaal wali hadees mein hai ke log use dekh kar mahal wale se kehte hain ke tu ne is eent ki jagah kyun chhod di? Pas main woh eent hoon. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai Rasool ﷺ farmate hain: Mujhe tamam Anbiya par chhe fazilatein di gayi hain, mujhe Jame-ul-Kalimat ata farmaye gaye hain. Sirf raub se meri madad ki gayi hai. Mere liye ghaneemat ka maal halal kiya gaya. Mere liye saari zameen masjid aur wuzu banayi gayi, main saari makhlooq ki taraf Nabi bana kar bheja gaya hoon aur mere saath nabiyon ko khatam kar diya gaya. Yeh hadees Tirmidhi mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Sahih kehte hain. Sahih Muslim wagaira mein mahal misaal wali riwayat mein yeh alfaaz bhi aaye hain ke main aaya aur main ne is eent ki jagah poori kar di. Musnad mein hai main Allah ke nazdeek nabiyon ka ilm karne wala tha us waqt jabke Adam poori tarah paida bhi nahin huye the. Aur hadees mein hai mere kayi naam hain, main Muhammad hoon aur main Ahmad hoon aur main Mahi hoon Allah Ta'ala meri wajah se kufr ko mita dega aur main Hashir hoon tamam logon ka hashr mere qadmon tale hoga aur main Aaqib hoon jis ke baad koi Nabi nahin (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr R.A farmate hain ek roz Huzoor ﷺ hamare paas aaye goya ke aap rukhsat kar rahe hain aur teen martaba farmaya main Ummi Nabi hoon mere baad koi Nabi nahin.

Main fatih kalmaat diya gaya hoon jo nihayat jame aur pooray hain. Main jaanta hoon ke jahannam ke daroghay kitnay hain aur arsh ke uthanay walay kitnay hain. Mera apni ummat se ta'aruf karaya gaya hai. Jab tak main tum mein hoon meri suntay raho aur mantay chalay jao. Jab main rukhsat ho jaoon toh Kitabullah ko mazboot thaam lo us ke halal ko halal aur us ke haram ko haram samjho (Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad). Is baray mein aur bhi bohat si hadeesein hain. Allah Ta'ala ki is wasee rahmat par us ka shukar karna chahiye ke us ne apnay raham-o-karam se aisay azeem Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hamari taraf bheja aur unhein Khatam-ul-Mursaleen aur Khatam-ul-Anbiya banaya aur yaksooi wala, aasaan, sacha aur sahal deen aap ke hathon kamal ko pohanchaya. Rabb-ul-Aalameen ne apni kitab mein aur Rahmat-ul-lil-Aalameen ne apni mutawatir ahadees mein yeh khabar di ke aap ke baad koi nabi nahin. Pas jo shakhs bhi aap ke baad nabuwat ya risalat ka da'wa karay woh jhoota, muftari, dajjal, gumrah aur gumrah karnay wala hai. Go woh shabday dikhaye aur jadugari karay aur baray kamalat aur aql ko hairan kar denay wali cheezein pesh karay aur tarah tarah ki bairangiyan dikhaye lekin aqalmand jaantay hain ke yeh sab fareb, dhoka aur makkari hai. Yaman ke mudda'i-e-nabuwat Ansi aur Yamama ke mudda'i-e-nabuwat Musailama Kazzab ko dekh lo ke duniya ne unhein jaisay yeh thay samajh liya aur un ki asliyat sab par zahir ho gayi. Yehi haal hoga har us shakhs ka jo qayamat tak is da'way se makhlooq ke samnay aayega ke us ka jhoot aur us ki gumrahi sab par khul jayegi. Yahan tak ke sab se aakhri Dajjal Maseeh aayega. Us ki alamaton se bhi har aalim aur har momin us ka kazzab hona jaan le ga pas yeh bhi Allah ki aik naimat hai ke aisay jhootay da'way daron ko yeh naseeb hi nahin hota ke woh neki ke ahkaam dein aur burai se rokein. Haan jin ahkaam mein un ka apna koi maqsad hota hai un par bohat zor detay hain. Un ke aqwal, af'aal iftira aur fujoor walay hotay hain. Jaisay farman-e-bari hai: (Hal unabbikum 'ala man tanazzalush-shayateen) (Surah (Ash-Shu'ara: 221) yani kya main tumhein bataoon ke shayateen kin ke paas aatay hain? Har aik bohtan baaz gunahgar ke paas. Sachay nabiyon ka haal us ke bilkul bar-aks hota hai woh nihayat neki walay, bohat sachay hidayat walay, istiqamat walay, qaul-o-fe'l ke achay, nekiyon ka hukum denay walay, buraiyon se rokne walay hotay hain. Saath hi Allah ki taraf se un ki ta'eed hoti hai. Mojzon se aur khariq-e-aadat cheezon se un ki sachai aur zyada zahir hoti hai. Aur is qadar zahir, wazeh aur saaf daleelein un ki nabuwat par hoti hain ke har qalb-e-saleem un ke mann-nay par majboor ho jata hai. Allah Ta'ala apnay tamam sachay nabiyon par qayamat tak durood-o-salam nazil farmata rahay.)

Behtareen Dua. Bahut si naimaton ke inaam karne wale Allah ka hukm ho raha hai ke hamein us ka bakasrat zikr karna chahiye aur us par bhi hamein naimaton aur bade ajr-o-sawab ka wada diya jata hai. Ek martaba Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya kya main tumhare behtar amal aur bahut hi zyada pakeeza kaam aur sab se bade darje ki neki aur sone chandi ko rah-e-Allah kharch karne se bhi zyada behtar aur jihad se bhi afzal kaam na bataun? Logon ne poocha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) woh kya hai? Farmaya Allah Azzawajal ka zikr (Tirmidhi, Ibn Majah waghera). Yeh hadith pehle Wal-Zakireen ki tafsir mein bhi guzar chuki hai. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) farmate hain, main ne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh dua suni hai jise main kisi waqt tark nahin karta. Dua yeh hai: (Allahummaj-alni a'zama shukrika wa atba'a nasihatika wa aksara dhikrika wahfaz wasiyyatika) yani Aye Allah tu mujhe apna bahut bada shukr guzar, farman bardar, bakasrat zikr karne wala aur tere ahkaam ki hifazat karne wala bana de. (Tirmidhi waghera). Do a'rabi Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye. Ek ne poocha sab se achha shakhs kaun hai? Aap ne farmaya jo lambi umr paye, aur nek a'maal kare. Dusre ne poocha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ahkaam-e-Islam to bahut saare hain mujhe koi choti ka hukm bata dijiye ke us mein chimat jaun, aap ne farmaya zikr-e-Allah mein har waqt apni zaban ko tar rakh (Tirmidhi). Farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ka zikr mein har waqt mashghool raho yahan tak ke log tumhein majnoon kehne lagein (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ka ba-kasrat zikr karo yahan tak ke munafiq tumhein riya kaar kehne lagein (Tabrani). Farmate hain jo log kisi majlis mein baithein aur wahan Allah ka zikr na karein woh majlis Qayamat ke din un par hasrat-o-afsos ka ba'is banegi (Musnad). Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmate hain har farz kaam ki koi had hai. Phir uzr ki halat mein woh maaf bhi hai lekin zikr-e-Allah ki koi had nahin na woh kisi waqt talta hai. Haan koi deewana ho to aur baat hai. Khade baithe lete raat ko din ko khushki mein tari mein safar mein hazar mein ghina mein faqr mein sehat mein bimari mein poshidgi mein zahir mein garz har haal mein zikr-e-Allah karna chahiye. Subh-o-sham Allah ki tasbeeh bayan karni chahiye. Tum jab yeh karoge to Allah tum par apni rahmaten nazil farmaye ga aur farishte tumhare liye har waqt dua-go rahenge. Is baare mein aur bhi bahut si ahadith-o-aasar hain. Is aayat mein bhi bakasrat zikr-e-Allah karne ki hidayat ho rahi hai. Buzurgon ne zikr-e-Allah aur wazaif ki bahut si mustaqil kitabein likhi hain. Jaise Imam Nasai, Imam Ma'mari waghera. In sab mein behtareen kitab is mauzoo par Hazrat Imam Nawawi (R.H) ki hai, subh-o-sham us ki tasbeeh bayan karte raho. Jaise farmaya (فَسُـبْحٰنَ اللّٰهِ حِيْنَ تُمْسُوْنَ وَحِيْنَ تُصْبِحُوْنَ 17؀) (Surah (Ar-Rum: 17). Allah ke liye paki hai. Jab tum shaam karo aur jab tum subh karo, usi ke liye hamd hai aasmanon mein aur zameen mein aur ba'd az zawaal aur zuhr ke waqt, phir us ki fazilat bayan karne aur us ki taraf raghbat dilane ke liye farmata hai woh khud tum par rahmat bhej raha hai.

Ya'ni jab woh tumhari yaad rakhta hai toh phir kya wajah ke tum uske zikr se ghaflat karo? Jaise farmaya (Kama arsalna feekum rasoolam minkum yatloo 'alaikum ayatina wa yuzakkeekum wa yu'allimukumul kitaba wal hikmata wa yu'allimukum ma lam takoonoo ta'lamoon) (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 151). Jis tarah hum ne tum mein khud tumhi mein se rasool bheja jo tum par hamari kitab parhta hai aur woh sikhata hai jise tum jaante hi na thay. Pas tum mera zikr karo main tumhari yaad karoon ga aur tum mera shukr karo aur meri nashukri na karo. Hadith-e-Qudsi mein hai Allah Ta'ala farmata hai jo mujhe apne dil mein yaad karta hai main bhi use apne dil mein yaad karta hoon. Aur jo mujhe kisi jama'at mein yaad karta hai main bhi use jama'at mein yaad karta hoon jo uski jama'at se behtar hoti hai. Salat jab Allah ki taraf muzaf ho toh matlab yeh hota hai ke Allah Ta'ala uski bhalai apne farishton ke samne bayan karta hai. Aur qaul mein hai murad uski rahmat hai. Aur dono qaulon ka anjam ek hi hai. Farishton ki salat unki dua aur istighfar hai. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (Allazeena yahmiloonal 'arsha wa man haulahoo yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wa yu'minoona bihi wa yastaghfiroona lillazeena amanoo, rabbana wasi'ta kulla shai'ir rahmatan wa 'ilman faghfir lillazeena taboo wattaba'oo sabeelaka wa qihim 'azabal jaheem) (Surah (Ghafir: 7), 'Arsh ke uthane wale aur uske aas paas wale apne Rab ki hamd-o-tasbeeh bayan karte hain, us par iman late hain aur momin bandon ke liye istighfar karte hain ke ae hamare Rab tu ne har cheez ko rahmat-o-'ilm se gher liya hai. Ae Allah tu unhein bakhsh jo tauba karte hain aur teri raah par chalte hain. Unhein 'azab-e-jahannam se bhi nijat de. Unhein un jannaton mein le ja jin ka tu un se wa'da kar chuka hai. Aur unhein bhi un ke saath pahuncha jo un ke baap dadon, biwiyon aur auladon mein se nek hain, unhein buraiyon se bacha le. Woh Allah apni rahmat ko tum par nazil farma kar apne farishton ki dua ko tumhare haq mein qabool farma kar tumhein jahalat-o-zalalat ki andheriyon se nikal kar hidayat-o-yaqeen ke noor ki taraf le jata hai. Allah Ta'ala duniya aur aakhirat mein mominon par raheem-o-kareem hai. Duniya mein haq ki taraf unki rahnumai karta hai aur roziyan ata farmata hai aur aakhirat mein ghabrahat aur dar-o-khauf se bacha le ga. Farishte aa kar unhein basharat denge ke tum jahannam se azad ho aur jannati ho. Kyunke un farishton ke dil mominon ki mohabbat-o-ulfat se pur hain. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek martaba apne as-haab ke saath raaste se guzar rahe thay. Ek chota bacha raaste mein tha uski maa ne ek jama'at ko aate hue dekha toh mera bacha mera bacha kehti hui dauri aur bache ko god mein le kar ek taraf hat gayi. Maa ki is mohabbat ko dekh kar sahaba ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khayal toh farmaiye kya yeh apne bache ko aag mein daal degi?

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) un ke matlab ko samajh kar farmane lage qasam Allah ki! Allah Ta'ala bhi apne doston ko aag mein nahin daale ga. (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek qaidi aurat ko dekha ke us ne apne bachay ko dekhte hi utha liya aur apne kalejay se laga kar usay doodh pilane lagi, aap ne farmaya batao toh agar is ke ikhtiyar mein ho toh kya yeh apni khushi se apne bachay ko aag mein daal de gi? Sahaba ne kaha hargiz nahin, aap ne farmaya qasam hai Allah ki Allah Ta'ala apne bandon par is se bhi zyada meharban hai, Allah ki taraf se un ka samra jis din yeh is se milenge salam hoga. Jaise farmaya (Salamun qawlan mir Rabbir Raheem). Qatada (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain aapas mein ek dusre ko salam karenge. Is ki ta'eed bhi aayat (Da'wahum feeha Subhanakallahumma wa tahiyyatuhum feeha salamun, wa akhiru da'wahum anil hamdu lillahi Rabbil 'Alameen) (Surah (Yunus: 10) se hoti hai. Allah ne un ke liye ajr-e-kareem yani jannat ma' is ki tamam ne'maton ke tayyar kar rakhi hai. Jin mein se har ne'mat khana peena pehanna odhna auratein lazzatein manzar waghera aisi hain ke aaj toh kisi ke khwab-o-khayal mein bhi nahin aa saktein. Che ja'ikah dekhne mein ya sunne mein aayen.))))

Aur jo mujhe kisi jama'at mein yaad karta hai main bhi use jama'at mein yaad karta hoon jo uski jama'at se behtar hoti hai. Salat jab Allah ki taraf muzaf ho toh matlab yeh hota hai ke Allah Ta'ala uski bhalai apne farishton ke samne bayan karta hai. Aur qaul mein hai murad uski rahmat hai. Aur dono qaulon ka anjam ek hi hai. Farishton ki salat unki dua aur istighfar hai. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (Allazeena yahmiloonal 'arsha wa man haulahoo yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wa yu'minoona bihi wa yastaghfiroona lillazeena amanoo, rabbana wasi'ta kulla shai'ir rahmatan wa 'ilman faghfir lillazeena taboo wattaba'oo sabeelaka wa qihim 'azabal jaheem) (Surah (Ghafir: 7), 'Arsh ke uthane wale aur uske aas paas wale apne Rab ki hamd-o-tasbeeh bayan karte hain, us par iman late hain aur momin bandon ke liye istighfar karte hain ke ae hamare Rab tu ne har cheez ko rahmat-o-'ilm se gher liya hai. Ae Allah tu unhein bakhsh jo tauba karte hain aur teri raah par chalte hain. Unhein 'azab-e-jahannam se bhi nijat de. Unhein un jannaton mein le ja jin ka tu un se wa'da kar chuka hai. Aur unhein bhi un ke saath pahuncha jo un ke baap dadon, biwiyon aur auladon mein se nek hain, unhein buraiyon se bacha le. Woh Allah apni rahmat ko tum par nazil farma kar apne farishton ki dua ko tumhare haq mein qabool farma kar tumhein jahalat-o-zalalat ki andheriyon se nikal kar hidayat-o-yaqeen ke noor ki taraf le jata hai. Allah Ta'ala duniya aur aakhirat mein mominon par raheem-o-kareem hai. Duniya mein haq ki taraf unki rahnumai karta hai aur roziyan ata farmata hai aur aakhirat mein ghabrahat aur dar-o-khauf se bacha le ga. Farishte aa kar unhein basharat denge ke tum jahannam se azad ho aur jannati ho. Kyunke un farishton ke dil mominon ki mohabbat-o-ulfat se pur hain. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek martaba apne as-haab ke saath raaste se guzar rahe thay. Ek chota bacha raaste mein tha uski maa ne ek jama'at ko aate hue dekha toh mera bacha mera bacha kehti hui dauri aur bache ko god mein le kar ek taraf hat gayi. Maa ki is mohabbat ko dekh kar sahaba ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khayal toh farmaiye kya yeh apne bache ko aag mein daal degi?

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) un ke matlab ko samajh kar farmane lage qasam Allah ki! Allah Ta'ala bhi apne doston ko aag mein nahin daale ga. (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek qaidi aurat ko dekha ke us ne apne bachay ko dekhte hi utha liya aur apne kalejay se laga kar usay doodh pilane lagi, aap ne farmaya batao toh agar is ke ikhtiyar mein ho toh kya yeh apni khushi se apne bachay ko aag mein daal de gi? Sahaba ne kaha hargiz nahin, aap ne farmaya qasam hai Allah ki Allah Ta'ala apne bandon par is se bhi zyada meharban hai, Allah ki taraf se un ka samra jis din yeh is se milenge salam hoga. Jaise farmaya (Salamun qawlan mir Rabbir Raheem). Qatada (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain aapas mein ek dusre ko salam karenge. Is ki ta'eed bhi aayat (Da'wahum feeha Subhanakallahumma wa tahiyyatuhum feeha salamun, wa akhiru da'wahum anil hamdu lillahi Rabbil 'Alameen) (Surah (Yunus: 10) se hoti hai. Allah ne un ke liye ajr-e-kareem yani jannat ma' is ki tamam ne'maton ke tayyar kar rakhi hai. Jin mein se har ne'mat khana peena pehanna odhna auratein lazzatein manzar waghera aisi hain ke aaj toh kisi ke khwab-o-khayal mein bhi nahin aa saktein. Che ja'ikah dekhne mein ya sunne mein aayen.))))

Behtareen Dua. Bahut si naimaton ke inaam karne wale Allah ka hukm ho raha hai ke hamein us ka bakasrat zikr karna chahiye aur us par bhi hamein naimaton aur bade ajr-o-sawab ka wada diya jata hai. Ek martaba Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya kya main tumhare behtar amal aur bahut hi zyada pakeeza kaam aur sab se bade darje ki neki aur sone chandi ko rah-e-Allah kharch karne se bhi zyada behtar aur jihad se bhi afzal kaam na bataun? Logon ne poocha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) woh kya hai? Farmaya Allah Azzawajal ka zikr (Tirmidhi, Ibn Majah waghera). Yeh hadith pehle Wal-Zakireen ki tafsir mein bhi guzar chuki hai. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) farmate hain, main ne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh dua suni hai jise main kisi waqt tark nahin karta. Dua yeh hai: (Allahummaj-alni a'zama shukrika wa atba'a nasihatika wa aksara dhikrika wahfaz wasiyyatika) yani Aye Allah tu mujhe apna bahut bada shukr guzar, farman bardar, bakasrat zikr karne wala aur tere ahkaam ki hifazat karne wala bana de. (Tirmidhi waghera). Do a'rabi Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye. Ek ne poocha sab se achha shakhs kaun hai? Aap ne farmaya jo lambi umr paye, aur nek a'maal kare. Dusre ne poocha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ahkaam-e-Islam to bahut saare hain mujhe koi choti ka hukm bata dijiye ke us mein chimat jaun, aap ne farmaya zikr-e-Allah mein har waqt apni zaban ko tar rakh (Tirmidhi). Farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ka zikr mein har waqt mashghool raho yahan tak ke log tumhein majnoon kehne lagein (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ka ba-kasrat zikr karo yahan tak ke munafiq tumhein riya kaar kehne lagein (Tabrani). Farmate hain jo log kisi majlis mein baithein aur wahan Allah ka zikr na karein woh majlis Qayamat ke din un par hasrat-o-afsos ka ba'is banegi (Musnad). Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmate hain har farz kaam ki koi had hai. Phir uzr ki halat mein woh maaf bhi hai lekin zikr-e-Allah ki koi had nahin na woh kisi waqt talta hai. Haan koi deewana ho to aur baat hai. Khade baithe lete raat ko din ko khushki mein tari mein safar mein hazar mein ghina mein faqr mein sehat mein bimari mein poshidgi mein zahir mein garz har haal mein zikr-e-Allah karna chahiye. Subh-o-sham Allah ki tasbeeh bayan karni chahiye. Tum jab yeh karoge to Allah tum par apni rahmaten nazil farmaye ga aur farishte tumhare liye har waqt dua-go rahenge. Is baare mein aur bhi bahut si ahadith-o-aasar hain. Is aayat mein bhi bakasrat zikr-e-Allah karne ki hidayat ho rahi hai. Buzurgon ne zikr-e-Allah aur wazaif ki bahut si mustaqil kitabein likhi hain. Jaise Imam Nasai, Imam Ma'mari waghera. In sab mein behtareen kitab is mauzoo par Hazrat Imam Nawawi (R.H) ki hai, subh-o-sham us ki tasbeeh bayan karte raho. Jab tum shaam karo aur jab tum subh karo, usi ke liye hamd hai aasmanon mein aur zameen mein aur ba'd az zawaal aur zuhr ke waqt, phir us ki fazilat bayan karne aur us ki taraf raghbat dilane ke liye farmata hai woh khud tum par rahmat bhej raha hai.

Taurat mein Nabi-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sifaat. Ata bin Yasar farmate hain main ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin Aas (R.A) se kaha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sifatein Taurat mein kya hain? Farmaya jo sifatein aap ki Quran mein hain unhi mein baaz ausaf aap ke Taurat mein bhi hain. Taurat mein hai ae Nabi hum ne tujhe gawah aur khushi sunane wala, darane wala, ummatiyon ko bachane wala bana kar bheja hai. Tu mera banda aur Rasool hai. Main ne tera naam Mutawakkil rakha hai, tu bad-go aur fahash kalam nahin hai, na bazaron mein shor machane wala. Woh burai ke badle burai nahin karta balkeh darguzar karta hai aur maaf farmata hai. Use Allah Ta'ala qabz nahin karega jab tak logon ko tedha kar diye hue deen ko us ki zaat se bilkul seedha na kar de aur woh La Ilaha Illallah ke qail na ho jayen.
