Aur ayat mein hai ke tum logon par gawah ho aur tum par yeh Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) gawah hain. Aap mominon ko behtareen ajr ki basharat sunane wale aur kafiron ko badtareen azab ka dar sunane wale hain. Aur chunke Allah ka hukum hai us ki baja awari ke mat-hat aap makhlooq ko Khaliq ki ibadat ki taraf bulane wale hain. Aap ki sachai is tarah zahir hai jaise suraj ki roshni. Haan koi ziddi ad jaye to aur baat hai, aye Nabi! Kafiron aur munafiqon ki baat na mano na un ki taraf kaan lagao aur un se darguzar karo. Yeh jo eizayein pahunchate hain unhein khayal mein bhi na lao aur Allah par poora bharosa karo woh kafi hai.)

Nikah ki haqeeqat. Is ayat mein bahut se ahkaam hain. Is se maloom hota hai ke sirf aqd par bhi nikah ka itlaq hota hai. Is ke suboot mein is se zyada sarahat wali ayat aur nahin. Is mein ikhtilaf hai ke lafz-e-nikah haqeeqat mein sirf ijab-o-qabool ke liye hai? Ya sirf jima ke liye hai? Ya in dono ke majmoo'e ke liye? Quran-e-Kareem mein is ka itlaq aqd-o-wati dono par hi hua hai. Lekin is ayat mein sirf aqd par hi itlaq hai. Is ayat se yeh bhi sabit hota hai ke dukhool se pehle bhi khawand apni biwi ko talaq de sakta hai. Mominat ka zikr yahan par ba-wajah-e-ghalba ke hai warna hukm-e-kitabiya aurat ka bhi yahi hai. Salaf ki ek badi jamaat ne is ayat se istidlal kar ke kaha hai ke talaq usi waqt waqay hoti hai jab is se pehle nikah ho gaya ho. Is ayat mein nikah ke baad talaq ko farmaya hai pas maloom hua hai ke nikah se pehle na talaq sahih hai na woh waqay hoti hai. Imam Shafi aur Imam Ahmad aur bahut badi jamaat-e-salaf-o-khalaf ka yahi mazhab hai. Malik aur Abu Hanifa ka khayal hai ke nikah se pehle bhi talaq durust ho jati hai. Maslan kisi ne kaha ke agar main falan aurat se nikah karoon to us par talaq hai. To ab jab bhi us se nikah karega talaq parh jayegi. Phir Malik aur Abu Hanifa mein us shakhs ke bare mein ikhtilaf hai jo kahe ke jis aurat se main nikah karoon us par talaq hai to Imam Abu Hanifa kehte hain pas woh jis se nikah karega us par talaq parh jayegi aur Imam Malik ka qaul hai ke nahin parhegi kyunke Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se poocha gaya ke agar kisi shakhs ne nikah se pehle yeh kaha ho ke main jis aurat se nikah karoon us par talaq hai to kya hukm hai? Aap ne yeh ayat tilawat ki aur farmaya us aurat ko talaq nahin hogi. Kyunke Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne talaq ko nikah ke baad farmaya hai. Pas nikah se pehle ki talaq koi cheez nahin. Musnad-e-Ahmad, Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Ibn-e-Majah mein hai Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain. Ibn-e-Adam jis ka malik na ho us mein talaq nahin. Aur hadith mein hai jo talaq nikah se pehle ki ho woh kisi shumar mein nahin. (Ibn-e-Majah). Pas Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke jab tum aurton ko nikah ke baad hath lagane se pehle hi talaq de do to un par koi iddat nahin balkay woh jis se chahein usi waqt nikah kar sakti hain. Haan agar aisi halat mein un ka khawand faut ho gaya ho to yeh hukm nahin use chaar maah das din ki iddat guzarni paregi. Ulama ka is par ittefaq hai. Pas nikah ke baad hi miyan ne biwi ko is se pehle hi agar talaq de di hai to agar mehar muqarrar ho chuka hai to us ka aadha dena parega. Warna thora bahut de dena kafi hai. Aur ayat mein hai (Yaa Ayyuhallazeena Aamanoo Iza Nakahtumul Mominati Summa Tallaqtumoohunna Min Qabli An Tamassoohunna Famaa Lakum Alaihinna Min Iddatin Ta'taddoonaha, Famatti'oohunna Wa Sarrihoohunna Sarahan Jameela 49) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 49) yani agar mehar muqarrar ho chuka hai aur hath lagane se pehle hi talaq de di to aadhe mehar ki woh mustahiq hai.

Aur ayat mein irshad hai (لَاجُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ اِنْ طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَاۗءَ مَالَمْ تَمَسُّوْھُنَّ اَوْ تَفْرِضُوْا لَھُنَّ فَرِيْضَةً ۖ وَّمَتِّعُوْھُنَّ ۚ عَلَي الْمُوْسِعِ قَدَرُهٗ وَعَلَي الْمُقْتِرِ قَدَرُهٗ ۚ مَتَاعًۢا بالْمَعْرُوْفِ ۚ حَقًّا عَلَي الْمُحْسِـنِيْنَ) (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 236) yani agar tum apni biwiyon ko hath lagane se pehle hi talaq de do toh yeh kuch gunah ki baat nahin. Agar unka mehar muqarrar na hua ho toh tum unhein kuch na kuch de do. Apni apni taqat ke mutabiq, ameer-o-ghareeb dastoor ke mutabiq un se sulook karein aur bhale logon par yeh zaroori hai. Chunancha aisa ek waqea khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath bhi guzra. Ke aap ne Umaima bint Sharjeel se nikah kiya, yeh rukhsat ho kar aa gayin, aap gaye, hath barhaya toh goya us ne ise pasand na kiya, aap ne Hazrat Abu Usaid (R.A) ko hukum diya ke unka saman tayyar kar dein aur do kapre arziya ke unhein de dein. Pas sarah-e-jameel yani achhai se rukhsat kar dena yahi hai ke is surat mein agar mehar muqarrar hai toh aadha de de. Aur agar muqarrar nahin toh apni taqat ke mutabiq us ke sath kuch sulook kar de.))

Haq-e-Mehar aur basurat-e-alaihadgi ke ahkamat. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se farma raha hai ke aap ne apni jin biwiyon ko mehar ada kiya hai woh sab aap par halal hain. Aap ki tamam azwaj-e-mutahharat ka mehar sarhay barah oqiya tha jis ke paanch sau dirham hote hain. Haan Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Habibah bint-e-Abi Sufyan (R.A) ka mehar Hazrat Najashi (R.H) ne apne paas se chaar sau dinar diya tha. Aur isi tarah Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Safiyah bint-e-Huyay (R.A) ka mehar sirf un ki azadi thi. Khaibar ke qaidiyon mein aap bhi thin phir aap ne unhein azad kar diya aur isi azadi ko mehar qarar diya aur nikah kar liya. Aur Hazrat Juwairiyah bint-e-Harith Mustaliqiyah ne jitni raqam par mukatabah kiya tha woh puri raqam aap ne Hazrat Thabit bin Qais bin Shammas ko ada kar ke un se aqd bandha tha. Allah Ta'ala aap ki tamam azwaj-e-mutahharat par apni razamandi nazil farmaye. Isi tarah jo londiyan ghanimat mein aap ke qabze mein aayin woh bhi aap par halal hain. Safiyah aur Juwairiyah ke malik aap ho gaye the phir aap ne unhein azad kar ke un se nikah kar liya. Raihanah bint-e-Sham'oon Nasriyah aur Mariyah Qibtiyah (R.A) bhi aap ki malkiyat mein aayi thin. Hazrat Mariyah (R.A) se aap ko farzand bhi hua. Jin ka naam Hazrat Ibrahim tha. Chunke nikah ke bare mein nasraniyon ne ifrat aur yahudiyon ne tafrit se kaam liya tha is liye is adl-o-insaf wali sahal aur saaf shariyat ne darmiyana rah-e-haq ko zahir kar diya. Nasrani toh saat pushton tak jis aurat mard ka nasab na milta ho, un ka nikah jaiz jante the aur yahudi behan aur bhai ki ladki se bhi nikah kar lete the. Pas Islam ne bhanji bhatiji se nikah karne ko roka. Aur chacha ki ladki, phuphi ki ladki, mamu ki ladki aur khala ki ladki se nikah ko mubah qarar diya. Is ayat ke alfaz ki khubi par nazar daliye ke 'amm' aur 'khal' chacha aur mamu ke lafz ko toh wahid laye aur 'ammat' aur 'khallat' yani phuphi aur khala ke lafz ko jama laye. Jis mein mardon ki ek qisam ki fazilat aurton par sabit ho rahi hai. Jaise (Yukhrijunahum minan-nuri ilaz-zulumat) (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 257) aur jaise (Wa ja'alaz-zulumati wan-nur) (Surah (Al-An'am: 1). Yahan bhi chunke zulumat aur nur yani andhere aur ujale ka zikr tha aur ujale ko andhere par fazilat hai is liye woh lafz zulumat jama laye. Aur lafz nur mufrad laye. Is ki aur bhi bahut si nazirein di ja sakti hain, phir farmaya jinhon ne tere sath hijrat ki hai. Hazrat Umm-e-Hani (R.A) farmati hain mere paas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka manga aaya toh main ne apni mazuri zahir ki jise aap ne tasleem kar liya. Aur yeh ayat utri main hijrat karne waliyon mein na thi balkeh Fatah-e-Makkah ke baad iman lane waliyon mein thi. Mufassireen ne bhi yahi kaha hai ke murad hai ke jinhon ne Madine ki taraf aap ke sath hijrat ki ho. Qatadah se ek riwayat mein is se murad Islam lana bhi marwi hai.

Ibn Mas'ud R.A ki qira'at mein (وَامْرَاَةً مُّؤْمِنَةً اِنْ وَّهَبَتْ نَفْسَهَا للنَّبِيِّ اِنْ اَرَاد النَّبِيُّ اَنْ يَّسْتَنْكِحَهَا ۤ خَالِصَةً لَّكَ مِنْ دُوْنِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ ۭ قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا فَرَضْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ فِيْٓ اَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَمَا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَانُهُمْ لِكَيْلَا يَكُوْنَ عَلَيْكَ حَرَجٌ ۭ وَكَان اللّٰهُ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِيْمًا 50؀) (Al-Ahzab: 50). Phir farmaya aur woh momina aurat jo apna nafs apne Nabi ke liye hiba kardein. Aur Nabi bhi us se nikah karna chahein. Toh baghair mehar diye use nikah mein la sakte hain. Pas yeh hukm do sharton ke sath hai jaise aayat (وَلَا يَنْفَعُكُمْ نُصْحِيْٓ اِنْ اَرَدْتُّ اَنْ اَنْصَحَ لَكُمْ اِنْ كَان اللّٰهُ يُرِيْدُ اَنْ يُّغْوِيَكُمْ ۭ هُوَ رَبُّكُمْ ۣ وَاِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ 34؀ۭ) (Hud: 34) mein. Ya'ni Hazrat Nuh A.S apni qoum se farmate hain agar main tumhein nasihat karna chahun aur agar Allah tumhein is nasihat se mufeed karna na chahe toh meri nasihat tumhein koi nafa nahin de sakti. Aur jaise Hazrat Musa A.S ke is farman mein (يٰقَوْمِ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ اٰمَنْتُمْ باللّٰهِ فَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلُوْٓا اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّسْلِمِيْنَ 84؀) (Yunus: 84) ya'ni ae meri qoum agar tum Allah par iman laye ho. Aur agar tum musalman ho gaye ho toh tumhein Allah hi par bharosa karna chahiye. Pas jaise in aayaton mein do do sharait hain isi tarah is aayat mein bhi do sharait hain. Ek toh us ka apna nafs hiba karna dusre aap ka bhi use apne nikah mein lane ka irada karna. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ke paas ek aurat aayi aur kaha ke main apna nafs aap ke liye hiba karti hun. Phir woh der tak khadi rahein. Toh ek sahabi ne khade ho kar kaha Rasool Allah ﷺ agar aap in se nikah ka irada na rakhte hon toh mere nikah mein de dijiye. Aap ne farmaya tumhare paas kuch hai? Jo inhe mehar mein dein? Jawab diya ke is tehband ke siwa aur kuch nahin. Aap ne farmaya yeh agar tum inhe de doge toh khud baghair tehband ke reh jaoge kuch aur talash karo. Us ne kaha main aur kuch nahin pata. Aap ne farmaya talash toh karo go lohe ki angoothi hi mil jaye. Unhon ne har chand dekh bhaal ki lekin kuch na paya. Aap ne farmaya Quran ki kuch suratein bhi tumhein yaad hain? Us ne kaha falan falan suratein yaad hain. Aap ne farmaya bas inhi suraton par main ne inhe tumhare nikah mein diya. Yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai. Hazrat Anas R.A jab yeh waqia bayan karne lage toh un ki sahibzadi bhi sun rahi thin. Kehne lagin is aurat mein bahut hi kam haya thi. Toh aap ne farmaya tum se woh behtar thin ke Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat ki raghbat kar rahi thin aur aap par apna nafs pesh kar rahi thin (Bukhari). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek aurat Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aayin aur apni beti ki bahut si tareefein kar ke kehne lagin ke Huzoor meri murad yeh hai ke aap is se nikah kar lein. Aap ne qabool farma liya aur woh phir bhi tareef karti rahin.

Yahan tak ke kaha huzoor na woh kabhi woh bimar padein na sar mein dard hua yeh sun kar Aap ne farmaya phir mujhe is ki koi haajat nahin. Hazrat Ayesha R.A se marvi hai ke apne nafs ko hiba karne wali biwi sahiba Hazrat Khola bint-e-Hakim R.A thin. Aur riwayat mein hai yeh qabila Banu Saleem mein se thin. Aur riwayat mein hai yeh badi nek bakht aurat thin. Mumkin hai Umm-e-Saleem hi Hazrat Khola hon R.A. Aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke yeh dusri koi aurat hon. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne terah auraton se nikah kiya jin mein se chhe toh Quraishi thin. Khadija, Ayesha, Hafsa, Umm-e-Habiba, Sauda wa Umm-e-Salma R.A Ajma'een aur teen Banu Aamir bin Sa'sa'a ke qabile mein se thin aur do auratein qabila Banu Hilal bin Aamir mein se thin aur Hazrat Maimoona bint-e-Haris R.A. Yehi woh hain jinhon ne apna nafs Rasool-Allah ko hiba kiya tha aur Hazrat Zainab R.A jin ki kuniyat Umm-ul-Masakeen thi. Aur ek aurat Banu Abi Bakr bin Kilab se. Yeh wohi hai jis ne duniya ko ikhtiyar kiya tha aur Banu Joon mein se ek aurat jis ne panah talab ki thi, aur ek aurat Asadiya jin ka naam Zainab bint-e-Jahsh hai R.A. Do kaneezein thin. Safiya bint-e-Huyay bin Akhtab aur Juwairiya bint-e-Haris bin Amr bin Mustaliq Khuza'iya. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se marvi hai ke apne nafs ko hiba karne wali aurat Hazrat Maimoona bint-e-Haris thin lekin is mein inqita hai. Aur yeh riwayat mursal hai. Yeh mashhoor baat hai ke Hazrat Zainab jin ki kuniyat Umm-ul-Masakeen thi, yeh Zainab bint-e-Khuzaima thin, qabila Ansar mein se thin aur Huzoor ﷺ ki hayat mein hi inteqal kar gayin R.A. Wallahu A'lam, maqsad yeh hai ke woh auratein jinhon ne apne nafs ka ikhtiyar Aap ko diya tha chunancha Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Ayesha R.A se marvi hai ke main un auraton par ghairat kiya karti thi jo apna nafs Huzoor ﷺ ko hiba kar deti thin aur mujhe bada ta'ajjub maloom hota tha ke auratein apna nafs hiba karti hain. Jab yeh aayat utri ke (Turji man tasha'u minhunna wa tu'wi ilaika man tasha'u, wa manibtaghaita mimman azalta fala junaha 'alaika, zalika adna an taqarra a'yunuhunna wa la yahzanna wa yardaina bima ataitahunna kulluhunna, wallahu ya'lamu ma fi qulubikum, wa kanallahu 'aliman halima) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 51) al-kh, toh un mein se jise chahe us se na kar aur jise chahe apne paas jagah de aur jin se tu ne yaksooi kar li hai unhein bhi agar tum le aao toh tum par koi haraj nahin. Toh main ne kaha bas ab toh Allah Ta'ala ne Aap par khoob wus'at-o-kushadgi kar di. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se marvi hai ke koi aurat Huzoor ﷺ ke paas na thi jis ne apna nafs Aap ko hiba kiya ho. Hazrat Yunus bin Bukair farmate hain go Aap ke liye yeh mubah tha ke jo aurat apne tayin Aap ko sonp de Aap use apne ghar mein rakh lein lekin Aap ne aisa kiya nahin. Kyunke yeh amr Aap ki marzi par rakha gaya tha. Yeh baat kisi aur ke liye jaiz nahin haan mehar ada kar de toh beshak jaiz hai.

Chunancha Hazrat Barwa' bint-e-Washiq ke bare mein jinhon ne apna nafs sonp diya tha jab un ke shohar inteqal kar gaye to Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yahi faisla kiya tha ke un ke khandan ki aur aurton ke misl unhein mehar diya jaye. Jis tarah maut mehar ko muqarrar kar deti hai isi tarah sirf dukhool se bhi mehar wajib ho jata hai. Haan Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is hukm se mustasna thay. Aisi aurton ko kuch dena aap par wajib na tha go use sharaf bhi hasil ho chuka ho. Is liye ke aap ko baghair mehar ke aur baghair wali ke aur baghair gawahon ke nikah kar lene ka ikhtiyar tha jaisa ke Hazrat Zainab bint-e-Jahsh (R.A) ke qisse mein hai. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain kisi aurat ko yeh jaiz nahin ke apne aap ko baghair wali aur baghair mehar ke kisi ke nikah mein de de. Haan sirf Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke liye yeh tha. Aur mominon par jo hum ne muqarrar kar diya hai use hum khoob jante hain yani woh chaar se zyada biwiyan ek sath rakh nahin sakte. Haan un ke ilawa londiyan rakh sakte hain. Aur un ki koi tadaad muqarrar nahin. Isi tarah wali ki, mehar ki, gawahon ki bhi shart hai. Pas ummat ka to yeh hukm hai aur aap par is ki pabandiyan nahin. Taake aap ko koi haraj na ho. Allah bada Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai.)))

Riwayat-o-Ahkamat: Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se marvi hai ke main un aurton par aar rakha karti thi jo apna nafs Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hiba karein aur kehti thin ke auratein baghair mehar ke apne aap ko Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hawalay karne mein sharmati hain? Yahan tak ke yeh aayat utri toh main ne kaha ke aap ka Rabb aap ke liye kushadgi karta hai. Pas maloom hua ke aayat se murad yahi auratein hain. Un ke baare mein Allah ke Nabi ko ikhtiyar hai ke jisay chahein qabool karein aur jisay chahein qabool na farmayein. Phir is ke baad yeh bhi aap ke ikhtiyar mein hai ke jinhein qabool na farmaya ho unhein jab chahein nawaz dein. Aamir Sha'bi se marvi hai ke jinhein mu'akhar kar rakha tha un mein Hazrat Um-e-Shareek thin. Ek matlab is jumlay ka yeh bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke aap ki biwiyon ke baare mein aap ko ikhtiyar tha ke agar chahein taqseem karein, chahein na karein, jisay chahein muqaddam karein, jisay chahein mu'akhar karein. Isi tarah khaas baat-cheet mein bhi. Lekin yeh yaad rahe ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni poori umar barabar apni azwaj-e-mutahharat mein adl ke sath barabari ki taqseem karte rahe. Ba'az fuqaha-e-Shafi'iya ka qaul hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se marvi hai ke is aayat ke nazil ho chukne ke baad bhi Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum se ijazat liya karte the. Mujh se toh jab daryaft farmate main kehti agar mere bas mein ho toh main kisi aur ke paas aap ko hargiz na jaane doon. Pas sahih baat jo bahut achi hai aur jis se in aqwal mein mutabiqat bhi ho jaati hai woh yeh hai ke aayat aam hai. Apne nafs sonpne waliyon aur aap ki biwiyon sab ko shamil hai. Hiba karne waliyon ke baare mein nikah karne na karne aur nikah waliyon mein taqseem karne na karne ka aap ko ikhtiyar tha. Phir farmata hai ke yahi hukm bilkul munasib hai aur azwaj-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke liye sahoolat wala hai. Jab woh jaan lengi ke aap bariyon ke mukallaf nahin hain, phir bhi musawat qaim rakhte hain toh unhein bahut khushi hogi aur mamnoon-o-mashkoor hongi aur aap ke insaaf-o-adl ki daad dengi. Allah dilon ki halaton se waqif hai. Woh jaanta hai ke kisay kis ki taraf zyada raghbat hai. Musnad mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne taur par sahih taqseem aur pooray adl ke baad Allah se arz kiya karte the ke Ilah-ul-Aalameen jahan tak mere bas mein tha main ne insaaf kar diya. Ab jo mere bas mein nahin us par toh mujhe malamat na karna, ya'ni dil ke rujoo karne ka ikhtiyar mujhe nahin. Allah seenon ki baaton ka aalim hai, lekin hilm-o-karam wala hai, chashm-poshi karta hai, maaf farmata hai.

Azwaj-e-Mutahharat ka ahd-o-wafa. Pehli aayaton mein guzar chuka hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Azwaj-e-Mutahharat ko ikhtiyar diya ke agar woh chahein to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zaujiyat mein rahein aur agar chahein to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se alaihida ho jayein. Lekin Ummahat-ul-Momineen ne daman-e-Rasool ko chhorna pasand na farmaya. Is par unhein Allah ki taraf se ek dunyawi badla yeh bhi mila ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko is aayat mein hukum hua ke ab is ke siwa kisi aur aurat se nikah nahin kar sakte, na Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) in mein se kisi ko chhor kar us ke badle dusri la sakte hain go woh kitni hi khush-shakal kyun na ho? Haan laundiyon aur kaneezon ki aur baat hai. Is ke baad phir Rabb-ul-Aalameen ne yeh tangi Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par se utha li aur nikah ki ijazat de di, lekin khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne phir se koi aur nikah kiya hi nahin. Is haraj ke uthane mein aur phir amal ke na hone mein bahut bari maslahat yeh thi ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh ehsan apni biwiyon par rahe. Chunancha Hazrat Aisha (R.A) se marwi hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke inteqal se pehle hi Allah Ta'ala ne Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke liye aur auratein bhi halal kar di thin (Tirmidhi, Nasai waghera). Hazrat Umme Salama (R.A) se bhi marwi hai. Halal karne wali aayat (تُرْجِيْ مَنْ تَشَاۗءُ مِنْهُنَّ وَ تُـــــْٔوِيْٓ اِلَيْكَ مَنْ تَشَاۗءُ ۭ وَمَنِ ابْتَغَيْتَ مِمَّنْ عَزَلْتَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكَ ۭ ذٰلِكَ اَدْنٰٓى اَنْ تَقَرَّ اَعْيُنُهُنَّ وَلَا يَحْزَنَّ وَيَرْضَيْنَ بِمَآ اٰتَيْتَهُنَّ كُلُّهُنَّ ۭ وَاللّٰهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِيْ قُلُوْبِكُمْ ۭ وَكَان اللّٰهُ عَلِــيْمًا حَلِــيْمًا 51؀) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 51) hai, jo is aayat se pehle guzar chuki hai, bayan mein woh pehle hai aur utarne mein woh peeche hai. Surah Baqarah mein bhi is tarah iddat-e-wafat ki pichli aayat mansookh hai aur pehli aayat is ki nasikh hai. Wallahu A'lam. Is aayat ke ek aur ma'ani bhi bahut se hazrat se marwi hain. Woh kehte hain matlab is se yeh hai ke jin auraton ka zikr is se pehle hai un ke siwa aur halal nahin, jin mein yeh sifatein hon woh in ke alawa bhi halal hain. Chunancha Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) se sawal hua ke kya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki jo biwiyan thin agar woh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki maujoodgi mein inteqal kar jayein to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur auraton se nikah nahin kar sakte the? Aap (R.A) ne farmaya yeh kyun? To sail ne 'la yahillu' wali aayat parhi. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Ubayy (R.A) ne farmaya is aayat ka matlab to yeh hai ke auraton ki jo qismein is se pehle bayan hui hain yani nikah-ta biwiyan, laundiyan, chacha ki, phuphiyon ki, mamu aur khalaon ki betiyan, hiba karne wali auratein. In ke siwa jo aur qisam ki hon jin mein yeh ausaf na hon woh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par halal nahin hain (Ibn Jarir). Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke siwaye in Muhajirat-e-Mominaat ke aur auraton se nikah karne ki Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko mumanat kar di gayi. Ghair muslim auraton se nikah haram kar diya gaya. Quran mein hai (وَمَنْ يَّكْفُرْ بالْاِيْمَانِ فَقَدْ حَبِطَ عَمَلُهٗ ۡ وَهُوَ فِي الْاٰخِرَةِ مِنَ الْخٰسِرِيْنَ ۧ) (Surah (Al-Ma'idah: 5) yani iman ke baad kufr karne wale ke a'maal gharat hain.

Pas Allah Ta'ala ne aayat (Yaa Ayyuhan-Nabiyyu Innaa Ahlalnaa Laka Azwaajakal-Laatee Aatayta Ujoorahunna Wa Maa Malakat Yameenuka Mimma Afaa'allaahu 'Alaika Wa Banaati 'Ammika Wa Banaati 'Ammaatika Wa Banaati Khaalika Wa Banaati Khaalika Al-Laatee Haajarna Ma'aka Wamra'atam-Mu'minatan Inw-Wahabat Nafsahaa Lin-Nabiyyi In Araadan-Nabiyyu Ay-Yastankihahaa Khaalisatal-Laka Min Doonil-Mu'mineen. Qad 'Alimnaa Maa Faradnaa 'Alaihim Fee Azwaajihim Wa Maa Malakat Aymaanuhum Likailaa Yakoona 'Alaika Haraj. Wa Kaanallaahu Ghafoorar-Raheemaa) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 50), mein aurton ki jin qismon ka zikr kiya woh toh halaal hain un ke maswa aur haraam hain. Mujahid R.H farmate hain un ke siwa har qism ki auratein khwah woh musalman hon khwah yahoodiya hon khwah nasraniya sab haraam hain. Abu Saleh R.H farmate hain ke a'rabiya aur anjaan aurton se nikah se rok diye gaye. Lekin jo auratein halaal thin un mein se agar chahein saikron kar lein halaal hain. Al-gharz aayat aam hai un aurton ko jo aap ke ghar mein thin aur un aurton ko jin ki aqsaam bayaan huin sab ko shamil hai aur jin logon se is ke khilaf marwi hai un se is ke mutabiq bhi marwi hai. Lehaza koi manfi nahin. Haan is par ek baat baqi reh jaati hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Hafsa (R.A) ko talaq de di thi phir un se ruju kar liya tha aur Hazrat Sauda (R.A) ke firaq ka bhi irada kiya tha jis par unhon ne apni baari ka din Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ko de diya tha. Is ka jawab Imam Ibn-e-Jareer R.H ne yeh diya hai ke yeh waqia is aayat ke nazil hone se pehle ka hai. Baat yahi hai lekin hum kehte hain is jawab ki bhi zaroorat nahin. Is liye ke aayat mein un ke siwa doosriyon se nikah karne aur unhein nikal kar auron ko lane ki muman'at hai na ke talaq dene ki, Wallahu A'lam. Sauda (R.A) wale waqia mein aayat (Wa Inimra'atun Khaafat Mim-Ba'lihaa Nushoozan Aw I'raadan Falaa Junaaha 'Alaihimaa Ay-Yuslihaa Bainahumaa Sulhan. Was-Sulhu Khair. Wa Uhdiratil-Anfusush-Shuh. Wa In Tuhsinoo Wa Tattaqoo Fa'innallaaha Kaana Bimaa Ta'maloona Khabeera) (Surah (An-Nisa: 128) utri hai aur Hazrat Hafsa (R.A) wala waqia Abu Dawood waghera mein marwi hai. Abu Ya'la mein hai ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) apni sahibzadi Hazrat Hafsa (R.A) ke paas ek din aaye dekha ke woh ro rahi hain poocha ke shayad tumhein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne talaq de di. Suno agar ruju ho gaya aur phir yahi mauqa pesh aaya toh qasam Allah ki main marte dam tak tum se kalam na karunga. Aayat mein Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko zyada karne se aur kisi ko nikal kar us ke badle doosri ko lane se mana kiya hai. Magar londiyan halaal rakhi gayin.

Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) farmate hain ke jahiliyat mein ek khabeeth riwaj yeh bhi tha ke log aapas mein biwiyon ka tabadla kar liya karte thay, yeh apni use de deta tha aur woh apni use de deta tha. Islam ne is ganday tareeqay se musalmanon ko rok diya. Ek martaba ka waqia hai ke Uyaynah bin Hisn Fazari Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye aur apni jahiliyat ki aadat ke mutabiq baghair ijazat liye chalay aaye. Is waqt aap ke paas Hazrat Aishah (R.A) baithi hui thin. Aap ne farmaya tum baghair ijazat kyun chalay aaye? Us ne kaha wah! Main ne toh aaj tak qabeela Mudar ke khandan ke kisi shakhs se ijazat mangi hi nahin. Phir kehne laga yahan aap ke paas kaun si aurat baithi hui thin? Aap ne farmaya yeh Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Aishah (R.A) thin. Toh kehne laga Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) inhe chhor dein, main in ke badlay apni biwi aap ko deta hoon jo khoobsurti mein bemisal hai. Aap ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne aisa karna haram kar diya hai. Jab woh chalay gaye toh Mai Sahiba ne daryaft farmaya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh kaun tha? Aap ne farmaya ek ahmaq sardar tha. Tum ne in ki baatein sunin? Is par bhi yeh apni qoum ka sardar hai. Is riwayat ka ek rawi Ishaq bin Abdullah bilkul giray huay darjay ka hai.))))

Ahkamat-e-Parda. Is aayat mein parde ka hukm hai aur shar'i aadaab-o-ahkaam ka bayaan hai. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke qaul ke mutabiq jo aayatein utri hain un mein ek yeh bhi hai. Bukhari Muslim mein aap se marwi hai ke teen baatein maine kahin jin ke mutabiq hi Rabb-ul-Aalameen ke ahkaam naazil hue. Maine kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Agar aap Maqam-e-Ibrahim ko qibla banayein toh behtar ho. Allah Ta'ala ka bhi yahi hukm utra ke (WATTAKHIZU MIN MAQAMI IBRAHIMA MUSALLA) (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 125). Maine kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Mujhe toh yeh achha nahin maloom hota ke ghar mein har koi yani chhota bada aajaye, aap apni biwiyon ko parde ka hukm dein toh achha ho, pas Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se parde ka hukm naazil hua. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ) ki azwaaj-e-mutahharaat ghairat ki wajah se kuch kehne sunne lagein toh maine kaha kisi ghuroor mein na rehna, agar Huzoor (ﷺ) tumhein chhod dein toh Allah Ta'ala tum se behtar biwiyan aap ko dilwayega, chunancha yahi aayat Quran mein naazil hui. Sahih Muslim mein ek chauthi muwafiqat bhi mazkoor hai woh Badr ke qaidiyon ka faisla hai aur riwayat mein hai sanah 5 Hijri maah-e-Zul-Qa'dah mein jabke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Zainab bint-e-Jahsh (R.A) se nikah kiya hai. Jo nikah khud Allah Ta'ala ne karaya tha, isi subah ko parde ki aayat naazil hui hai. Baaz hazraat kehte hain yeh waqea san teen hijri ka hai. Wallahu A'lam. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein Huzoor (ﷺ) ne jab Hazrat Zainab bint-e-Jahsh (R.A) se nikah kiya toh logon ki dawat ki, woh kha pee kar baaton mein baithe rahe, aap ne uthne ki tayari bhi ki. Phir bhi woh na uthe, yeh dekh kar aap khade ho gaye, aap ke saath hi kuch log toh uth kar chal diye lekin phir bhi teen shakhs wahin baithe reh gaye aur baatein karte rahe. Huzoor (ﷺ) palat kar aaye toh dekha ke woh abhi tak baaton mein lage hue hain. Aap phir laut gaye. Jab yeh log chale gaye toh Hazrat Anas (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ) ko khabar di. Ab aap aaye, ghar mein tashreef le gaye, Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain maine bhi jaana chaha toh aap ne apne aur mere darmiyan parda kar liya aur yeh aayat utri. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne is mauqa par gosht roti khilayi thi aur Hazrat Anas (R.A) ko bheja tha ke logon ko bula layein, log aate the, khaate the aur wapas jaate the. Jab ek bhi aisa na bacha ke jise Hazrat Anas (R.A) bulate toh aap ko khabar di, aap ne farmaya ab dastarkhwan badha do, log sab chale gaye magar teen shakhs baaton mein lage rahe. Huzoor (ﷺ) yahan se nikal kar Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke paas gaye aur farmaya Assalamu Alaikum Ahl-ul-Baiti wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuhu. Unhon ne jawab diya Wa Alaikumussalam wa Rahmatullah, farmayiye Huzoor (ﷺ) biwi sahiba se khush toh hain? Aap ne farmaya Allah tumhein barkat de. Isi tarah aap apni tamam azwaaj-e-mutahharaat ke paas gaye aur sab jagah yahi baatein huin. Ab laut kar jo aaye toh dekha ke woh teeno sahab ab tak gaye nahin.

Chunki aap mein sharm-o-haya, lihaz-o-muruwwat behad tha is liye aap kuch farma na sake aur phir se Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ke hujre ki taraf chale. Ab na jaane main ne khabar di ya aap ko khud khabardar kar diya gaya ki woh teenon bhi chale gaye hain to aap phir aaye aur chaukhat mein ek qadam rakhte hi aap ne parda daal diya aur parde ki aayat nazil hui. Ek riwayat mein bajaye teen shakhson ke do ka zikr hai. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ki aap ke kisi naye nikah par Hazrat Umme Sulaim ne malida bana kar ek bartan mein rakh kar Hazrat Anas (R.A) se kaha ise Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko pahunchao aur keh dena ki yeh thoda sa tohfa hamari taraf se qabool farmayiye aur mera salam bhi keh dena. Us waqt log the bhi tangi mein. Main ne ja kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko salam kiya, Ummul Momineen ka salam pahunchaya aur paigham bhi. Aap ne ise dekha aur farmaya achha ise rakh do. Main ne ghar ke ek kone mein rakh diya phir farmaya jao falan aur falan ko bula lao, bahut se logon ke naam liye aur phir farmaya in ke alawa jo musalman mil jaye main ne yahi kiya. Jo mila use Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke haan khane ke liye bhejta raha, wapas lauta to dekha ki ghar aur anganai aur baithak sab logon se bhare hue hain, taqreeban teen sau aadmi jama ho gaye the. Ab mujh se aap ne farmaya aao woh pyala utha lao, main laya to aap ne apna hath us par rakh kar dua ki aur jo Allah ne chaha aap ne zaban se kaha, phir farmaya chalo das das aadmi halqa kar ke baith jao aur har ek Bismillah keh kar apne apne aage se khana shuru karo. Isi tarah khana shuru hua aur sab ke sab kha chuke to aap ne farmaya pyala utha lo. Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain main ne pyala utha kar dekha to main nahin keh sakta ki jis waqt rakha us waqt us mein zyada khana tha ya ab? Chand log aap ke ghar mein thehar gaye, un mein baatein ho rahi thin aur Ummul Momineen deewar ki taraf munh phere baithi hui thin, un ka itni der tak na hatna Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par shaq guzar raha tha lekin sharm-o-lihaz ki wajah se kuch farmate na the, agar unhein is baat ka ilm ho jata to woh nikal jaate lekin woh be-fikri se baithte hi rahe. Aap ghar se nikal kar aur azwaj-e-mutahharat ke hujron ke paas chale gaye phir wapas aaye to dekha ki woh baithe hue hain. Ab to yeh bhi samajh gaye, bade nadim hue aur jaldi se nikal liye, aap andar badhe aur parda latka diya. Main bhi hujre mein hi tha jab yeh aayat utri aur aap is ki tilawat karte hue bahar aaye, sab se pehle is aayat ko aurton ne suna aur main to sab se awwal in ka sunne wala hoon. Pehle Hazrat Zainab (R.A) ke paas aap ka manga le jaane ki riwayat aayat (Falamma qada Zaidun) al-kh, ki tafseer mein guzar chuki hai, is ke aakhir mein baaz riwayaton mein yeh bhi hai ki phir logon ko nasihat ki gayi aur Hashim ki is hadith mein is aayat ka bayan bhi hai. Ibn Jarir mein hai ki raat ke waqt azwaj-e-mutahharat qaza-e-hajat ke liye jungle ko jaya karti thin. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko yeh pasand na tha, aap farmaya karte the ki unhein is tarah na jaane dijiye.

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is par tawajjo nahin farmate thay. Ek martaba Hazrat Sauda bint-e-Zama (R.A) niklin toh chunke Farooq-e-Azam ki mansha yeh thi ke kisi tarah azwaj-e-mutahharat ka yeh nikalna band ho, is liye unhein unke qad-o-qamat ki wajah se pehchan kar ba-awaz-e-buland kaha ke hum ne tumhein ae Sauda pehchan liya. Is ke baad parde ki ayatein utrin. Is riwayat mein yunhi hai lekin mashhoor yeh hai ke yeh waqia nuzool-e-hijab ke baad ka hai. Chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ki riwayat hai ke hijab ke hukum ke baad Hazrat Sauda (R.A) niklin, is mein yeh bhi hai ke yeh usi waqt wapas aagayin. An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) shaam ka khana tanawul farma rahe thay. Ek haddi haath mein thi, aa kar waqia bayan kiya, usi waqt wahi nazil hui, jab khatam hui us waqt bhi haddi haath mein hi thi, use chhori hi na thi. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala tumhari zarooraton ki bina par bahar nikalne ki ijazat deta hai. Ayat mein Allah Ta'ala musalmanon ko is aadat se rokta hai jo jahiliyat mein aur ibtida-e-Islam mein un mein thi ke baghair ijazat dusre ke ghar mein chale jana. Pas Allah Ta'ala is ummat ka ikram karte hue ise yeh adab sikhata hai. Chunancha ek hadith mein bhi yeh mazmoon hai ke khabardar aurton ke paas na jao. Phir Allah ne unhein mustasna kar liya jinhein ijazat de di jaye. Toh farmaya magar yeh ke tumhein ijazat di jaye. Khane ke liye aise waqt par na jao ke tum us ki tayari ke muntazir na raho. Mujahid aur Qatada farmate hain ke khane ke pakne aur us ke tayar hone ke waqt hi na pahuncho. Jab samjha ke khana tayar hoga, ja ghuse, yeh khaslat Allah ko pasand nahin. Yeh daleel hai tufaili banne ki hurmat par. Imam Khatib Baghdadi (R.H) ne is ki muzammat mein poori ek kitab likhi hai. Phir farmaya jab bulaye jao tum phir jao aur jab kha chuko toh nikal jao. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai ke tum mein se kisi ko jab us ka bhai bulaye toh use dawat qabool karni chahiye khwah nikah ki ho ya koi aur, aur hadith mein hai agar mujhe faqat ek khur ki dawat di jaye toh bhi main use qabool karunga. Dastoor-e-dawat bhi bayan farmaya ke jab kha chuko toh ab mezban ke yahan chaukri maar kar na baith jao. Balki wahan se chale jao. Baaton mein mashghool na ho jaya karo. Jaise un teen shakhson ne kiya tha. Jis se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko takleef hui lekin sharmindagi aur lihaz se aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kuch na bole, isi tarah matlab yeh bhi hai ke tumhara be-ijazat An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke gharon mein chale jana aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par shaaq guzarta hai lekin aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ba-wajah-e-sharm-o-haya ke tum se keh nahin sakte. Allah Ta'ala tum se saaf saaf farma raha hai ke ab se aisa na karna. Woh haq hukum se haya nahin karta. Tumhein jis tarah be-ijazat aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyon ke paas jana mana hai isi tarah un ki taraf aankh utha kar dekhna bhi haram hai. Agar tumhein un se koi zaroori cheez leni deni bhi ho toh pas-e-parda len-den ho. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek martaba malida kha rahe thay, Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko bhi bula liya, aap (R.A) bhi khane baith gaye.

Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) pehle hi se khane mein shareek thin. Hazrat Umar (R.A) azwaj-e-mutahharat ke parde ki tamanna mein thay. Khate hue ungliyon se ungliyan lag gayin toh besakhta farmane lage, kaash ke meri maan li jati aur parda karaya jata toh kisi ki nigah bhi na padti. Us waqt parde ka hukum utra. Phir parde ki tareef farma raha hai ke mardon auraton ke dilon ki pakeezgi ka yeh zariya hai. Kisi shakhs ne Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki kisi biwi se Aap (ﷺ) ke baad nikah karne ka irada kiya hoga, is aayat mein yeh haram qarar diya gaya. Chyunke Huzoor (ﷺ) ki biwiyan zindagi mein aur jannat mein bhi Aap (ﷺ) ki biwiyan hain aur jumla musalmanon ki woh maayen hain, is liye musalmanon par un se nikah karna mahaz haram hai. Yeh hukum un biwiyon ke liye jo Aap (ﷺ) ke ghar mein Aap (ﷺ) ke inteqal ke waqt thin, sab ke nazdeek ijma'an hai. Lekin jis biwi ko Aap (ﷺ) ne apni zindagi mein talaq de di aur us se mel ho chuka ho toh us se koi aur nikah kar sakta hai ya nahin? Is mein do mazhab hain aur jis se dukhool na kiya aur talaq de di ho us se dusre log nikah kar sakte hain. Qailah bint-e-Ash'as bin Qais Huzoor (ﷺ) ki malkiyat mein aa gayi thi, Aap (ﷺ) ke inteqal ke baad us ne Ikrimah bin Abu Jahl se nikah kar liya. Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) par yeh giran guzra lekin Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne samjhaya ke ae Khalifa-e-Rasool! Yeh Huzoor (ﷺ) ki biwi na thi, na ise Huzoor (ﷺ) ne ikhtiyar diya, na ise parde ka hukum diya aur is ki qoum ke irtidad ke sath hain, is ke irtidad ki wajah se Allah ne ise Huzoor (ﷺ) se bari kar diya. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ka itminan ho gaya. Pas in dono baton ki burai bayan farmata hai ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko eeza dena, un ki biwiyon se un ke baad nikah kar lena, yeh dono gunah Allah ke nazdeek bahut bade hain. Tumhari poshidgiyan aur alaniya baatein sab Allah par zahir hain, us par koi choti se choti cheez bhi poshida nahin. Aankhon ki khayanat ko, seene mein chupi hui baton aur dil ke iradon ko woh janta hai.)

Ahkamat-e-Parda. Is aayat mein parde ka hukm hai aur shar'i aadaab-o-ahkaam ka bayaan hai. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke qaul ke mutabiq jo aayatein utri hain un mein ek yeh bhi hai. Bukhari Muslim mein aap se marwi hai ke teen baatein maine kahin jin ke mutabiq hi Rabb-ul-Aalameen ke ahkaam naazil hue. Maine kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Agar aap Maqam-e-Ibrahim ko qibla banayein toh behtar ho. Allah Ta'ala ka bhi yahi hukm utra ke (WATTAKHIZU MIN MAQAMI IBRAHIMA MUSALLA) (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 125). Maine kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Mujhe toh yeh achha nahin maloom hota ke ghar mein har koi yani chhota bada aajaye, aap apni biwiyon ko parde ka hukm dein toh achha ho, pas Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se parde ka hukm naazil hua. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ) ki azwaaj-e-mutahharaat ghairat ki wajah se kuch kehne sunne lagein toh maine kaha kisi ghuroor mein na rehna, agar Huzoor (ﷺ) tumhein chhod dein toh Allah Ta'ala tum se behtar biwiyan aap ko dilwayega, chunancha yahi aayat Quran mein naazil hui. Sahih Muslim mein ek chauthi muwafiqat bhi mazkoor hai woh Badr ke qaidiyon ka faisla hai aur riwayat mein hai sanah 5 Hijri maah-e-Zul-Qa'dah mein jabke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Zainab bint-e-Jahsh (R.A) se nikah kiya hai. Jo nikah khud Allah Ta'ala ne karaya tha, isi subah ko parde ki aayat naazil hui hai. Baaz hazraat kehte hain yeh waqea san teen hijri ka hai. Wallahu A'lam. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein Huzoor (ﷺ) ne jab Hazrat Zainab bint-e-Jahsh (R.A) se nikah kiya toh logon ki dawat ki, woh kha pee kar baaton mein baithe rahe, aap ne uthne ki tayari bhi ki. Phir bhi woh na uthe, yeh dekh kar aap khade ho gaye, aap ke saath hi kuch log toh uth kar chal diye lekin phir bhi teen shakhs wahin baithe reh gaye aur baatein karte rahe. Huzoor (ﷺ) palat kar aaye toh dekha ke woh abhi tak baaton mein lage hue hain. Aap phir laut gaye. Jab yeh log chale gaye toh Hazrat Anas (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ) ko khabar di. Ab aap aaye, ghar mein tashreef le gaye, Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain maine bhi jaana chaha toh aap ne apne aur mere darmiyan parda kar liya aur yeh aayat utri. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne is mauqa par gosht roti khilayi thi aur Hazrat Anas (R.A) ko bheja tha ke logon ko bula layein, log aate the, khaate the aur wapas jaate the. Jab ek bhi aisa na bacha ke jise Hazrat Anas (R.A) bulate toh aap ko khabar di, aap ne farmaya ab dastarkhwan badha do, log sab chale gaye magar teen shakhs baaton mein lage rahe. Huzoor (ﷺ) yahan se nikal kar Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke paas gaye aur farmaya Assalamu Alaikum Ahl-ul-Baiti wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuhu. Unhon ne jawab diya Wa Alaikumussalam wa Rahmatullah, farmayiye Huzoor (ﷺ) biwi sahiba se khush toh hain? Aap ne farmaya Allah tumhein barkat de. Isi tarah aap apni tamam azwaaj-e-mutahharaat ke paas gaye aur sab jagah yahi baatein huin. Ab laut kar jo aaye toh dekha ke woh teeno sahab ab tak gaye nahin.

Chunki aap mein sharm-o-haya, lihaz-o-muruwwat behad tha is liye aap kuch farma na sake aur phir se Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ke hujre ki taraf chale. Ab na jaane main ne khabar di ya aap ko khud khabardar kar diya gaya ki woh teenon bhi chale gaye hain to aap phir aaye aur chaukhat mein ek qadam rakhte hi aap ne parda daal diya aur parde ki aayat nazil hui. Ek riwayat mein bajaye teen shakhson ke do ka zikr hai. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ki aap ke kisi naye nikah par Hazrat Umme Sulaim ne malida bana kar ek bartan mein rakh kar Hazrat Anas (R.A) se kaha ise Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko pahunchao aur keh dena ki yeh thoda sa tohfa hamari taraf se qabool farmayiye aur mera salam bhi keh dena. Us waqt log the bhi tangi mein. Main ne ja kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko salam kiya, Ummul Momineen ka salam pahunchaya aur paigham bhi. Aap ne ise dekha aur farmaya achha ise rakh do. Main ne ghar ke ek kone mein rakh diya phir farmaya jao falan aur falan ko bula lao, bahut se logon ke naam liye aur phir farmaya in ke alawa jo musalman mil jaye main ne yahi kiya. Jo mila use Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke haan khane ke liye bhejta raha, wapas lauta to dekha ki ghar aur anganai aur baithak sab logon se bhare hue hain, taqreeban teen sau aadmi jama ho gaye the. Ab mujh se aap ne farmaya aao woh pyala utha lao, main laya to aap ne apna hath us par rakh kar dua ki aur jo Allah ne chaha aap ne zaban se kaha, phir farmaya chalo das das aadmi halqa kar ke baith jao aur har ek Bismillah keh kar apne apne aage se khana shuru karo. Isi tarah khana shuru hua aur sab ke sab kha chuke to aap ne farmaya pyala utha lo. Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain main ne pyala utha kar dekha to main nahin keh sakta ki jis waqt rakha us waqt us mein zyada khana tha ya ab? Chand log aap ke ghar mein thehar gaye, un mein baatein ho rahi thin aur Ummul Momineen deewar ki taraf munh phere baithi hui thin, un ka itni der tak na hatna Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par shaq guzar raha tha lekin sharm-o-lihaz ki wajah se kuch farmate na the, agar unhein is baat ka ilm ho jata to woh nikal jaate lekin woh be-fikri se baithte hi rahe. Aap ghar se nikal kar aur azwaj-e-mutahharat ke hujron ke paas chale gaye phir wapas aaye to dekha ki woh baithe hue hain. Ab to yeh bhi samajh gaye, bade nadim hue aur jaldi se nikal liye, aap andar badhe aur parda latka diya. Main bhi hujre mein hi tha jab yeh aayat utri aur aap is ki tilawat karte hue bahar aaye, sab se pehle is aayat ko aurton ne suna aur main to sab se awwal in ka sunne wala hoon. Pehle Hazrat Zainab (R.A) ke paas aap ka manga le jaane ki riwayat aayat (Falamma qada Zaidun) al-kh, ki tafseer mein guzar chuki hai, is ke aakhir mein baaz riwayaton mein yeh bhi hai ki phir logon ko nasihat ki gayi aur Hashim ki is hadith mein is aayat ka bayan bhi hai. Ibn Jarir mein hai ki raat ke waqt azwaj-e-mutahharat qaza-e-hajat ke liye jungle ko jaya karti thin. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko yeh pasand na tha, aap farmaya karte the ki unhein is tarah na jaane dijiye.

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is par tawajjo nahin farmate thay. Ek martaba Hazrat Sauda bint-e-Zama (R.A) niklin toh chunke Farooq-e-Azam ki mansha yeh thi ke kisi tarah azwaj-e-mutahharat ka yeh nikalna band ho, is liye unhein unke qad-o-qamat ki wajah se pehchan kar ba-awaz-e-buland kaha ke hum ne tumhein ae Sauda pehchan liya. Is ke baad parde ki ayatein utrin. Is riwayat mein yunhi hai lekin mashhoor yeh hai ke yeh waqia nuzool-e-hijab ke baad ka hai. Chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ki riwayat hai ke hijab ke hukum ke baad Hazrat Sauda (R.A) niklin, is mein yeh bhi hai ke yeh usi waqt wapas aagayin. An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) shaam ka khana tanawul farma rahe thay. Ek haddi haath mein thi, aa kar waqia bayan kiya, usi waqt wahi nazil hui, jab khatam hui us waqt bhi haddi haath mein hi thi, use chhori hi na thi. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala tumhari zarooraton ki bina par bahar nikalne ki ijazat deta hai. Ayat mein Allah Ta'ala musalmanon ko is aadat se rokta hai jo jahiliyat mein aur ibtida-e-Islam mein un mein thi ke baghair ijazat dusre ke ghar mein chale jana. Pas Allah Ta'ala is ummat ka ikram karte hue ise yeh adab sikhata hai. Chunancha ek hadith mein bhi yeh mazmoon hai ke khabardar aurton ke paas na jao. Phir Allah ne unhein mustasna kar liya jinhein ijazat de di jaye. Toh farmaya magar yeh ke tumhein ijazat di jaye. Khane ke liye aise waqt par na jao ke tum us ki tayari ke muntazir na raho. Mujahid aur Qatada farmate hain ke khane ke pakne aur us ke tayar hone ke waqt hi na pahuncho. Jab samjha ke khana tayar hoga, ja ghuse, yeh khaslat Allah ko pasand nahin. Yeh daleel hai tufaili banne ki hurmat par. Imam Khatib Baghdadi (R.H) ne is ki muzammat mein poori ek kitab likhi hai. Phir farmaya jab bulaye jao tum phir jao aur jab kha chuko toh nikal jao. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai ke tum mein se kisi ko jab us ka bhai bulaye toh use dawat qabool karni chahiye khwah nikah ki ho ya koi aur, aur hadith mein hai agar mujhe faqat ek khur ki dawat di jaye toh bhi main use qabool karunga. Dastoor-e-dawat bhi bayan farmaya ke jab kha chuko toh ab mezban ke yahan chaukri maar kar na baith jao. Balki wahan se chale jao. Baaton mein mashghool na ho jaya karo. Jaise un teen shakhson ne kiya tha. Jis se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko takleef hui lekin sharmindagi aur lihaz se aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kuch na bole, isi tarah matlab yeh bhi hai ke tumhara be-ijazat An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke gharon mein chale jana aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par shaaq guzarta hai lekin aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ba-wajah-e-sharm-o-haya ke tum se keh nahin sakte. Allah Ta'ala tum se saaf saaf farma raha hai ke ab se aisa na karna. Woh haq hukum se haya nahin karta. Tumhein jis tarah be-ijazat aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyon ke paas jana mana hai isi tarah un ki taraf aankh utha kar dekhna bhi haram hai. Agar tumhein un se koi zaroori cheez leni deni bhi ho toh pas-e-parda len-den ho. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek martaba malida kha rahe thay, Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko bhi bula liya, aap (R.A) bhi khane baith gaye.

Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) pehle hi se khane mein shareek thin. Hazrat Umar (R.A) azwaj-e-mutahharat ke parde ki tamanna mein thay. Khate hue ungliyon se ungliyan lag gayin toh besakhta farmane lage, kaash ke meri maan li jati aur parda karaya jata toh kisi ki nigah bhi na padti. Us waqt parde ka hukum utra. Phir parde ki tareef farma raha hai ke mardon auraton ke dilon ki pakeezgi ka yeh zariya hai. Kisi shakhs ne Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki kisi biwi se Aap (ﷺ) ke baad nikah karne ka irada kiya hoga, is aayat mein yeh haram qarar diya gaya. Chyunke Huzoor (ﷺ) ki biwiyan zindagi mein aur jannat mein bhi Aap (ﷺ) ki biwiyan hain aur jumla musalmanon ki woh maayen hain, is liye musalmanon par un se nikah karna mahaz haram hai. Yeh hukum un biwiyon ke liye jo Aap (ﷺ) ke ghar mein Aap (ﷺ) ke inteqal ke waqt thin, sab ke nazdeek ijma'an hai. Lekin jis biwi ko Aap (ﷺ) ne apni zindagi mein talaq de di aur us se mel ho chuka ho toh us se koi aur nikah kar sakta hai ya nahin? Is mein do mazhab hain aur jis se dukhool na kiya aur talaq de di ho us se dusre log nikah kar sakte hain. Qailah bint-e-Ash'as bin Qais Huzoor (ﷺ) ki malkiyat mein aa gayi thi, Aap (ﷺ) ke inteqal ke baad us ne Ikrimah bin Abu Jahl se nikah kar liya. Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) par yeh giran guzra lekin Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne samjhaya ke ae Khalifa-e-Rasool! Yeh Huzoor (ﷺ) ki biwi na thi, na ise Huzoor (ﷺ) ne ikhtiyar diya, na ise parde ka hukum diya aur is ki qoum ke irtidad ke sath hain, is ke irtidad ki wajah se Allah ne ise Huzoor (ﷺ) se bari kar diya. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ka itminan ho gaya. Pas in dono baton ki burai bayan farmata hai ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko eeza dena, un ki biwiyon se un ke baad nikah kar lena, yeh dono gunah Allah ke nazdeek bahut bade hain. Tumhari poshidgiyan aur alaniya baatein sab Allah par zahir hain, us par koi choti se choti cheez bhi poshida nahin. Aankhon ki khayanat ko, seene mein chupi hui baton aur dil ke iradon ko woh janta hai.)

Pardah ki tafseelat: Chunke upar ki aayaton mein ajnabiyon se parday ka hukum hua tha is liye jin qareebi rishtedaron se pardah na tha un ka bayan is aayat mein kardiya. Surah Noor mein bhi isi tarah farmaya ke auratein apni zeenat zahir na karein magar apne khawandon, baapon, sasron, ladkon, khawand ke ladkon, bhaiyon, bhatijon, bhanjon, auraton aur malkiyat jin ki un ke hathon mein ho. Un ke samne ya kaam kaaj karne wale ghair khwahishmand mardon ya kamsin bachon ke samne. Is ki poori tafseer is aayat ke tehat mein guzar chuki hai. Chacha aur mamoon ka zikr yahan is liye nahin kiya gaya ke mumkin hai woh apne ladkon ke samne un ke ausaf bayan karein. Hazrat Sha'bi (R.H) aur Hazrat Ikrimah (R.H) toh un dono ke samne aurat ka dupatta utarna makrooh jante thay. Nisa'ihin se murad momin auratein hain. Mat-e-hat se murad londi ghulam hain. Jaise ke pehle un ka bayan guzar chuka hai aur hadith bhi hum wahin warid kar chuke hain. Saeed bin Musayyab (R.H) farmate hain is se murad sirf londiyan hi hain. Allah Ta'ala se darti raho. Allah har cheez par shahid hai. Chupa khula sab use maloom hai. Is maujood aur hazir ka khauf rakho aur us ka lihaz karti raho.

Salat-o-Salam ki fazeelat. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Abu Al-Aliyah R.H se marvi hai ke Allah ka apne Nabi ﷺ par Durood bhejna apne farishton ke samne aap ki sana-o-sifat ka bayan karna hai aur farishton ka Durood aap ke liye dua karna hai. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain yani barkat ki dua. Aksar Ahl-e-Ilm ka qaul hai ke Allah ka Durood Rahmat hai aur farishton ka Durood istighfar hai. Atta R.H farmate hain Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ki Salat Subbuh-un-Quddus sabqat rahmati ghazbi hai. Maqsood is Ayat-e-Sharifa se yeh hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ki qadr-o-manzilat, izzat-o-martabat logon ki nigahon mein jach jaye, woh jaan lein ke khud Allah Ta'ala aap ka sana-khwan hai aur us ke farishte aap par Durood bhejte rehte hain. Mala-e-A'la ki yeh khabar de kar ab zameen walon ko hukum deta hai ke tum bhi aap par Durood-o-Salam bheja karo taake Aalam-e-Ulvi aur Aalam-e-Sifli ke logon ka is par ijtima ho jaye. Hazrat Musa A.S se Bani Israel ne poocha tha ke kya Allah tum par Salat bhejta hai? To Allah Ta'ala ne wahi bheji ke in se keh do ke haan Allah Ta'ala apne Nabiyon aur Rasoolon par Rahmat bhejta rehta hai. Isi ki taraf is Ayat mein bhi ishara hai. Doosri Ayat mein Allah Ta'ala ne khabar di hai ke yahi Rahmat Allah Ta'ala apne momin bandon par bhi nazil farmata hai, irshad hai: (هُوَ الَّذِيْ يُصَلِّيْ عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَلٰۗىِٕكَتُهٗ لِيُخْرِجَكُمْ مِّنَ الظُّلُمٰتِ اِلَى النُّوْرِ ۭ وَكَان بالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ رَحِيْمًا) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 43), yani ae iman walo tum Allah Ta'ala ka bakasrat zikr karte raha karo aur subh-o-sham us ki tasbeeh bayan kiya karo, woh khud tum par Durood bhejta hai aur us ke farishte bhi. Aur kaha gaya Huzoor ﷺ se hum aap par Salam kehna to jante hain, Durood sikha dijiye to aap ne farmaya yun kaho: (اللھم اجعل صلواتک ورحمتک وبرکاتک علی محمد وعلی ال محمد کما جعلتھا علی ابراہیم وال ابراہیم انک حمید مجید). Is ka ek rawi Abu Dawood A'ma jis ka naam Nafee bin Haris hai woh matrook hai. Hazrat Ali R.A se logon ko is dua ka sikhana bhi marvi hai.

(Allahumma dahiya-l-madhuwwati wa bari-al-masmookati wa jabbar-al-quloobi 'ala fitratiha shaqiha wa sa'idiha, ij'al shara'ifa salawatika wa nawami barakatika wa faza'ila ala'ika 'ala Muhammadin 'abdika wa rasoolika, al-fatihi lima ughliqa, wal-khatimi lima sabaqa, wal-mu'lini-l-haqqa bil-haqqi, wad-damighi li-jaishati-l-abatili, kama hummila fad-tala'a bi-amrika bi-ta'atika, mustawfizan fi marzatika, ghaira nakilin fi qadamin wala wahinin fi 'azmin, wa'iyan li-wahyika, hafizan li-'ahdika, madiyan 'ala nafazi amrika, hatta awra qabasan li-qabisihi, ala'u-llahi tasilu bi-ahlihi asbabuhu, bihi hudiyat-al-quloobu ba'da khawzati-l-fitani wal-ithmi, wa abhaj-a mawdihati-l-a'lami, wa na'irati-l-ahkami, wa munirati-l-islami, fahuwa aminuka-l-ma'moon, wa khazinu 'ilmika-l-makhzoon, wa shaheeduka yawma-d-deen, wa ba'ithuka ni'matan, wa rasooluka bil-haqqi rahmata. Allahumma afsah lahu fi 'adnika, wa ajzihi muda'afati-l-khairi min fadlika, lahu muhannatin ghaira mukaddaratin min fawzi thawabika-l-ma'looli, wa jazeeli 'ata'ika-l-mahlooli. Allahumma a'li 'ala bina'i-n-nasi bina'ahu, wa akrim mathwahu ladaika wa nuzulahu, wa atmim lahu noorahu, wa ajzihi min ibtigha'ika lahu maqboola-sh-shahadati, mardiya-l-maqalati, dha mantiqin 'adlin, wa khuttatin faslin, wa hujjatin wa burhanin 'azeem). Magar is ki sanad theek nahin, is ka rawi Abu-l-Hajjaj Mizzi Salamah Kundi na toh ma'roof hai na is ki 'alamat Hazrat Ali (R.A) se sabit hai. Ibn-e-Majah mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain jab tum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par durood bhejo toh bahut achha durood parha karo. Bahut mumkin hai ke tumhara yeh durood Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par pesh kiya jaye. Logon ne kaha phir aap hi hamein koi aisa durood sikhaiye, aap ne farmaya behtar hai yeh parho: (Allahumma-j'al salawatika wa rahmatika wa barakatika 'ala sayyidi-l-mursaleena wa imami-l-muttaqeena wa khatimi-n-nabiyyina Muhammadin 'abdika wa rasoolika, imami-l-khairi wa qa'idi-l-khairi wa rasooli-r-rahmah. Allahumma-b'athu maqaman mahmoodan yaghbituhu bihi-l-awwaluna wal-akhirun). Is ke baad At-tahiyyat ke baad ke dono durood hain. Yeh riwayat bhi mauqoof hai. Ibn-e-Jareer ki ek riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Yunus bin Khabbab ne apne Fars ke ek khutbe mein is ayat ki tilawat ki. Phir logon ke durood ke tariqe ke sawal ko bayan farma kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke jawab mein "Warham Muhammada-n-wa aala Muhammada-n-kama rahimta aala Ibrahima" ko bhi bayan farmaya hai. Is se yeh bhi istidlal kiya gaya hai ke aap ke liye raham ki dua bhi hai. Jamhoor ka yahi mazhab hai. Is ki mazeed ta'eed is hadith se bhi hoti hai jis mein hai ke ek A'rabi ne apni dua mein kaha tha: "Aye Allah mujh par aur Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par raham kar aur hamare sath kisi aur par raham na kar", toh aap ne use farmaya: "Tu ne bahut hi zyada kushada cheez tang kar di." Qazi Ayaz ne jamhoor Malikiyah se is ka adam-e-jawaz naqal kiya hai. Abu Muhammad bin Abu Zaid bhi is ke jawaz ki taraf gaye hain. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke jab tak koi shakhs mujh par durood bhejta rehta hai tab tak farishte bhi us ke liye dua-e-raham karte rehte hain. Ab tumhein ikhtiyar hai ke kami karo ya zyadati karo. (Ibn-e-Majah). Farmate hain sab se qareeb roz-e-qayamat mujh se woh hoga jo sab se zyada mujh par durood parha karta tha.

(Tirmidhi) Farman hai mujh par jo ek martaba Durood bheje Allah Ta'ala us par apni das rahmatain bhejta hai. Is par ek shakhs ne kaha phir main apni dua ka aadha waqt Durood mein hi kharch karunga. Farmaya jaisi teri marzi. Usne kaha phir main do tihaiyan kar lun? Aap ne farmaya agar chahe. Usne kaha phir toh main apna sara waqt is ke liye hi kar deta hun. Aap ne farmaya is waqt Allah Ta'ala tujhe deen-o-duniya ke gham se nijat de de ga aur tere gunah maaf farma de ga. (Tirmidhi) Ubayy bin Ka'ab R.A ka bayan hai ke aadhi raat ko Huzoor ﷺ bahar nikalte aur farmate, hila dene wali aa rahi hai aur us ke peeche hi peeche lagne wali bhi hai. Hazrat Ubayy ne ek martaba kaha Huzoor ﷺ main raat ko kuch namaz parha karta hun, toh us ka tihai hissa Aap par Durood parhta rahoon? Aap ne farmaya aadha hissa. Unhon ne kaha ke aadha kar lun? Farmaya do tihai. Kaha achha main poora waqt isi mein guzarunga. Aap ne farmaya tab toh Allah tere tamam gunah maaf farma de ga. (Tirmidhi) Isi riwayat ki ek aur sanad mein hai do tihai raat guzarne ke baad Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya logo Allah ki yaad karo. Logo zikr-e-Ilahi karo. Dekho kapkapa dene wali aa rahi hai aur us ke peeche hi peeche lagne wali aa rahi hai. Maut apne sath ki kul museebaton aur aafton ko liye hue chali aa rahi hai. Hazrat Ubayy ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ main Aap par bakasrat Durood parhta hun, pas kitna waqt is mein guzaru? Aap ne farmaya jitna tu chahe. Kaha chauthai? Farmaya jitna chaho aur zyada karo toh aur achha hai. Kaha aadha? Toh yahi jawab diya. Poocha do tihai? Toh yahi jawab mila. Kaha toh bas main sara hi waqt is mein guzarunga. Farmaya phir Allah Ta'ala tujhe tere tamam ham-o-gham se bacha le ga aur tere gunah maaf farma de ga. (Tirmidhi) Ek shakhs ne Aap se kaha Huzoor ﷺ agar main apni tamam-tar salat Aap hi par kar dun toh? Aap ne farmaya duniya aur aakhirat ke tamam maqasid poore ho jayenge. (Musnad Ahmad) Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Auf R.A farmate hain Aap ek martaba ghar se nikle. Main sath ho liya. Aap khajooron ke ek bagh mein gaye, wahan ja kar sajde mein gir gaye aur itna lamba sajda kiya, is qadar der lagayi ke mujhe toh yeh khatka guzra ke kahin Aap ki rooh parwaz na kar gayi ho. Qareeb ja kar ghaur se dekhne laga itne mein Aap ne sar uthaya, mujh se poocha kya baat hai? Toh main ne apni halat zahir ki. Farmaya baat yeh thi ke Jibraeel A.S mere paas aaye aur mujh se farmaya tumhein basharat sunata hun ke Janab-e-Bari Azza Ismuhu farmata hai jo tujh par Durood bheje ga main bhi us par Durood bhejunga aur jo tujh par salam bheje ga main bhi us par salam bhejunga. (Musnad Ahmad bin Hanbal) Aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh sajda is amr par Allah ke shukriye ka tha. Ek martaba Huzoor ﷺ apne kisi kaam ke liye nikle, koi na tha jo Aap ke sath jata toh Hazrat Umar R.A jaldi se peeche peeche gaye. Dekha ke Aap sajde mein hain, door hat kar khade ho gaye.

Aap ne sar utha kar un ki taraf dekh kar farmaya tum ne yeh bahut achha kiya ke mujhe sajde mein dekh kar peeche hat gaye. Suno mere paas Jibraeel A.S aaye aur farmaya aap ki ummat mein se jo ek martaba aap par Durood bheje ga. Allah us par das rahmatain utare ga aur us ke das darje buland kare ga. (Tabrani) Ek martaba aap apne Sahaba R.A ke paas aaye. Chehre se khushi zahir ho rahi thi. Sahaba R.A ne sabab daryaft kiya to farmaya ek farishte ne aa kar mujhe yeh basharat di ke mera ummati jab mujh par Durood bheje ga to Allah Ta'ala ki das rahmatain us par utrain gi. Isi tarah ek salam ke badle das salam (Nasa'i) aur riwayat mein hai ke ek Durood ke badle das nekiyan milain gi, das gunah maaf honge, das darje barhain ge aur isi ke misl us par lautaya jaye ga (Musnad) jo shakhs mujh par ek Durood bheje ga Allah us par das rahmatain nazil farmaye ga (Muslim waghera) farmate hain mujh par Durood bheja karo woh tumhare liye zakat hai aur mere liye waseela talab kiya karo woh jannat mein ek aala darja hai jo ek shakhs ko hi mile ga kya ajab ke woh main hi hoon (Ahmad) Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr R.A ka qaul hai ke Huzoor ﷺ par jo Durood bhejta hai Allah aur us ke farishte us par sattar Durood bhejte hain. Ab jo chahe kam kare aur jo chahe is mein ziyadati kare suno ek martaba Huzoor ﷺ hamare paas aaye aise ke goya koi kisi ko rukhsat kar raha ho. Teen baar farmaya ke main Ummi Nabi Muhammad ﷺ hoon. Mere baad koi Nabi nahin. Mujhe nihayat khula bahut jame aur khatam kar dene wala kalam diya gaya hai. Mujhe jahannam ke darogon ki arsh ke uthane walon ki ginti bata di gayi hai. Mujh par khas inayat ki gayi hai aur mujhe aur meri ummat ko aafiyat ata farmayi gayi hai. Jab tak main tum mein maujood hoon sunte aur mante raho. Jab mujhe mera Rab le jaye to tum Kitabullah ko mazboot thame rehna us ke halal ko halal aur us ke haram ko haram samajhna. (Musnad Ahmad) Farmate hain jis ke samne mera zikr kiya jaye use chahiye ke mujh par Durood bheje. Ek martaba ke Durood bhejne se Allah us par das rahmatain nazil farmata hai. (Abu Dawood Tayalisi) Ek Durood das rahmatain dilwata hai aur das gunah maaf karata hai (Musnad) Bakheel hai woh jis ke samne mera zikr kiya gaya aur us ne mujh par Durood na parha. (Tirmidhi) Aur riwayat mein hai aisa shakhs sab se bada bakheel hai. Ek mursal hadith mein hai insaan ko yeh bukhal kafi hai ke mera naam sun kar Durood na parhe. Farmate hain woh shakhs barbad hua jis ke paas mera zikr kiya gaya aur us ne mujh par Durood na bheja. Woh barbad hua jis ki zindagi mein Ramzan aaya aur nikal jane tak us ke gunah maaf na hue. Woh bhi barbad hua jis ne apne maa baap ke burhape ke zamane ko pa liya phir bhi unhon ne use jannat mein na pahunchaya. (Tirmidhi) Yeh hadeesain daleel hain is amr par ke Huzoor ﷺ par Durood parhna wajib hai. Ulama ki ek jamaat ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Jaise Tahawi, Haleemi waghera. Ibn Majah mein hai jo mujh par Durood parhna bhool gaya us ne jannat ki raah se khata ki. Yeh hadith mursal hai.

Lekin pehli ahadees se is ki poori taqwiyat ho jati hai. Baaz log kehte hain majlis mein ek dafa toh wajib hai phir mustahab hai. Chunancha Tirmidhi ki ek hadees mein hai jo log kisi majlis mein baithein aur Allah ke zikr aur durood ke baghair uth khade hon woh majlis Qayamat ke din un par wabaal ho jaye gi. Agar Allah chahe toh unhein azab kare chahe maaf kar de aur riwayat mein zikr-e-Allah ka zikr nahin. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke go woh Jannat mein jayen lekin mehroomi-e-sawab ke baais unhein sakht afsos rahe ga. Baaz ka qaul hai ke umr bhar mein ek martaba Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par durood wajib hai phir mustahab hai taake aayat ki tameel ho jaye. Qazi Ayaz ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par durood bhejne ke wujoob ko bayan farma kar isi qaul ki tayeed ki hai. Lekin Tabari farmate hain ke aayat se toh istihbab hi sabit hota hai aur is par ijma ka dawa kiya hai. Bohat mumkin hai ke un ka matlab bhi yahi ho ke ek martaba wajib phir mustahab jaise Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwwat ki gawahi. Lekin main kehta hoon bohat se aise auqaat hain jin mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par durood parhne ka hamein hukum mila hai lekin baaz waqt wajib hai aur baaz jagah wajib nahin. Chunancha (1) Azan sun kar. Dekhiye Musnad ki hadees mein hai jab tum azan suno toh jo muazzin keh raha ho tum bhi kaho phir mujh par durood bhejo ek ke badle das durood Allah tum par bheje ga phir mere liye waseela mango jo Jannat ki ek manzil hai aur ek hi banda is ka mustahiq hai mujhe umeed hai ke woh banda main hoon suno jo mere liye waseela ki dua karta hai us ke liye meri shafa'at halal ho jati hai. Pehle durood ke zakat hone ki hadees mein bhi is ka bayan guzar chuka hai. Farman hai ke jo shakhs durood bheje aur kahe Allahumma anzilhul maq'adal muqarraba indaka yaumal qiyamati us ke liye meri shafa'at Qayamat ke din wajib ho jaye gi. (Musnad) Ibn Abbas se yeh dua manqool hai (2) Masjid mein jaane aur masjid se nikalne ke waqt. Chunancha Musnad mein hai. Hazrat Fatima farmati hain jab An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) masjid mein jaate toh durood-o-salam parh kar Allahummaghfirli zunoobi waftah li abwaba rahmatika parhte aur jab masjid se nikalte toh durood-o-salam ke baad Allahummaghfirli zunoobi waftah li abwaba rahmatika parhte. Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka farman hai jab masjidon mein jao toh Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par durood parha karo. (3) Namaz ke aakhri qa'ada mein Attahiyat ka durood. Is ki behas pehli guzar chuki. Haan awwal tashahhud mein ise kisi ne wajib nahin kaha. Albata mustahab hone ka ek qaul Shafi'i ka hai. Go doosra qaul is ke khilaf bhi unhi se marwi hai. (4) Janaze ki namaz mein Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par durood parhna. Chunancha sunnat tareeqa yeh hai ke pehli takbeer mein Surah Fatiha parhe. Doosri mein durood parhe. Teesri mein mayyat ke liye dua kare chauthi mein Allahumma la tahrimna ajrahu wa la taftinna ba'dahu al-kh, parhe. Ek sahabi ka qaul hai ke masnoon namaz-e-janaza yun hai ke Imam takbeer keh kar aahista salam pher de. (Nasa'i) (5) Eid ki namaz mein. Hazrat Ibn Mas'ood, Hazrat Abu Musa aur Hazrat Huzaifa ke paas aa kar Waleed bin Uqba kehta hai Eid ka din hai batlao takbeeron ki kya kaifiyat hai?

Abdullah R.A ne farmaya takbeer-e-tahreema keh kar Allah ki hamd kar, apne Nabi ﷺ par durood bhej, dua maang, phir takbeer keh kar yehi kar. Phir takbeer keh kar yehi kar. Phir takbeer keh kar yehi kar. Phir takbeer keh kar yehi kar, phir qira'at kar, phir takbeer keh kar ruku kar, phir khara ho kar parh aur apne Rabb ki hamd bayan kar aur Huzoor ﷺ par salawat parh aur dua kar aur takbeer keh aur isi tarah kar, phir ruku mein ja. Hazrat Huzaifa R.A aur Hazrat Abu Musa R.A ne bhi is ki tasdeeq ki. (6) Dua ke khatmay par. Tirmidhi mein Hazrat Umar R.A ka qaul hai ke dua aasman-o-zameen mein mu'allaq rehti hai yahan tak ke tu durood parhay tab charhti hai. Ek riwayat marfoo' bhi isi tarah ki aayi hai, is mein yeh bhi hai ke dua ke awwal mein, darmiyan mein aur aakhir mein durood parh liya karo. Ek ghareeb aur za'eef hadees mein hai ke mujhe sawaar ke pyalay ki tarah na kar lo ke jab woh apni tamam zaroori cheezein le leta hai to paani ka katora bhi bhar leta hai, agar wuzu ki zaroorat pari to wuzu kar liya, pyaas lagi to paani pee liya warna paani baha diya. Dua ki ibtida mein, dua ke darmiyan mein aur dua ke aakhir mein mujh par durood parha karo. Khusoosan dua-e-qunoot mein durood ki zyada takeed hai. Hazrat Hasan R.A farmatay hain mujhe Huzoor ﷺ ne kuch kalmaat sikhaye jinhein main witron mein parha karta hoon: Allahumma ihdini feeman hadait, wa 'aafini feeman 'aafait, wa tawallani feeman tawallait, wa baarik li feema a'tait, wa qini sharra ma qadhait, fa innaka taqdhi wa la yuqdha 'alaik, innahu la yadhillu man waalait, wa la ya'izzu man 'aadait, tabaarakta Rabbana wa ta'aalait (Ahl-us-Sunan). Nasai ki riwayat mein aakhir mein yeh alfaaz bhi hain: Wa sallallahu 'alan-Nabi. (7) Jumma ke din aur Jumma ki raat mein. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai sab se afzal din Jumma ka din hai, isi mein Hazrat Adam A.S paida kiye gaye, isi mein qabz kiye gaye, isi mein nafha hai, isi mein behoshi hai. Pas tum is din mujh par bakasrat durood parha karo. Tumhare durood mujh par pesh kiye jatay hain. Sahaba R.A ne poocha aap to zameen mein dafna diye gaye honge phir hamaray durood aap par kaisay pesh kiye jayenge? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne nabiyon ke jismon ka khana zameen par haram kar diya. Abu Dawood, Nasai waghera mein bhi yeh hadees hai. Ibn-e-Majah mein hai Jumma ke din bakasrat durood parho, is din farishtay hazir hotay hain. Jab koi mujh par durood parhta hai us ka durood mujh par pesh kiya jata hai jab tak ke woh farigh ho. Poocha gaya maut ke baad bhi? Farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne zameen par nabiyon ke jismon ka galana sarana haram kar diya hai, Nabi Allah zinda hain rozi diye jatay hain. Yeh hadees ghareeb hai aur is mein inqita' hai. 'Ubada bin Nusay ne Hazrat Abu Darda R.A ko paya nahin. Wallahu A'lam. Baihaqi mein bhi hadees hai ke Jumma ke din aur Jumma ki raat mujh par bakasrat durood bhejo lekin woh bhi za'eef hai. Ek riwayat mein hai us ka jism zameen nahin khati jis se Rooh-ul-Quds ne kalam kiya ho. Lekin yeh hadees mursal hai. Ek mursal hadees mein bhi Jumma ke din aur raat mein durood ki kasrat ka hukum hai.

(8) Isi tarah khateeb par bhi dono khutbon mein durood wajib hai, is ke baghair sahih na honge, is liye ke yeh ibadat hai aur is mein zikr-e-Allah wajib hai, pas zikr-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi wajib hoga. Jaise azan-o-namaz, Shafi'i aur Ahmad ka yahi mazhab hai. (9) Aap ki qabr-e-shareef ki ziyarat ke waqt Abu Dawood mein hai, jo musalman mujh par salam parhta hai, Allah meri rooh ko lota deta hai yahan tak ke main us ke salam ka jawab doon. Abu Dawood mein hai apne gharon ko qabrein na banao, meri qabr par urs-o-mela na lagao. Haan mujh par durood parho go tum kahin bhi ho lekin tumhara durood mujh tak pohanchaya jata hai. Qazi Ismail bin Ishaq apni kitab Fazl-us-Salat mein ek riwayat laye hain ke ek shakhs har subh Roza-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par aata tha aur durood-o-salam parhta tha. Ek din us se Hazrat Ali bin Hussain bin Ali (R.A) ne kaha tum roz aisa kyun karte ho? Us ne jawab diya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par salam karna mujhe bohat marghoob hai. Aap ne farmaya suno main tumhein ek hadith sunaoon, main ne apne baap se, unhon ne mere dada se suna hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Meri qabr ko eid na banao, na apne gharon ko qabrein banao, jahan kahin tum ho wahin se mujh par durood-o-salam bhejo, woh mujhe pohanch jate hain." Is ki asnad mein ek rawi mubham hai jis ka naam mazkoor nahin aur sanad se yeh riwayat mursal marwi hai. Hassan bin Hassan bin Ali (R.A) se marwi hai ke unhon ne aap ki qabr ke paas kuch logon ko dekh kar unhein yeh hadith sunayi ke aap ki qabr par mela lagane se aap ne rok diya hai. Mumkin hai un ki kisi be-adabi ki wajah se yeh hadith aap ko sunane ki zaroorat pari ho, maslan woh buland awaz se bol rahe hon. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke aap ne ek shakhs ko Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke Roza par pay dar pay aate hue dekh kar farmaya ke tu aur jo shakhs Andulus mein hai, jahan kahin tum ho wahin se salam bhejo, tumhare salam mujhe pohancha diye jate hain. Tabrani mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is ayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya ke yeh khas raaz hai, agar tum mujh se na poochte to main bhi na batata. Suno mere sath do farishtay muqarrar hain, jab mera zikr kisi musalman ke samne kiya jata hai aur woh mujh par durood bhejta hai to woh farishtay kehte hain Allah tujhe bakhshe, aur khud Allah aur us ke farishtay us par aameen kehte hain. Yeh hadith bohat hi ghareeb hai aur is ki sanad bohat hi za'eef hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Allah Ta'ala ke farishtay hain jo zameen mein chalte phirte rehte hain, meri ummat ke salam mujh tak pohanchate rehte hain. Nasai waghera mein bhi yeh hadith hai. Ek hadith mein hai ke jo meri qabr ke paas se mujh par salam parhta hai use main sunta hoon aur jo door se salam bhejta hai use main pohanchaya jata hoon. Yeh hadith sandan sahih nahin, Muhammad bin Marwan Suddi Sagheer matrook hai. (10) Hamare sathiyon ka qaul hai ke ehram wala jab labbaik pukare to use bhi durood parhna chahiye. Darqutni waghera mein Qasim bin Muhammad bin Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ka farman marwi hai ke logon ko is baat ka hukum kiya jata tha.

Sahih sanad se Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam R.A ka qaul marwi hai ke jab tum Makkah pahuncho toh saat martaba tawaf karo, Maqam-e-Ibrahim par do rakat namaz ada karo. Phir Safa par charho itna ke wahan se Baitullah nazar aaye wahan kharay reh kar saat takbeerein kaho un ke darmiyan Allah ki hamd-o-sana bayan karo aur Durood parho. Aur apne liye dua karo phir Marwah par bhi isi tarah karo. 0101 hamaray sathiyon ne yeh bhi kaha hai ke zibah ke waqt bhi Allah ke naam ke sath Durood parhna chahiye. Aayat "Wa rafa'na laka zikrak" se unhon ne ta'eed chahi hai kyunke is ki tafsir mein hai ke jahan Allah ka zikr kiya jaye wahin Aap ﷺ ka naam bhi liya jaye ga. Jamhoor is ke mukhalif hain woh kehte hain yahan sirf zikr-e-Allah kafi hai. Jaise khanay ke waqt aur jima ke waqt waghera waghera ke in auqat mein Durood ka parhna sunnat se sabit nahin hua. Ek hadith mein hai ke Allah ke tamam ambiya aur rasoolon par bhi salat-o-salam bhejo woh bhi meri tarah Allah ke bhejay huay hain lekin is ki sanad mein do zaeef rawi hain Umar bin Haroon aur un ke ustad. Kaan ki sansanahat ke waqt bhi Durood parhna ek hadith mein hai. Agar is ki asnaad sahi sabit ho jaye toh Sahih Ibn-e-Khuzaima mein hai jab tum mein se kisi ke kaan mein sarsarahat ho toh mujhe zikr karke Durood parhay aur kahay ke jis ne mujhe bhalai se yaad kiya usay Allah bhi yaad karay is ki sanad ghareeb hai aur is ke suboot mein nazar hai. Masla: Ahl-e-Kitab is baat ko mustahab jantay hain ke katib jab kabhi Huzoor ﷺ ka naam likhay ﷺ likhay. Ek hadith mein hai jo shakhs kisi kitab mein mujh par Durood likhay us ke Durood ka sawab us waqt tak jari rehta hai jab tak woh kitab rahay lekin kayi wajah se yeh hadith sahi nahin balkay Imam Zahabi R.H ke ustad toh isay mauzoo kehte hain. Yeh hadith bohat se tareeq se marwi hai lekin ek sanad bhi sahi nahin. Imam Khatib Baghdadi R.H apni kitab "Aadab-ur-Raadi wal Sami" mein likhte hain main ne Imam Ahmad R.H ki dasti likhi hui kitab mein bohat jagah Rasool Allah ﷺ ka naam dekha jahan Durood likha hua na tha Aap ﷺ zabani Durood parh liya karte thay. Fasl: Nabiyon ke siwa ghair nabiyon par salat bhejna agar tab'an ho toh beshak jaiz hai. Jaise hadith mein hai "Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin wa alihi wa azwajihi wa zurriyyatihi". Haan sirf ghair nabiyon par salat bhejne mein ikhtilaf hai. Baaz toh isay jaiz batatay hain aur daleel mein aayat "Huwallazi yusalli alaikum" al-kh aur "Ulaika alaihim salawat" aur "Wa salli alaihim" pesh karte hain aur yeh hadith bhi ke jab Rasool Allah ﷺ ke paas kisi qoum ka sadqa aata toh Aap ﷺ farmatay "Allahumma salli alaihim" chunancha Hazrat Abdullah bin Abi Aufa R.A farmatay hain "Jab mere walid Aap ﷺ ke paas apna sadqay ka maal laye toh Aap ﷺ ne farmaya Allahumma salli ala ali Abi Aufa" (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Ek aur hadith mein hai ke ek aurat ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ mujh par aur mere khawand par salat bhejiye toh Aap ﷺ ne farmaya "Sallallahu alaihi wa ala zaujik" lekin jamhoor ulama is ke khilaf hain aur kehte hain ke ambiya ke siwa auron par khassatan salat bhejna mamnoo hai.

Is liye ke is lafz ka istemaal Anbiya Alaihimus Salatu Wassalam ke liye is qadar bakasrat ho gaya hai ke sunte hi zehen mein yahi khayal aata hai ke yeh naam kisi Nabi ka hai to ehtiyat isi mein hai ke ghair Nabi ke liye yeh alfaaz na kahe jayen. Maslan Abu Bakr Sallallahu Alaihi ya Ali Sallallahu Alaihi na kaha jaye go ma'ani mein is mein koi qabahat nahin jaise Muhammad Azzawajal nahin kaha jata. Halan-ke zi-izzat aur zi-martaba aap bhi hain is liye ke yeh alfaaz Allah Ta'ala ki zaat ke liye mashhoor ho chuke hain aur Kitab-o-Sunnat mein Salawat ka jo istemaal ghair Anbiya ke liye hua hai woh bator-e-dua ke hai. Isi wajah se Aal-e-Abi Aufa ko is ke baad kisi ne in alfaaz se yaad nahin kiya na Hazrat Jabir aur un ki biwi ko. Yehi maslak hamein bhi achha lagta hai, Wallahu A'lam. Ba'az ek aur wajah bhi bayan karte hain yani yeh ke ghair Anbiya ke liye yeh alfaaz-e-Salawat istemaal karna baddino ka shewa ho gaya hai. Woh apne buzurgon ke haq mein yehi alfaaz istemaal karte hain pas un ki iqtida hamein na karni chahiye. Is mein bhi ikhtilaf hai ke yeh mukhalifat kis darje ki hai hurmat ke tor par ya karahat ke tor par ya khilaf-e-aula. Sahih yeh hai ke yeh makrooh-e-tanzeehi hai. Is liye ke biddatiyon ka tareeqa hai jis par hamein karband hona theek nahin aur makrooh wahi hota hai jis mein nahi maqsood ho. Zyada tar aitbaar is mein isi par hai ke Salawat ka lafz salaf mein Nabiyon par hi bola jata raha jaise ke Azzawajal ka lafz Allah Ta'ala hi ke liye bola jata raha. Ab raha Salam so is ke bare mein Sheikh Abu Muhammad Juwaini farmate hain ke yeh bhi Salawat ke ma'ani mein hai pas ghaib par is ka istemaal na kiya jaye aur jo Nabi na ho us ke liye khastan ise bhi na bola jaye. Pas Ali A.S na kaha jaye. Zindon aur murdon ka yehi hukum hai. Haan jo samne majood ho us se khitab karke Salam-un-Alaik ya Salam-un-Alaikum ya Assalamu Alaik ya Alaikum kehna jaiz hai aur is par ijma hai. Yahan par yeh baat yaad rakhni chahiye ke umooman musannifeen ke qalam se Ali A.S nikalta hai ya Ali Karamallahu Wajhahu nikalta hai go ma'ani mein is mein koi haraj na ho lekin is se aur Sahaba ki janab mein ek tarah ki su-e-adabi payi jati hai. Hamein sab Sahaba ke sath husn-e-aqeedat rakhni chahiye. Yeh alfaaz-e-ta'zeem-o-takreem ke hain is liye Hazrat Ali se zyada mustahiq un ke Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq aur Hazrat Umar aur Hazrat Usman R.A Ajma'een hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas se marwi hai ke Nabi ﷺ ke siwa kisi aur par Salawat na bhejni chahiye. Haan musalman mardon aurton ke liye dua-e-maghfirat karni chahiye. Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz R.H ne apne ek khat mein likha tha ke ba'az log aakhirat ke a'amal se duniya ke jama karne ki fikr mein hain aur ba'az molvi wa'iz apne khalifon aur amiron ke liye Salawat ke hi alfaaz bolte hain jo Rasoolullah ﷺ ke liye the. Jab tere paas mera yeh khat pahunche to unhein keh dena ke Salawat sirf Nabiyon ke liye hain aur aam musalmanon ke liye is ke siwa jo chahein dua karein.

Hazrat Ka'ab R.A kehte hain har subh sattar hazaar farishtay utar kar qabr-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko gher letay hain aur apne par sameit kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke liye dua-e-rahmat karte rehte hain aur sattar hazaar raat ko aatay hain yahan tak ke Qayamat ke din jab aap ki qabr-e-mubarak shaq hogi toh aap ke sath sattar hazaar farishtay honge (Far'u) Imam Nawawi R.H farmatay hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par salat-o-salam ek sath bhejne chahiyein sirf (ﷺ) ya sirf (A.S / Alaihis Salam) na kahein. Is aayat mein bhi dono hi ka hukum hai pas awla yeh hai ke yun kaha jaye (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tasleema.)

Mal'oon-o-Muazzab log. Jo log Allah Ta'ala ke ahkaam ki khilaf-warzi karke uske roke hue kaamon se na ruk kar uski nafarmaniyon par jam kar use naraz kar rahe hain aur uske Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zimme tarah-tarah ke bohtan bandhte hain woh mal'oon aur muazzab hain. Hazrat Ikrama (R.H) farmate hain is se murad tasveerein banane wale hain. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai mujhe Ibn-e-Adam eeza deta hai woh zamane ko gaaliyan deta hai aur zamana main hoon, main hi din raat ka taghayyur-o-tabaddul kar raha hoon. Matlab yeh hai ke jahiliyat wale kaha karte the haye zamane ki halakat, is ne hamare sath yeh kiya aur yun kiya. Pas Allah ke af'aal ko zamane ki taraf mansoob karke phir zamane ko bura kehte the, goya af'aal ke fa'il yani khud Allah ko bura kehte the. Hazrat Safiya (R.A) se jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne nikah kiya to is par bhi ba'az logon ne baatein banana shuru ki thin. Baqol Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) yeh aayat is bare mein utri. Aayat aam hai, kisi tarah bhi Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko takleef de woh is aayat ke matahat mal'oon aur muazzab hai. Is liye ke Rasool-e-Allah ko eeza deni goya Allah ko eeza deni hai. Jis tarah aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ita'at ain ita'at-e-Ilahi hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain main tumhein Allah ko yaad dilata hoon, dekho Allah ko beech mein rakh kar tum se kehta hoon ke mere as-haab ko mere baad nishana na bana lena, meri mohabbat ki wajah se un se bhi mohabbat rakhna, un se bughz-o-dabeer rakhne wala mujh se dushmani karne wala hai. Unhein jis ne eeza di aur jis ne Allah ko eeza di yaqeen mano ke Allah us ki bhoosi ura de ga. Yeh hadith Tirmidhi mein bhi hai. Jo log imandaron ki taraf un buraiyon ko mansoob karte hain jin se woh bari hain, woh bare bohtan-baaz aur zabardast gunah-gaar hain. Is wa'eed mein sab se pehle to kuffar dakhil hain, phir Rafzi Shia jo Sahaba par aib-geeri karte hain aur Allah ne jin ki tareefein ki hain yeh unhein bura kehte hain. Allah Ta'ala ne saaf farma diya hai ke woh Ansar-o-Muhajireen se khush hai. Quran-e-Kareem mein jagah-jagah un ki madh-o-sataish majood hai. Lekin yeh be-khabar kund-zehan unhein bura kehte hain, un ki muzammat karte hain aur un mein woh baatein batate hain jin se woh bilkul alag hain. Haq yeh hai ke Allah ki taraf se un ke dil oundhe ho gaye hain is liye un ki zabanen bhi ulti chalti hain. Qabil-e-madh logon ki muzammat karte hain aur muzammat walon ki tareefein karte hain. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hota hai ke gheebat kise kehte hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tera apne bhai ka is tarah zikr karna jise agar woh sune to use bura maloom ho. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hua ke agar woh baat us mein ho tab? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jabhi to gheebat hai warna bohtan hai. (Tirmidhi) Ek martaba apne as-haab se sawal kiya ke sab se bari sood-khwari kya hai? Unhon ne kaha ke Allah jane aur Allah ka Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam). Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya sab se bara sood Allah ke nazdeek kisi Musalman ki aabroo-rezi karna hai. Phir aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne isi aayat ki tilawat farmayi.
