Tamam duniya ki auraton se behtar-o-afzal kaun? Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko farmata hai ke aap momin auraton se farma dein bilkhusoos apni biwiyon aur sahibzadiyon se kyunke woh tamam duniya ki auraton se behtar-o-afzal hain ke woh apni chadarein niche latka liya karein taake jahiliyat ki auraton se mumtaz ho jayen isi tarah londiyon se bhi azad auraton ki pehchan ho jaye. Jilbab us chadar ko kehte hain jo auratein apni dupattiyon ke upar dalti hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala musalman auraton ko hukum deta hai ke jab woh apne kisi kaam kaaj ke liye bahar niklein to jo chadar woh odhti hain use sar par se jhuka kar munh dhak liya karein, sirf ek aankh khuli rakhein. Imam Muhammad bin Sirin (R.H) ke sawal par Hazrat Ubaida Salmani (R.H) ne apna chehra aur sar dhank kar aur bayin aankh khuli rakh kar bata diya ke yeh matlab is ayat ka hai. Hazrat Ikrama (R.H) ka qaul hai ke apni chadar se apna gala tak dhanp le. Hazrat Umme Salma (R.A) farmati hain is ayat ke utarne ke baad Ansar ki auratein jab nikalti thin to is tarah luki chupi chalti thin goya unke saron par parind hain siyah chadarein apne upar daal liya karti thin. Hazrat Zahri se sawal hua ke kya londiyan bhi chadar odhein? Khwah khawandon waliyan hon ya be-khawand ki hon? Farmaya dupatta to zaroor odhein agar woh khawandon waliyan hon aur chadar na odhein taake un mein aur azad auraton mein farq rahe. Hazrat Sufyan Sauri se manqool hai ke zimmi kafiron ki auraton ki zeenat ka dekhna sirf khauf-e-zina ki wajah se mamnoo hai na ke unki hurmat-o-izzat ki wajah se kyunke ayat mein mominon ki auraton ka zikr hai. Chadar ka latkana chunke alamat hai azad pak daman auraton ki is liye yeh chadar ke latkane se pehchan li jayengi ke yeh na wahi auratein hain na londiyan hain. Suddi ka qaul hai ke fasiq log andheri raton mein raste se guzarne wali auraton par awazein kaste the is liye yeh nishan ho gaya ke ghar girhast auraton aur londiyon bandiyon waghera mein tameez ho jaye aur un pak daman auraton par koi lab na hila sake. Phir farmaya ke jahiliyat ke zamane mein jo be-pardagi ki rasm thi jab tum Allah ke is hukum ke aamil ban jaoge to Allah Ta'ala tamam agli khataon se darguzar farmale ga aur tum par mehar-o-karam kare ga, phir farmata hai ke agar munafiq log aur badkar aur jhooti afwahein dushmanon ki charhai waghera ki udane wale ab bhi baaz na aaye aur haq ke tarafdar na huye to hum aye Nabi tujhe un par ghalib aur musallat kar denge. Phir to woh Madine mein thehar hi nahin sakenge. Bahut jald tabah kar diye jayenge aur jo kuch din unke Madine ki iqamat se guzrenge woh bhi la'nat-o-phutkar mein zillat aur maar mein guzrenge. Har taraf se dhutkare jayenge, randa-e-dargah ho jayenge, jahan jayenge giraftar kiye jayenge aur buri tarah qatl kiye jayenge.

Aise kuffar-o-munafiqeen par jabke woh apni sarkashi se baaz na aayen musalmanon ko ghalba dena hamari qadeemi sunnat hai jis mein na kabhi taghayyur-o-tabaddul hua na ab ho.

Chadar ka latkana chunke alamat hai azad pak daman auraton ki is liye yeh chadar ke latkane se pehchan li jayengi ke yeh na wahi auratein hain na londiyan hain. Suddi ka qaul hai ke fasiq log andheri raton mein raste se guzarne wali auraton par awazein kaste the is liye yeh nishan ho gaya ke ghar girhast auraton aur londiyon bandiyon waghera mein tameez ho jaye aur un pak daman auraton par koi lab na hila sake. Phir farmaya ke jahiliyat ke zamane mein jo be-pardagi ki rasm thi jab tum Allah ke is hukum ke aamil ban jaoge to Allah Ta'ala tamam agli khataon se darguzar farmale ga aur tum par mehar-o-karam kare ga, phir farmata hai ke agar munafiq log aur badkar aur jhooti afwahein dushmanon ki charhai waghera ki udane wale ab bhi baaz na aaye aur haq ke tarafdar na huye to hum aye Nabi tujhe un par ghalib aur musallat kar denge. Phir to woh Madine mein thehar hi nahin sakenge. Bahut jald tabah kar diye jayenge aur jo kuch din unke Madine ki iqamat se guzrenge woh bhi la'nat-o-phutkar mein zillat aur maar mein guzrenge. Har taraf se dhutkare jayenge, randa-e-dargah ho jayenge, jahan jayenge giraftar kiye jayenge aur buri tarah qatl kiye jayenge.

Aise kuffar-o-munafiqeen par jabke woh apni sarkashi se baaz na aayen musalmanon ko ghalba dena hamari qadeemi sunnat hai jis mein na kabhi taghayyur-o-tabaddul hua na ab ho.

Qayamat qareeb-tar samjho. Log yeh samajh kar ke qayamat kab aayegi, is ka ilm Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hai, aap se sawal karte thay toh Allah Ta'ala ne sab ko apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani maloom karwa diya ke is ka mutlaq mujhe ilm nahin, yeh sirf Allah Ta'ala hi jaanta hai. Surah A'raf mein bhi yeh bayan hai aur is surah mein bhi. Pehli surah Makkah mein utri thi, yeh surah Madine mein nazil hui, jis se zahir kara diya gaya ke ibtida se intiha tak qayamat ke sahih waqt ki ta'een aap ko maloom na thi. Haan itna Allah Ta'ala ne apne bandon ko maloom kara diya tha ke qayamat ka waqt hai qareeb. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (Iqtarabatis-sa'atu wanshaqqal qamar) (Al-Qamar: 1) aur aayat mein hai (Iqtaraba lin-nasi hisabuhum wahum fi ghaflatin mu'ridun) (Al-Anbiya: 1) aur (Ata amrullahi fala tastajiluhu subhanahu wa ta'ala amma yushrikun) (An-Nahl: 1) wagaira. Allah Ta'ala ne kafiron ko apni rahmat se door kar diya hai, un par abadi la'nat farmayi hai. Dar-e-Aakhirat mein un ke liye aag-e-jahannam taiyar hai jo badi bhadakne wali hai, jis mein woh hamesha rahenge, na kabhi nikal saken na chhoot saken aur wahan na koi apna faryad-ras payenge na koi dost-o-madadgar jo unhein chhudale ya bacha sake. Yeh jahannam mein munh ke bal dale jayenge. Us waqt tamanna karenge ke kaash ke hum Allah-o-Rasool ke tabe-dar hote. Maidan-e-Qayamat mein bhi un ki yahi tamannayen rahengi, haath ko chabate hue kahenge ke kaash hum Quran-o-Hadith ke aamil hote. Kaash ke main ne falan ko dost na banaya hota. Us ne toh mujhe Quran-o-Hadith se behka diya, fi-l-waq'i shaitan insan ko zaleel karne wala hai. Aur aayat mein hai (Rubama yawaddulladhina kafarau lau kanu muslimin) (Al-Hijr: 2) anqareeb kuffar aarzoo karenge ke kaash ke woh musalman hote. Us waqt kahenge ke ae Allah hum ne apne sardaron aur apne ulama ki pairwi ki. Umara aur mashayikhin ke peeche lage rahe. Rasoolon se ikhtilaf kiya aur yeh samjha ke hamare bade rah-e-raast par hain, un ke paas haq hai. Aaj sabit hua ke dar-haqiqat woh kuch na thay. Unhon ne toh hamain behka diya, parwardigar tu unhein dohra azab kar. Ek toh un ke apne kufr ka, ek hamain barbad karne ka. Aur un par badtareen la'nat nazil kar. Ek qira'at mein kabiran ke badle kathiran hai, matlab donon ka yaksan hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kisi aisi dua ki darkhwast ki jise woh namaz mein padhain toh aap ne yeh dua ta'leem farmayi: (Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran wa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta faghfirli maghfiratan min indika warhamni innaka antal ghafoorur raheem) yani ae Allah main ne bahut se gunah kiye hain. Main manta hoon ke tere siwa koi unhein maaf nahin kar sakta, pas tu apni khusoosi bakhshish se mujhe bakhsh de aur mujh par raham kar, tu bada hi bakhshish karne wala aur meharban hai. Is hadith mein bhi zulman kathiran aur kabiran donon hi marwi hain.

Baaz logon ne yeh bhi kaha hai ke dua mein kaseeran kabeeran dono lafz mila lein. Lekin yeh theek nahin balkay theek yeh hai ke kabhi kaseeran kahe kabhi kabeeran, dono lafzon mein se jisay chahay parh sakta hai. Lekin dono ko jama nahin kar sakta, Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka ek saathi aap ke mukhalifeen se keh raha tha ke tum Allah ke haan ja kar yeh kaho ge ke (Rabbana inna ata'na) ilakh.

Jaise aur aayat mein hai (Iqtarabatis-sa'atu wanshaqqal qamar) (Al-Qamar: 1) aur aayat mein hai (Iqtaraba lin-nasi hisabuhum wahum fi ghaflatin mu'ridun) (Al-Anbiya: 1) aur (Ata amrullahi fala tastajiluhu subhanahu wa ta'ala amma yushrikun) (An-Nahl: 1) wagaira. Allah Ta'ala ne kafiron ko apni rahmat se door kar diya hai, un par abadi la'nat farmayi hai. Dar-e-Aakhirat mein un ke liye aag-e-jahannam taiyar hai jo badi bhadakne wali hai, jis mein woh hamesha rahenge, na kabhi nikal saken na chhoot saken aur wahan na koi apna faryad-ras payenge na koi dost-o-madadgar jo unhein chhudale ya bacha sake. Yeh jahannam mein munh ke bal dale jayenge. Us waqt tamanna karenge ke kaash ke hum Allah-o-Rasool ke tabe-dar hote. Maidan-e-Qayamat mein bhi un ki yahi tamannayen rahengi, haath ko chabate hue kahenge ke kaash hum Quran-o-Hadith ke aamil hote. Kaash ke main ne falan ko dost na banaya hota. Us ne toh mujhe Quran-o-Hadith se behka diya, fi-l-waq'i shaitan insan ko zaleel karne wala hai. Aur aayat mein hai (Rubama yawaddulladhina kafarau lau kanu muslimin) (Al-Hijr: 2) anqareeb kuffar aarzoo karenge ke kaash ke woh musalman hote. Us waqt kahenge ke ae Allah hum ne apne sardaron aur apne ulama ki pairwi ki. Umara aur mashayikhin ke peeche lage rahe. Rasoolon se ikhtilaf kiya aur yeh samjha ke hamare bade rah-e-raast par hain, un ke paas haq hai. Aaj sabit hua ke dar-haqiqat woh kuch na thay. Unhon ne toh hamain behka diya, parwardigar tu unhein dohra azab kar. Ek toh un ke apne kufr ka, ek hamain barbad karne ka. Aur un par badtareen la'nat nazil kar. Ek qira'at mein kabiran ke badle kathiran hai, matlab donon ka yaksan hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kisi aisi dua ki darkhwast ki jise woh namaz mein padhain toh aap ne yeh dua ta'leem farmayi: (Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran wa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta faghfirli maghfiratan min indika warhamni innaka antal ghafoorur raheem) yani ae Allah main ne bahut se gunah kiye hain. Main manta hoon ke tere siwa koi unhein maaf nahin kar sakta, pas tu apni khusoosi bakhshish se mujhe bakhsh de aur mujh par raham kar, tu bada hi bakhshish karne wala aur meharban hai. Is hadith mein bhi zulman kathiran aur kabiran donon hi marwi hain.

Baaz logon ne yeh bhi kaha hai ke dua mein kaseeran kabeeran dono lafz mila lein. Lekin yeh theek nahin balkay theek yeh hai ke kabhi kaseeran kahe kabhi kabeeran, dono lafzon mein se jisay chahay parh sakta hai. Lekin dono ko jama nahin kar sakta, Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka ek saathi aap ke mukhalifeen se keh raha tha ke tum Allah ke haan ja kar yeh kaho ge ke (Rabbana inna ata'na) ilakh.

Musa A.S ka mizaj. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Hazrat Musa A.S bohat hi sharmiley aur baray lihaz daar thay. Yehi matlab hai Quran ki is aayat ka. Kitab-ut-Tafsir mein toh Imam sahab is hadith ko itna hi mukhtasar laye hain, lekin Ahadith-e-Anbiya ke bayan mein isay mutawwal laye hain. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke woh bojah-e-sakht haya-o-sharm ke apna badan kisi ke samnay nanga nahin karte thay. Bani Israel aap ko eeza dene ke darpay ho gaye aur yeh afwah ura di ke chunke un ke jism par baras ke daagh hain ya un ke baizay barh gaye hain ya koi aur aafat hai is wajah se yeh is qadar parday dari karte hain. Allah Ta'ala ka irada hua ke yeh badgumani aap se door karde. Ek din Hazrat Musa A.S tanhai mein nangay naha rahay thay, ek pathar par aap ne kapray rakh diye thay, jab ghusal se farigh ho kar aaye, kapray lene chahay toh pathar aagay ko sarak gaya. Aap apni lakri liye us ke peechay gaye woh dornay laga. Aap bhi "Ae pathar mere kapray, mere kapray" kehte hue us ke peechay dornay lagay. Bani Israel ki jamaat ek jagah baithi hui thi. Jab aap wahan tak pahunch gaye toh Allah ke hukum se pathar thehar gaya. Aap ne apne kapray pehan liye. Bani Israel ne aap ke tamam jism ko dekh liya aur jo fazool baatein un ke kaanon mein pari thin un se Allah ne apne Nabi ko bari kardiya. Ghussay mein Hazrat Musa A.S ne teen ya chaar paanch lakriyan pathar par maari thin. Rasool Allah ﷺ farmatay hain wallah lakriyon ke nishan us pathar par par gaye. Isi bara'at waghera ka zikr is aayat mein hai. Yeh hadith Muslim mein nahin, yeh riwayat bohat si sanadon se bohat si kitabon mein hai. Baaz riwayatein mauqoof bhi hain. Hazrat Ali R.A se marwi hai ke ek martaba Hazrat Musa A.S aur Hazrat Haroon A.S pahar par gaye jahan Hazrat Haroon A.S ka inteqal ho gaya, logon ne Hazrat Musa A.S ki taraf badgumani ki aur aap ko satana shuru kiya. Parwardigar-e-Aalam ne farishton ko hukum diya aur woh usay utha laye aur Bani Israel ki majlis ke paas se guzray, Allah ne usay zaban di aur qudrati maut ka izhar kiya. Un ki qabr ka sahih nishan na-maloom hai, sirf us teelay ka logon ko ilm hai aur wohi un ki qabr ki jagah janta hai lekin bezaban hai. Toh ho sakta hai ke eeza yehi ho aur ho sakta hai ke woh eeza ho jis ka bayan pehlay guzra. Lekin main kehta hoon yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke yeh aur yeh dono hon balkay un ke siwa aur bhi eeza'ein hon. Huzoor ﷺ ne ek martaba logon mein kuch taqseem kiya, is par ek shakhs ne kaha is taqseem se Allah ki razamandi ka irada nahin kiya gaya. Hazrat Abdullah R.A farmatay hain main ne jab yeh suna toh main ne kaha ae Allah ke dushman main teri is baat ki khabar Rasool Allah ﷺ ko zaroor pahunchaunga. Chunancha main ne ja kar Huzoor ﷺ se khabar kardi, aap ka chehra surkh ho gaya phir farmaya Allah ki rahmat ho Hazrat Musa A.S par woh is se bohat zyada eeza diye gaye lekin sabr kiya. (Bukhari, Muslim) Aur riwayat mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ka aam irshad tha ke koi bhi mere paas kisi ki taraf se koi baat na pahunchaye.

Main chahta hoon ke main tum mein aakar baithoon toh mere dil mein kisi ki taraf se koi baat chubhti hui na ho. Ek martaba kuch maal Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaya, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne use logon mein taqseem kiya. Do shakhs us ke baad aapas mein baatein kar rahe thay. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) un ke paas se guzre, ek dusre se keh raha tha ke wallah is taqseem se na toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Allah ki khushi ka irada kiya na aakhirat ke ghar ka. Main thehar gaya aur dono ki baatein sunin. Phir khidmat-e-Nabwi mein hazir hua aur kaha ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne toh yeh farmaya hai ke kisi ki koi baat mere samne na laya karo. Abhi ka waqia hai ke main ja raha tha jo falan aur falan se main ne yeh baatein sunin, ise sun kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka chehra gusse ke mare surkh ho gaya aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par yeh baat bahut hi garan guzri. Phir meri taraf dekh kar farmaya Abdullah jaane do, dekho Musa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) is se bhi zyada sataye gaye lekin unhon ne sabr kiya, Quran farmata hai Musa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) Allah ke nazdeek bade martabe wale thay. Mustajab-ud-Dawat thay. Jo dua karte thay qabool hoti thi. Haan Allah ka deedar na hua is liye ke yeh taqat-e-insani se kharij tha. Sab se badh kar un ki wajahat ka suboot is se milta hai ke unhon ne apne bhai Hazrat Haroon (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ke liye nabuwat mangi, Allah ne woh bhi ata farmayi. Farmata hai (وَوَهَبْنَا لَهٗ مِنْ رَّحْمَتِنَآ اَخَاهُ هٰرُوْنَ نَبِيًّا 53) (Surah (Maryam: 53) Hum ne use apni rahmat se us ke bhai Haroon ko nabi bana diya.)

Taqwa ki hidayat. Allah Ta'ala apne momin bandon ko apne taqwa ki hidayat karta hai, un se farmata hai ke is tarah woh us ki ibadat karein ke goya use apni aankhon se dekh rahe hain aur baat bilkul saaf, seedhi, sachi, achi bola karein. Jab woh dil mein taqwa, zaban par sachai ikhtiyar kar lenge to is ke badle mein Allah Ta'ala unhein a'maal-e-saliha ki taufiq de ga aur un ke tamam agle gunah maaf farma de ga, balkay aayinda ke liye bhi unhein istighfar ki taufiq de ga taake gunah baqi na rahein. Allah aur Rasool ke farmabardar aur sache kamyab hain, jahannam se door aur jannat se sarfaraz hain. Ek din Zohar ki namaz ke baad mardon ki taraf mutawajja ho kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Mujhe Allah ka hukum hua hai ke main tumhein Allah se darte rehne aur seedhi baat bolne ka hukum doon. Phir aurton ki taraf mutawajja ho kar bhi yahi farmaya (Ibn Abi Hatim). Ibn Abi Dunya ki kitab 'At-Taqwa' mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamesha mimbar par har khutbay mein yeh aayat tilawat farmaya karte thay, lekin is ki sanad ghareeb hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka qaul hai: Jise yeh baat pasand ho ke log us ki izzat karein, use Allah Ta'ala se darte rehna chahiye. Ikrama farmate hain: Qaul-e-Sadeed 'La ilaha illallah' hai. Hazrat Khabbab farmate hain: Sachi baat qaul-e-sadeed hai. Mujahid farmate hain: Har seedhi baat qaul-e-sadeed mein dakhil hai.

Taqwa ki hidayat. Faraiz, hudood amanat hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka bayan hai ke amanat se murad yahan itaat hai. Isay Hazrat Adam (A.S) par pesh karne se pehle zameen-o-aasman aur paharon par pesh kiya gaya lekin woh baar-e-amanat na utha sake aur apni majboori aur mazuri ka izhaar kiya. Janab-e-Bari Azza Ismuhu ne isay ab Hazrat Adam (A.S) par pesh kiya ke yeh sab toh inkaar kar rahe hain. Tum kaho. Aap ne poocha Allah is mein baat kya hai? Farmaya agar baja laoge sawab paoge aur burai ki saza paoge. Aap ne farmaya main tayyar hoon. Aap se yeh bhi marvi hai ke amanat se murad faraiz hain. Dusron par jo pesh kiya tha yeh bator-e-hukm ke na tha balkay jawab talab kiya tha toh unka inkaar aur izhaar-e-majboori gunah na tha balkay is mein ek qisam ki tazeem thi ke bawajood poori taqat ke Allah ke khauf se tharra uthay ke kahin poori adaigi na hosake aur maaray na jayen. Lekin insaan jo ke bhoola tha usne is baar-e-amanat ko khushi khushi utha liya. Aap hi se yeh bhi marvi hai ke asr ke qareeb yeh amanat uthai thi aur maghrib se pehle hi khata sarzad hogayi. Hazrat Ubay (R.A) ka bayan hai ke aurat ki pakdamni bhi Allah ki amanat hai. Qatada ka qaul hai deen, faraiz, hudood sab Allah ki amanat hain. Janabat ka ghusl bhi baqol-e-baaz amanat hai. Zaid bin Aslam farmate hain teen cheezein Allah ki amanat hain: ghusl-e-janabat, roza aur namaz. Matlab yeh hai ke yeh cheezein sab ki sab amanat mein dakhil hain. Tamam ahkaam baja lane, tamam mamnooaat se parhez karne ka insaan mukallaf hai. Jo baja layega sawab payega jahan gunah karega saza payega. Imam Hasan Basri farmate hain khayal karo aasman bawajood is pukhtagi, zeenat aur nek farishton ka maskan hone ke Allah ki amanat bardasht na karsaka jab usne yeh maloom karliya ke baja-awari agar na hui toh azaab hoga. Zameen salahiyat ke bawajood aur sakhti ke lambai aur chaudai ke darr gayi aur apni aajizi zahir karne lagi. Pahar bawajood apni bulandi aur taqat aur sakhti ke is se kaanp gaye aur apni lachari zahir karne lage. Muqatil farmate hain pehle aasmanon ne jawab diya aur kaha yun toh hum muti hain lekin haan hamare bas ki yeh baat nahin kyunke adam-e-baja-awari ki surat mein bahut bada khatra hai. Phir zameen se kaha gaya ke agar poori utri toh fazl-o-karam se nawaz doonga. Lekin usne kaha yun toh har tarah tabe-e-farman ho jo farmaya jaye amal karoon lekin meri wusat se toh yeh bahar hai. Phir paharon se kaha gaya unhon ne bhi jawab diya ke nafarmani toh hum karne ke nahin amanat daal di jaye toh utha lenge lekin yeh bas ki baat nahin hamein maaf farmaya jaye. Phir Hazrat Adam (A.S) se kaha gaya unhon ne kaha aye Allah agar poora utroon toh kya milega? Farmaya badi buzurgi hogi jannat milegi rahm-o-karam hoga aur agar itaat na ki nafarmani ki toh phir sakht saza hogi aur aag mein daal diye jaoge unhon ne kaha ya Allah manzoor hai.

Mujahid farmate hain aasman ne kaha main ne sitaron ko jagah di, farishton ko utha liya lekin yeh nahin utha sakunga, yeh toh faraiz ka bojh hai jis ki mujh mein taqat nahin. Zameen ne kaha mujh mein tu ne darakht boye, darya jaari kiye, logon ko basaya, magar yeh amanat toh mere bas ki nahin. Main farz ki paband ho kar sawab ki umeed par azab ke ehtemal ko nahin utha sakti. Paharon ne bhi yahi kaha lekin insaan ne lapak kar ise utha liya. Baaz riwayaton mein hai ke teen din tak woh girya zari karte rahe aur apni bebasi ka izhar karte rahe lekin insaan ne ise apne zimme le liya. Allah ne use farmaya ab sun agar tu nek niyat raha toh meri iaanat hamesha tere shamil-e-haal rahegi, teri aankhon par main do palkein kar deta hoon ke meri narazgi ki cheezon se tu inhe band kar le. Main teri zaban par do hont bana deta hoon ke jab woh marzi ke khilaf bolna chahe toh tu ise band kar le. Teri sharmgah ki hifazat ke liye main libas utarta hoon ke meri marzi ke khilaf tu ise na khole. Zameen-o-aasman ne sawab-o-azab se inkar kar diya aur farmanbardari mein musakhar rahe lekin insanon ne ise utha liya. Ek bilkul ghareeb marfoo hadith mein hai ke amanat aur wafa insanon par nabiyon ki marifat nazil huin. Allah ka kalam un ki zabanon mein utra, nabiyon ki sunnaton se unhon ne har bhalai burai maloom kar li. Har shakhs neki badi ko jaan gaya. Yaad rakho! Sab se pehle logon mein amanat dari thi phir wafa aur ahd ki nigahbani aur zimmedari ko pura karna tha. Amanat dari ke dhundle se nishan logon ke dilon par reh gaye. Kitabein un ke hathon mein hain. Aalim amal karte hain, jahil jante hain lekin anjaan ban rahe hain, ab yeh amanat wafa mujh tak aur meri ummat tak pahunchi. Yaad rakho Allah isi ko halak karta hai jo apne aap ko halak kar le, ise chhor kar ghaflat mein par jaye. Logo! Hoshiyar raho, apne aap par nazar rakho. Shaitani waswason se bacho. Allah tumhein azma raha hai ke tum mein se achhe amal karne wala kaun hai? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs iman ke sath in cheezon ko layega jannat mein jayega. Panchon waqton ki namaz ki hifazat karta ho, wazu, ruku, sajda aur waqt samet zakat ada karta ho. Dil ki khushi ke sath zakat ki raqam nikalta ho. Suno wallah yeh baghair iman ke ho hi nahin sakta aur amanat ko ada kare. Hazrat Abu Darda (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se sawal hua ke amanat ki adaigi se kya murad hai? Farmaya janabat ka farzi ghusal. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne Ibn-e-Adam par apne deen mein se kisi cheez ki is ke siwa amanat nahin di. Tafsir-e-Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah ki rah ka qatl tamam gunahon ko mita deta hai magar amanat ki khayanat ko nahin mitata. In khainon se Qayamat ke din kaha jayega jao in ki amanatein ada karo, yeh jawab denge Allah kahan se ada karein? Duniya toh jati rahi. Teen martaba yahi sawal jawab hoga phir hukm hoga ke inhe in ki maa Hawiya mein le jao. Farishte dhakke dete hue gira denge.

Yahan tak ke us ki teh tak pahunch jayenge to unhein isi amanat ki hum-shakl jahannam ki aag ki cheez nazar padegi. Yeh use le kar upar ko chadhange jab kinare tak pahunchange to wahan paon phisal jayega. Phir gir padenge aur jahannam ke neeche tak girte chale jayenge. Phir layenge phir girenge hamesha isi azaab mein rahenge. Amanat wuzu mein bhi hai. Namaz mein bhi amanat baat-cheet mein bhi hai aur in sab se zyada amanat un cheezon mein hai jo kisi ke paas bator-e-amanat rakhi jayen. Hazrat Bara R.A se sawal hota hai ke aap ke bhai Abdullah bin Masood R.A yeh kya hadith bayan farma rahe hain? To aap is ki tasdeeq karte hain kaha haan theek hai. Hazrat Huzaifa R.A se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ se main ne do hadeesein suni hain. Ek ko main ne apni aankhon se dekh liya aur dusri ke zuhoor ka mujhe intezar hai ek to yeh ke aap ne farmaya amanat logon ki jibillat mein utari gayi phir Quran utra hadeesein bayan huin. Phir aap ne amanat ke uth jaane ki babat farmaya insaan soyega jo us ke dil se amanat uth jayegi aur aisa nishan reh jayega jaise kisi ke pair par koi angara ludhak kar aa gaya ho aur phapola pad gaya ho ke ubhra hua maloom hota hai lekin andar kuch bhi nahin. Phir aap ne ek kankar le kar use apne pair par ludhka kar dikha diya ke is tarah log len-den khareedo-farokht kiya karenge. Lekin taqreeban ek bhi imandar na hoga. Yahan tak ke mashhoor ho jayega ke falan qabeelay mein koi amanat-dar hai. Aur yahan tak ke kaha jayega yeh shakhs kaisa aqalmand, kis qadar zeerak, dana aur farasat wala hai halanke us ke dil mein rai ke daane barabar bhi imaan na hoga. Hazrat Huzaifa R.A farmate hain dekho is se pehle to main har ek se udhar-sudhar kar liya karta tha kyunke agar woh musalman hai to woh khud mera haq mujhe de jayega aur agar yahoodi ya nasrani hai to hukumat-e-Islam mujhe us se dilwa degi. Lekin ab to sirf falan falan ko hi udhar deta hoon baqi band kar diya hai. (Muslim waghera) Musnad-e-Ahmad mein farman-e-Rasool Allah ﷺ hai ke chaar baatein tujh mein hon phir agar sari duniya bhi faut ho jaye to tujhe nuqsan nahin. Amanat ki hifazat, baat-cheet ki sadaqat, husn-e-akhlaq aur wajah-e-halal ki rozi. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mubarak ki Kitab-uz-Zuhd mein hai ke Jabla bin Suhaim Hazrat Ziyad ke sath thay ittefaq se un ke munh se baton hi baton mein nikal gaya qasam hai amanat ki. Is par Hazrat Ziyad rone lage aur bohat roye. Main darr gaya ke mujh se koi sakht gunah sar-zad hua. Main ne kaha kya woh ise makrooh jaante thay farmaya haan Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ise bohat makrooh jaante thay aur is se mana farmate thay.

Abu Dawood mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain woh hum mein se nahin jo amanat ki qasam khaye, amanatdari jo Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne ki us ka natija yeh hoga ke munafiq mard-o-aurat aur mushrik mard-o-aurat yani woh jo zahir mein Musalman aur batin mein kafir thay aur woh jo andar bahar yaksan kafir thay unhein toh sakht saza mile aur momin mard-o-aurat par Allah ki rahmat nazil ho. Jo Allah ko us ke farishton ko us ke Rasoolon ko maante thay aur Allah ke sachay farmanbardar rahay. Allah Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai.

Faraiz, hudood amanat hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka bayan hai ke amanat se murad yahan itaat hai. Isay Hazrat Adam (A.S) par pesh karne se pehle zameen-o-aasman aur paharon par pesh kiya gaya lekin woh baar-e-amanat na utha sake aur apni majboori aur mazuri ka izhaar kiya. Janab-e-Bari Azza Ismuhu ne isay ab Hazrat Adam (A.S) par pesh kiya ke yeh sab toh inkaar kar rahe hain. Tum kaho. Aap ne poocha Allah is mein baat kya hai? Farmaya agar baja laoge sawab paoge aur burai ki saza paoge. Aap ne farmaya main tayyar hoon. Aap se yeh bhi marvi hai ke amanat se murad faraiz hain. Dusron par jo pesh kiya tha yeh bator-e-hukm ke na tha balkay jawab talab kiya tha toh unka inkaar aur izhaar-e-majboori gunah na tha balkay is mein ek qisam ki tazeem thi ke bawajood poori taqat ke Allah ke khauf se tharra uthay ke kahin poori adaigi na hosake aur maaray na jayen. Lekin insaan jo ke bhoola tha usne is baar-e-amanat ko khushi khushi utha liya. Aap hi se yeh bhi marvi hai ke asr ke qareeb yeh amanat uthai thi aur maghrib se pehle hi khata sarzad hogayi. Hazrat Ubay (R.A) ka bayan hai ke aurat ki pakdamni bhi Allah ki amanat hai. Qatada ka qaul hai deen, faraiz, hudood sab Allah ki amanat hain. Janabat ka ghusl bhi baqol-e-baaz amanat hai. Zaid bin Aslam farmate hain teen cheezein Allah ki amanat hain: ghusl-e-janabat, roza aur namaz. Matlab yeh hai ke yeh cheezein sab ki sab amanat mein dakhil hain. Tamam ahkaam baja lane, tamam mamnooaat se parhez karne ka insaan mukallaf hai. Jo baja layega sawab payega jahan gunah karega saza payega. Imam Hasan Basri farmate hain khayal karo aasman bawajood is pukhtagi, zeenat aur nek farishton ka maskan hone ke Allah ki amanat bardasht na karsaka jab usne yeh maloom karliya ke baja-awari agar na hui toh azaab hoga. Zameen salahiyat ke bawajood aur sakhti ke lambai aur chaudai ke darr gayi aur apni aajizi zahir karne lagi. Pahar bawajood apni bulandi aur taqat aur sakhti ke is se kaanp gaye aur apni lachari zahir karne lage. Muqatil farmate hain pehle aasmanon ne jawab diya aur kaha yun toh hum muti hain lekin haan hamare bas ki yeh baat nahin kyunke adam-e-baja-awari ki surat mein bahut bada khatra hai. Phir zameen se kaha gaya ke agar poori utri toh fazl-o-karam se nawaz doonga. Lekin usne kaha yun toh har tarah tabe-e-farman ho jo farmaya jaye amal karoon lekin meri wusat se toh yeh bahar hai. Phir paharon se kaha gaya unhon ne bhi jawab diya ke nafarmani toh hum karne ke nahin amanat daal di jaye toh utha lenge lekin yeh bas ki baat nahin hamein maaf farmaya jaye. Phir Hazrat Adam (A.S) se kaha gaya unhon ne kaha aye Allah agar poora utroon toh kya milega? Farmaya badi buzurgi hogi jannat milegi rahm-o-karam hoga aur agar itaat na ki nafarmani ki toh phir sakht saza hogi aur aag mein daal diye jaoge unhon ne kaha ya Allah manzoor hai.

Mujahid farmate hain aasman ne kaha main ne sitaron ko jagah di, farishton ko utha liya lekin yeh nahin utha sakunga, yeh toh faraiz ka bojh hai jis ki mujh mein taqat nahin. Zameen ne kaha mujh mein tu ne darakht boye, darya jaari kiye, logon ko basaya, magar yeh amanat toh mere bas ki nahin. Main farz ki paband ho kar sawab ki umeed par azab ke ehtemal ko nahin utha sakti. Paharon ne bhi yahi kaha lekin insaan ne lapak kar ise utha liya. Baaz riwayaton mein hai ke teen din tak woh girya zari karte rahe aur apni bebasi ka izhar karte rahe lekin insaan ne ise apne zimme le liya. Allah ne use farmaya ab sun agar tu nek niyat raha toh meri iaanat hamesha tere shamil-e-haal rahegi, teri aankhon par main do palkein kar deta hoon ke meri narazgi ki cheezon se tu inhe band kar le. Main teri zaban par do hont bana deta hoon ke jab woh marzi ke khilaf bolna chahe toh tu ise band kar le. Teri sharmgah ki hifazat ke liye main libas utarta hoon ke meri marzi ke khilaf tu ise na khole. Zameen-o-aasman ne sawab-o-azab se inkar kar diya aur farmanbardari mein musakhar rahe lekin insanon ne ise utha liya. Ek bilkul ghareeb marfoo hadith mein hai ke amanat aur wafa insanon par nabiyon ki marifat nazil huin. Allah ka kalam un ki zabanon mein utra, nabiyon ki sunnaton se unhon ne har bhalai burai maloom kar li. Har shakhs neki badi ko jaan gaya. Yaad rakho! Sab se pehle logon mein amanat dari thi phir wafa aur ahd ki nigahbani aur zimmedari ko pura karna tha. Amanat dari ke dhundle se nishan logon ke dilon par reh gaye. Kitabein un ke hathon mein hain. Aalim amal karte hain, jahil jante hain lekin anjaan ban rahe hain, ab yeh amanat wafa mujh tak aur meri ummat tak pahunchi. Yaad rakho Allah isi ko halak karta hai jo apne aap ko halak kar le, ise chhor kar ghaflat mein par jaye. Logo! Hoshiyar raho, apne aap par nazar rakho. Shaitani waswason se bacho. Allah tumhein azma raha hai ke tum mein se achhe amal karne wala kaun hai? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs iman ke sath in cheezon ko layega jannat mein jayega. Panchon waqton ki namaz ki hifazat karta ho, wazu, ruku, sajda aur waqt samet zakat ada karta ho. Dil ki khushi ke sath zakat ki raqam nikalta ho. Suno wallah yeh baghair iman ke ho hi nahin sakta aur amanat ko ada kare. Hazrat Abu Darda (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se sawal hua ke amanat ki adaigi se kya murad hai? Farmaya janabat ka farzi ghusal. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne Ibn-e-Adam par apne deen mein se kisi cheez ki is ke siwa amanat nahin di. Tafsir-e-Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah ki rah ka qatl tamam gunahon ko mita deta hai magar amanat ki khayanat ko nahin mitata. In khainon se Qayamat ke din kaha jayega jao in ki amanatein ada karo, yeh jawab denge Allah kahan se ada karein? Duniya toh jati rahi. Teen martaba yahi sawal jawab hoga phir hukm hoga ke inhe in ki maa Hawiya mein le jao. Farishte dhakke dete hue gira denge.

Yahan tak ke us ki teh tak pahunch jayenge to unhein isi amanat ki hum-shakl jahannam ki aag ki cheez nazar padegi. Yeh use le kar upar ko chadhange jab kinare tak pahunchange to wahan paon phisal jayega. Phir gir padenge aur jahannam ke neeche tak girte chale jayenge. Phir layenge phir girenge hamesha isi azaab mein rahenge. Amanat wuzu mein bhi hai. Namaz mein bhi amanat baat-cheet mein bhi hai aur in sab se zyada amanat un cheezon mein hai jo kisi ke paas bator-e-amanat rakhi jayen. Hazrat Bara R.A se sawal hota hai ke aap ke bhai Abdullah bin Masood R.A yeh kya hadith bayan farma rahe hain? To aap is ki tasdeeq karte hain kaha haan theek hai. Hazrat Huzaifa R.A se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ se main ne do hadeesein suni hain. Ek ko main ne apni aankhon se dekh liya aur dusri ke zuhoor ka mujhe intezar hai ek to yeh ke aap ne farmaya amanat logon ki jibillat mein utari gayi phir Quran utra hadeesein bayan huin. Phir aap ne amanat ke uth jaane ki babat farmaya insaan soyega jo us ke dil se amanat uth jayegi aur aisa nishan reh jayega jaise kisi ke pair par koi angara ludhak kar aa gaya ho aur phapola pad gaya ho ke ubhra hua maloom hota hai lekin andar kuch bhi nahin. Phir aap ne ek kankar le kar use apne pair par ludhka kar dikha diya ke is tarah log len-den khareedo-farokht kiya karenge. Lekin taqreeban ek bhi imandar na hoga. Yahan tak ke mashhoor ho jayega ke falan qabeelay mein koi amanat-dar hai. Aur yahan tak ke kaha jayega yeh shakhs kaisa aqalmand, kis qadar zeerak, dana aur farasat wala hai halanke us ke dil mein rai ke daane barabar bhi imaan na hoga. Hazrat Huzaifa R.A farmate hain dekho is se pehle to main har ek se udhar-sudhar kar liya karta tha kyunke agar woh musalman hai to woh khud mera haq mujhe de jayega aur agar yahoodi ya nasrani hai to hukumat-e-Islam mujhe us se dilwa degi. Lekin ab to sirf falan falan ko hi udhar deta hoon baqi band kar diya hai. (Muslim waghera) Musnad-e-Ahmad mein farman-e-Rasool Allah ﷺ hai ke chaar baatein tujh mein hon phir agar sari duniya bhi faut ho jaye to tujhe nuqsan nahin. Amanat ki hifazat, baat-cheet ki sadaqat, husn-e-akhlaq aur wajah-e-halal ki rozi. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mubarak ki Kitab-uz-Zuhd mein hai ke Jabla bin Suhaim Hazrat Ziyad ke sath thay ittefaq se un ke munh se baton hi baton mein nikal gaya qasam hai amanat ki. Is par Hazrat Ziyad rone lage aur bohat roye. Main darr gaya ke mujh se koi sakht gunah sar-zad hua. Main ne kaha kya woh ise makrooh jaante thay farmaya haan Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ise bohat makrooh jaante thay aur is se mana farmate thay.

Abu Dawood mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain woh hum mein se nahin jo amanat ki qasam khaye, amanatdari jo Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne ki us ka natija yeh hoga ke munafiq mard-o-aurat aur mushrik mard-o-aurat yani woh jo zahir mein Musalman aur batin mein kafir thay aur woh jo andar bahar yaksan kafir thay unhein toh sakht saza mile aur momin mard-o-aurat par Allah ki rahmat nazil ho. Jo Allah ko us ke farishton ko us ke Rasoolon ko maante thay aur Allah ke sachay farmanbardar rahay. Allah Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai.
